// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\ParkingSystemConfigurationManagement\Command\Update\UpdateParkingConfigurationCommandHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction.Security;
using NPark.Application.Shared.Dto;
using NPark.Application.Specifications.ParkingGateSpec;
using NPark.Application.Specifications.ParkingSystemConfigurationSpec;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;
using NPark.Domain.FileNames;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.ParkingSystemConfigurationManagement.Command.Update
{
    public sealed class UpdateParkingConfigurationCommandHandler
        : ICommandHandler<UpdateParkingConfigurationCommand>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<ParkingSystemConfiguration> _parkingSystemConfigurationRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<ParkingGate> _parkingGateRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<Ticket> _ticketRepository;
        private readonly IAuditLogger _auditLogger;
        private readonly ILogger<UpdateParkingConfigurationCommandHandler> _logger;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<User> _userRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<ONVIFCameraSetting> _onvifCameraSettingRepository;

        public UpdateParkingConfigurationCommandHandler(
            IGenericRepository<ParkingSystemConfiguration> parkingSystemConfigurationRepository,
            IGenericRepository<ParkingGate> parkingGateRepository,
            IGenericRepository<Ticket> ticketRepository,
            IAuditLogger auditLogger,
            ILogger<UpdateParkingConfigurationCommandHandler> logger,
            IGenericRepository<User> userRepository,
            IGenericRepository<ONVIFCameraSetting> onvifCameraSettingRepository)
        {
            _parkingSystemConfigurationRepository = parkingSystemConfigurationRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(parkingSystemConfigurationRepository));

            _parkingGateRepository = parkingGateRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(parkingGateRepository));

            _ticketRepository = ticketRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticketRepository));

            _auditLogger = auditLogger
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(auditLogger));

            _logger = logger
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));

            _userRepository = userRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(userRepository));

            _onvifCameraSettingRepository = onvifCameraSettingRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(onvifCameraSettingRepository));
        }

        public async Task<Result> Handle(
            UpdateParkingConfigurationCommand request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            try
            {
                var spec = new GetParkingSystemConfigurationForUpdateSpecification();

                var configuration = await _parkingSystemConfigurationRepository
                    .FirstOrDefaultWithSpecAsync(spec, cancellationToken);

                if (configuration is null)
                {
                    return await CreateConfigurationAsync(request, cancellationToken);
                }

                return await UpdateConfigurationAsync(configuration, request, cancellationToken);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("UpdateParkingConfiguration operation was canceled.");
                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error while updating parking configuration.");

                return Result.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "ParkingConfiguration.Update.Unexpected",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.ParkingConfiguration_Update_Unexpected,
                        Type: ErrorType.Infrastructure));
            }
        }

        private async Task<Result> CreateConfigurationAsync(
            UpdateParkingConfigurationCommand request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var pricingSchemaId = request.PricingSchemaId == Guid.Empty
                ? null
                : request.PricingSchemaId;

            var gracePeriod = request.gracePeriodMinutes.HasValue
                ? TimeSpan.FromMinutes(request.gracePeriodMinutes.Value)
                : (TimeSpan?)null;

            var configuration = ParkingSystemConfiguration.Create(
                entryGatesCount: request.EntryGatesCount,
                exitGatesCount: request.ExitGatesCount,
                allowedParkingSlots: request.AllowedParkingSlots,
                priceType: request.PriceType,
                vehiclePassengerData: request.VehiclePassengerData,
                printType: request.PrintType,
                dateTimeFlag: request.DateTimeFlag,
                ticketIdFlag: request.TicketIdFlag,
                feesFlag: request.FeesFlag,
                pricingSchemaId: pricingSchemaId,
                gracePeriod: gracePeriod);

            await _parkingSystemConfigurationRepository.AddAsync(configuration, cancellationToken);
            await _parkingSystemConfigurationRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            var addEntryGatesResult = await AddNewGatesAsync(
                configurationId: configuration.Id,
                gateInfos: request.EntryGates,
                gateType: GateType.Entrance,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken);

            if (addEntryGatesResult.IsFailure)
            {
                return addEntryGatesResult;
            }

            var addExitGatesResult = await AddNewGatesAsync(
                configurationId: configuration.Id,
                gateInfos: request.ExitGates,
                gateType: GateType.Exit,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken);

            if (addExitGatesResult.IsFailure)
            {
                return addExitGatesResult;
            }

            await _parkingGateRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            await SafeAuditAsync(
                eventName: "CreateParkingSystemConfiguration",
                statusCode: 201,
                request: request,
                configurationId: configuration.Id,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Parking system configuration created successfully. ConfigurationId: {ConfigurationId}",
                configuration.Id);

            return Result.Ok();
        }

        private async Task<Result> UpdateConfigurationAsync(
            ParkingSystemConfiguration configuration,
            UpdateParkingConfigurationCommand request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var pricingSchemaId = request.PricingSchemaId == Guid.Empty
                ? null
                : request.PricingSchemaId;

            var gracePeriod = request.gracePeriodMinutes.HasValue
                ? TimeSpan.FromMinutes(request.gracePeriodMinutes.Value)
                : (TimeSpan?)null;

            configuration.Update(
                entryGatesCount: request.EntryGatesCount,
                exitGatesCount: request.ExitGatesCount,
                allowedParkingSlots: request.AllowedParkingSlots,
                priceType: request.PriceType,
                vehiclePassengerData: request.VehiclePassengerData,
                printType: request.PrintType,
                dateTimeFlag: request.DateTimeFlag,
                ticketIdFlag: request.TicketIdFlag,
                feesFlag: request.FeesFlag,
                pricingSchemaId: pricingSchemaId,
                gracePeriod: gracePeriod);

            await _parkingSystemConfigurationRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            var gateSpec = new GetParkingGateBySystemConfiguration(configuration.Id);

            var existingGates = (await _parkingGateRepository
                    .ListWithSpecAsync(gateSpec, cancellationToken))
                .ToList();

            var requestedGateIds = request.EntryGates
                .Concat(request.ExitGates)
                .Where(g => g.GateId.HasValue)
                .Select(g => g.GateId!.Value)
                .ToHashSet();

            var gatesToDelete = existingGates
                .Where(g => !requestedGateIds.Contains(g.Id))
                .ToList();

            foreach (var gate in gatesToDelete)
            {
                var hasTickets = await _ticketRepository.IsExistAsync(
                    t => t.GateId == gate.Id,
                    cancellationToken);

                if (hasTickets)
                {
                    return Result.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Gate.HasTickets",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.Gate_HasTickets,
                            Type: ErrorType.Conflict));
                }
            }

            if (gatesToDelete.Count > 0)
            {
                _parkingGateRepository.DeleteRange(gatesToDelete);
                await _parkingGateRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
            }

            existingGates = (await _parkingGateRepository
                    .ListWithSpecAsync(gateSpec, cancellationToken))
                .ToList();

            var existingGateById = existingGates
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Id, g => g);

            var updateEntryResult = await UpdateExistingGatesAsync(
                existingGateById: existingGateById,
                gateInfos: request.EntryGates,
                gateType: GateType.Entrance,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken);

            if (updateEntryResult.IsFailure)
            {
                return updateEntryResult;
            }

            var updateExitResult = await UpdateExistingGatesAsync(
                existingGateById: existingGateById,
                gateInfos: request.ExitGates,
                gateType: GateType.Exit,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken);

            if (updateExitResult.IsFailure)
            {
                return updateExitResult;
            }

            await _parkingGateRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            var addNewEntryGatesResult = await AddNewGatesAsync(
                configurationId: configuration.Id,
                gateInfos: request.EntryGates.Where(g => !g.GateId.HasValue),
                gateType: GateType.Entrance,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken);

            if (addNewEntryGatesResult.IsFailure)
            {
                return addNewEntryGatesResult;
            }

            var addNewExitGatesResult = await AddNewGatesAsync(
                configurationId: configuration.Id,
                gateInfos: request.ExitGates.Where(g => !g.GateId.HasValue),
                gateType: GateType.Exit,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken);

            if (addNewExitGatesResult.IsFailure)
            {
                return addNewExitGatesResult;
            }

            await _parkingGateRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            await SafeAuditAsync(
                eventName: "UpdateParkingSystemConfiguration",
                statusCode: 200,
                request: request,
                configurationId: configuration.Id,
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Parking system configuration updated successfully. ConfigurationId: {ConfigurationId}",
                configuration.Id);

            return Result.Ok();
        }

        private async Task<Result> AddNewGatesAsync(
            int configurationId,
            IEnumerable<GateInfo> gateInfos,
            GateType gateType,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var gateInfoList = gateInfos.ToList();

            var duplicateGateNumberInRequest = gateInfoList
                .GroupBy(g => g.GateNumber)
                .FirstOrDefault(g => g.Count() > 1);

            if (duplicateGateNumberInRequest is not null)
            {
                return Result.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "Gate.DuplicateGateNumberInRequest",
                        Message: string.Format(
                            ErrorMessage.Gate_DuplicateGateNumberInRequest,
                            duplicateGateNumberInRequest.Key,
                            gateType),
                        Type: ErrorType.Validation));
            }

            foreach (var gateInfo in gateInfoList)
            {
                var validationResult = await ValidateGateInfoAsync(
                    gateInfo,
                    gateType,
                    cancellationToken);

                if (validationResult.IsFailure)
                {
                    return validationResult;
                }

                var alreadyExists = await _parkingGateRepository.IsExistAsync(
                    g => g.GateNumber == gateInfo.GateNumber &&
                         g.GateType == gateType,
                    cancellationToken);

                if (alreadyExists)
                {
                    return Result.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Gate.DuplicateGateNumberForType",
                            Message: string.Format(
                                ErrorMessage.Gate_DuplicateGateNumberForType_MissingGateId,
                                gateInfo.GateNumber,
                                gateType),
                            Type: ErrorType.Conflict));
                }

                var onvifCameraSettingId = await CreateOrUpdateOnvifCameraSettingAsync(
                    gateInfo.ONVIFCameraSetting,
                    existingCameraSettingId: null,
                    cancellationToken);

                var parkingGate = ParkingGate.Create(
                    gateNumber: gateInfo.GateNumber,
                    gateType: gateType,
                    parkingSystemConfigurationId: configurationId,
                    lprIp: gateInfo.LprIp,
                    pcIp: gateInfo.PcIp,
                    controlIp: gateInfo.ControlIp,
                    onvifCameraSettingId: onvifCameraSettingId,
                    hasQrPrinterName: gateInfo.HasQrPrinterName,
                    qrPrinterName: gateInfo.QrPrinterName,
                    hasReceiptPrinterName: gateInfo.HasReceiptPrinterName,
                    receiptPrinterName: gateInfo.ReceiptPrinterName);

                parkingGate.UpdateGateInfo(
                    gateNumber: gateInfo.GateNumber,
                    gateType: gateType,
                    lprIp: gateInfo.LprIp,
                    pcIp: gateInfo.PcIp,
                    controlIp: gateInfo.ControlIp,
                    onvifCameraSettingId: onvifCameraSettingId,
                    isAssigned: gateInfo.IsAssigned,
                    assignedTo: gateInfo.IsAssigned ? gateInfo.AssignedTo : null,
                    hasScanner: gateInfo.HasScanner!.Value,
                    hasQrPrinterName: gateInfo.HasQrPrinterName,
                    qrPrinterName: gateInfo.QrPrinterName,
                    hasReceiptPrinterName: gateInfo.HasReceiptPrinterName,
                    receiptPrinterName: gateInfo.ReceiptPrinterName);

                await _parkingGateRepository.AddAsync(parkingGate, cancellationToken);
            }

            return Result.Ok();
        }

        private async Task<Result> UpdateExistingGatesAsync(
            IDictionary<Guid, ParkingGate> existingGateById,
            IEnumerable<GateInfo> gateInfos,
            GateType gateType,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var gateInfoList = gateInfos
                .Where(g => g.GateId.HasValue)
                .ToList();

            var duplicateGateNumberInRequest = gateInfoList
                .GroupBy(g => g.GateNumber)
                .FirstOrDefault(g => g.Count() > 1);

            if (duplicateGateNumberInRequest is not null)
            {
                return Result.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "Gate.DuplicateGateNumberInRequest",
                        Message: string.Format(
                            ErrorMessage.Gate_DuplicateGateNumberInRequest,
                            duplicateGateNumberInRequest.Key,
                            gateType),
                        Type: ErrorType.Validation));
            }

            foreach (var gateInfo in gateInfoList)
            {
                if (!existingGateById.TryGetValue(gateInfo.GateId!.Value, out var gate))
                {
                    return Result.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Gate.NotFound",
                            Message: string.Format(
                                ErrorMessage.Gate_NotFound,
                                gateInfo.GateId.Value),
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                var validationResult = await ValidateGateInfoAsync(
                    gateInfo,
                    gateType,
                    cancellationToken);

                if (validationResult.IsFailure)
                {
                    return validationResult;
                }

                var duplicateGateNumberExists = await _parkingGateRepository.IsExistAsync(
                    g => g.Id != gate.Id &&
                         g.GateNumber == gateInfo.GateNumber &&
                         g.GateType == gateType,
                    cancellationToken);

                if (duplicateGateNumberExists)
                {
                    return Result.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Gate.DuplicateGateNumberForType",
                            Message: string.Format(
                                ErrorMessage.Gate_DuplicateGateNumberForType,
                                gateInfo.GateNumber,
                                gateType),
                            Type: ErrorType.Conflict));
                }

                var onvifCameraSettingId = await CreateOrUpdateOnvifCameraSettingAsync(
                    gateInfo.ONVIFCameraSetting,
                    gate.ONVIFCameraSettingId,
                    cancellationToken);

                gate.UpdateGateInfo(
                    gateNumber: gateInfo.GateNumber,
                    gateType: gateType,
                    lprIp: gateInfo.LprIp,
                    pcIp: gateInfo.PcIp,
                    controlIp: gateInfo.ControlIp,
                    onvifCameraSettingId: onvifCameraSettingId,
                    isAssigned: gateInfo.IsAssigned,
                    assignedTo: gateInfo.IsAssigned ? gateInfo.AssignedTo : null,
                    hasScanner: gateInfo.HasScanner!.Value,
                    hasQrPrinterName: gateInfo.HasQrPrinterName,
                    qrPrinterName: gateInfo.QrPrinterName,
                    hasReceiptPrinterName: gateInfo.HasReceiptPrinterName,
                    receiptPrinterName: gateInfo.ReceiptPrinterName);
            }

            return Result.Ok();
        }

        private async Task<Result> ValidateGateInfoAsync(
            GateInfo gateInfo,
            GateType gateType,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (!gateInfo.HasScanner.HasValue)
            {
                return Result.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "Gate.HasScanner.Required",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.Gate_HasScanner_Required,
                        Type: ErrorType.Validation));
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gateInfo.ControlIp))
            {
                return Result.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "Gate.ControlIp.Required",
                        Message: string.Format(
                            ErrorMessage.Gate_ControlIp_Required,
                            gateInfo.GateNumber),
                        Type: ErrorType.Validation));
            }

            if (gateInfo.IsAssigned && gateInfo.AssignedTo is null)
            {
                return Result.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "Gate.AssignedTo.Required",
                        Message: string.Format(
                            ErrorMessage.Gate_AssignedTo_Required,
                            gateInfo.GateNumber),
                        Type: ErrorType.Validation));
            }

            if (gateInfo.AssignedTo.HasValue)
            {
                var user = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(
                    gateInfo.AssignedTo.Value,
                    cancellationToken);

                var expectedRoleId = gateType == GateType.Entrance
                    ? SystemRoles.EntranceCashierRoleId
                    : SystemRoles.ExitCashierRoleId;

                if (user is null || user.RoleId != expectedRoleId)
                {
                    return Result.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Gate.AssignedToInvalidUser",
                            Message: string.Format(
                                ErrorMessage.Gate_AssignedToInvalidUser,
                                gateInfo.GateNumber),
                            Type: ErrorType.Validation));
                }
            }

            if (gateInfo.ONVIFCameraSetting is not null)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gateInfo.ONVIFCameraSetting.UrlRequest))
                {
                    return Result.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Gate.ONVIF.UrlRequest.Required",
                            Message: string.Format(
                                ErrorMessage.Gate_ONVIF_UrlRequest_Required_ForGate,
                                gateInfo.GateNumber),
                            Type: ErrorType.Validation));
                }

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gateInfo.ONVIFCameraSetting.UserName))
                {
                    return Result.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Gate.ONVIF.UserName.Required",
                            Message: string.Format(
                                ErrorMessage.Gate_ONVIF_UserName_Required_ForGate,
                                gateInfo.GateNumber),
                            Type: ErrorType.Validation));
                }

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gateInfo.ONVIFCameraSetting.Password))
                {
                    return Result.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Gate.ONVIF.Password.Required",
                            Message: string.Format(
                                ErrorMessage.Gate_ONVIF_Password_Required_ForGate,
                                gateInfo.GateNumber),
                            Type: ErrorType.Validation));
                }
            }

            if (gateInfo.HasQrPrinterName && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gateInfo.QrPrinterName))
            {
                return Result.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "Gate.QrPrinterName.Required",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.Gate_QrPrinterName_RequiredWhenHasQrPrinterName,
                        Type: ErrorType.Validation));
            }

            if (gateInfo.HasReceiptPrinterName && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gateInfo.ReceiptPrinterName))
            {
                return Result.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "Gate.ReceiptPrinterName.Required",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.Gate_ReceiptPrinterName_RequiredWhenHasReceiptPrinterName,
                        Type: ErrorType.Validation));
            }

            return Result.Ok();
        }

        private async Task<Guid?> CreateOrUpdateOnvifCameraSettingAsync(
            ONVIFCameraSettingDto? dto,
            Guid? existingCameraSettingId,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (dto is null)
            {
                return null;
            }

            if (existingCameraSettingId.HasValue)
            {
                var existing = await _onvifCameraSettingRepository.GetByIdAsync(
                    existingCameraSettingId.Value,
                    cancellationToken);

                if (existing is not null)
                {
                    existing.Update(
                        dto.UrlRequest,
                        dto.UserName,
                        dto.Password);

                    await _onvifCameraSettingRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

                    return existing.Id;
                }
            }

            var cameraSetting = ONVIFCameraSetting.Create(
                dto.UrlRequest,
                dto.UserName,
                dto.Password);

            await _onvifCameraSettingRepository.AddAsync(cameraSetting, cancellationToken);
            await _onvifCameraSettingRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            return cameraSetting.Id;
        }

        private async Task SafeAuditAsync(
            string eventName,
            int statusCode,
            UpdateParkingConfigurationCommand request,
            int configurationId,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            try
            {
                await _auditLogger.LogAsync(
                    new AuditLogEntry(
                        EventName: eventName,
                        EventCategory: "ParkingSystem",
                        IsSuccess: true,
                        StatusCode: statusCode,
                        UserId: null,
                        GateId: null,
                        Extra: new
                        {
                            ConfigurationId = configurationId,
                            request.EntryGatesCount,
                            request.ExitGatesCount,
                            request.AllowedParkingSlots,
                            request.PriceType,
                            request.gracePeriodMinutes,
                            TotalEntryGates = request.EntryGates.Count,
                            TotalExitGates = request.ExitGates.Count,
                            EntryGatesWithScanner = request.EntryGates.Count(g => g.HasScanner == true),
                            ExitGatesWithScanner = request.ExitGates.Count(g => g.HasScanner == true),
                            LoggedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                        }),
                    cancellationToken);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    ex,
                    "Audit logging failed for {EventName}. ConfigurationId: {ConfigurationId}",
                    eventName,
                    configurationId);
            }
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\ParkingSystemConfigurationManagement\Command\Update\UpdateParkingConfigurationCommandValidator.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using FluentValidation;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;
using System.Net;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.ParkingSystemConfigurationManagement.Command.Update
{
    public sealed class UpdateParkingConfigurationCommandValidator
        : AbstractValidator<UpdateParkingConfigurationCommand>
    {
        private const int PrinterNameMaxLength = 250;

        private readonly IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> _pricingSchemeRepository;

        public UpdateParkingConfigurationCommandValidator(
            IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> pricingSchemeRepository)
        {
            _pricingSchemeRepository = pricingSchemeRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(pricingSchemeRepository));

            RuleFor(x => x.EntryGatesCount)
                .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(1)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_EntryGatesCount);

            RuleFor(x => x.ExitGatesCount)
                .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(1)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_ExitGatesCount);

            RuleFor(x => x.PriceType)
                .IsInEnum()
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_PriceType);

            RuleFor(x => x.VehiclePassengerData)
                .IsInEnum()
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_VehiclePassengerData);

            RuleFor(x => x.PrintType)
                .IsInEnum()
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_PrintType);

            RuleFor(x => x.AllowedParkingSlots)
                .GreaterThan(0)
                .When(x => x.AllowedParkingSlots.HasValue)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_AllowedParkingSlots);

            When(x => x.PriceType == PriceType.Enter, () =>
            {
                RuleFor(x => x.PricingSchemaId)
                    .Cascade(CascadeMode.Stop)
                    .NotNull()
                    .NotEqual(Guid.Empty)
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.PricingSchemaId_RequiredWhenEnter)
                    .MustAsync(async (id, token) =>
                        id.HasValue &&
                        await _pricingSchemeRepository.IsExistAsync(p => p.Id == id.Value, token))
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.PricingSchema_NotFound);
            });

            RuleFor(x => x.EntryGatesCount)
                .Equal(x => x.EntryGates.Count)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Gate_EntryGatesCount_MustMatchEntryGates);

            RuleFor(x => x.ExitGatesCount)
                .Equal(x => x.ExitGates.Count)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Gate_ExitGatesCount_MustMatchExitGates);

            RuleForEach(x => x.EntryGates)
                .ChildRules(gate =>
                {
                    AddGateRules(gate, "EntryGate");
                });

            RuleForEach(x => x.ExitGates)
                .ChildRules(gate =>
                {
                    AddGateRules(gate, "ExitGate");
                });

            RuleFor(x => x)
                .Must(HaveUniqueLprIps)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Gate_LprIp_MustBeUnique);

            RuleFor(x => x)
                .Must(HaveUniqueControlIps)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Gate_ControlIp_MustBeUnique);
        }

        private static void AddGateRules(
            InlineValidator<GateInfo> gate,
            string gateLabel)
        {
            gate.RuleFor(x => x.ControlIp)
                .Cascade(CascadeMode.Stop)
                .NotEmpty()
                .WithMessage(string.Format(
                    ErrorMessage.Gate_ControlIp_Required_ForGateType,
                    gateLabel))
                .Must(IsValidIp)
                .WithMessage(string.Format(
                    ErrorMessage.Gate_ControlIp_Invalid_ForGateType,
                    gateLabel));

            gate.RuleFor(x => x.LprIp)
                .Must(IsValidIp)
                .WithMessage(string.Format(
                    ErrorMessage.Gate_LprIp_Invalid_ForGateType,
                    gateLabel))
                .When(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.LprIp));

            gate.RuleFor(x => x.PcIp)
                .Must(IsValidIp)
                .WithMessage(string.Format(
                    ErrorMessage.Gate_PcIp_Invalid_ForGateType,
                    gateLabel))
                .When(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.PcIp));

            gate.When(x => x.ONVIFCameraSetting is not null, () =>
            {
                gate.RuleFor(x => x.ONVIFCameraSetting!.UrlRequest)
                    .Must(value => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Gate_ONVIF_UrlRequest_Required);

                gate.RuleFor(x => x.ONVIFCameraSetting!.UserName)
                    .Must(value => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Gate_ONVIF_UserName_Required);

                gate.RuleFor(x => x.ONVIFCameraSetting!.Password)
                    .Must(value => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Gate_ONVIF_Password_Required);
            });

            gate.When(x => x.HasQrPrinterName, () =>
            {
                gate.RuleFor(x => x.QrPrinterName)
                    .Must(value => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Gate_QrPrinterName_RequiredWhenHasQrPrinterName);
            });

            gate.RuleFor(x => x.QrPrinterName)
                .MaximumLength(PrinterNameMaxLength)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Gate_QrPrinterName_MaxLength)
                .When(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.QrPrinterName));

            gate.When(x => x.HasReceiptPrinterName, () =>
            {
                gate.RuleFor(x => x.ReceiptPrinterName)
                    .Must(value => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Gate_ReceiptPrinterName_RequiredWhenHasReceiptPrinterName);
            });

            gate.RuleFor(x => x.ReceiptPrinterName)
                .MaximumLength(PrinterNameMaxLength)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Gate_ReceiptPrinterName_MaxLength)
                .When(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.ReceiptPrinterName));
        }

        private static bool HaveUniqueLprIps(UpdateParkingConfigurationCommand command)
        {
            var allIps = command.EntryGates
                .Select(g => g.LprIp?.Trim())
                .Concat(command.ExitGates.Select(g => g.LprIp?.Trim()))
                .Where(ip => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ip))
                .ToList();

            return allIps.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Count() == allIps.Count;
        }

        private static bool HaveUniqueControlIps(UpdateParkingConfigurationCommand command)
        {
            var allIps = command.EntryGates
                .Select(g => g.ControlIp?.Trim())
                .Concat(command.ExitGates.Select(g => g.ControlIp?.Trim()))
                .Where(ip => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ip))
                .ToList();

            return allIps.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Count() == allIps.Count;
        }

        private static bool IsValidIp(string? ip)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ip))
            {
                return false;
            }

            return IPAddress.TryParse(ip.Trim(), out _);
        }
    }
}

        public TimeSpan? EndTime { get; init; }

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\PricingSchemaManagement\Command\Add\AddPricingSchemaCommandHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.PricingSchemaManagement.Command.Add
{
    public sealed class AddPricingSchemaCommandHandler
      : ICommandHandler<AddPricingSchemaCommand>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> _repository;
        private readonly ILogger<AddPricingSchemaCommandHandler> _logger;

        public AddPricingSchemaCommandHandler(
            IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> repository,
            ILogger<AddPricingSchemaCommandHandler> logger)
        {
            _repository = repository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(repository));
            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
        }

        public async Task<Result> Handle(
            AddPricingSchemaCommand request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            try
            {
                // 1) Build PricingScheme entity based on request
                var pricingScheme = BuildPricingScheme(request);

                // 2) Persist
                await _repository.AddAsync(pricingScheme, cancellationToken);
                await _repository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Pricing scheme '{Name}' added successfully at {DateTimeUtc}.",
                    pricingScheme.Name,
                    DateTime.UtcNow);

                return Result.Ok();
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("AddPricingSchema operation was canceled.");
                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex,
                    "Unexpected error while adding pricing scheme. Name: {Name}, DurationType: {DurationType}, IsRepeated: {IsRepeated}.",
                    request.Name,
                    request.DurationType,
                    request.IsRepeated);

                return Result.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "PricingScheme.Add.Unexpected",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.PricingSchemeAddUnexpected,
                        Type: ErrorType.Infrastructure));
            }
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------
        // Helper: centralize creation logic
        // ---------------------------------------------
        private static PricingScheme BuildPricingScheme(AddPricingSchemaCommand request)
        {
            // لو الخطة مكررة (IsRepeated = true):
            // - نستخدم DurationType.Hours
            // - نشتغل بـ TotalHours فقط
            if (request.IsRepeated)
            {
                return PricingScheme.Create(
                    name: request.Name,
                    durationType: DurationType.Hours,
                    startTime: null,
                    endTime: null,
                    isRepeated: true,
                    salary: request.Price,
                    totalDays: null,
                    totalHours: request.TotalHours);
            }

            // لو مش مكررة: نمشي على نوع المدة
            return request.DurationType switch
            {
                DurationType.Hours => CreateHourlyScheme(request),
                DurationType.Days => CreateDailyScheme(request),
                DurationType.Years => CreateYearlyScheme(request),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
                    nameof(request.DurationType),
                    request.DurationType,
                    "Unsupported duration type for pricing scheme.")
            };
        }

        private static PricingScheme CreateHourlyScheme(AddPricingSchemaCommand request)
        {
            return PricingScheme.Create(
                name: request.Name,
                durationType: DurationType.Hours,
                startTime: request.StartTime,
                endTime: request.EndTime,
                isRepeated: false,
                salary: request.Price,
                totalDays: null,
                totalHours: request.TotalHours);
        }

        private static PricingScheme CreateDailyScheme(AddPricingSchemaCommand request)
        {
            return PricingScheme.Create(
                name: request.Name,
                durationType: DurationType.Days,
                startTime: request.StartTime,
                endTime: request.EndTime,
                isRepeated: false,
                salary: request.Price,
                totalDays: request.TotalDays,
                totalHours: null);
        }

        private static PricingScheme CreateYearlyScheme(AddPricingSchemaCommand request)
        {
            var totalDays = 365;

            return PricingScheme.Create(
                name: request.Name,
                durationType: DurationType.Years,
                startTime: request.StartTime,
                endTime: request.EndTime,
                isRepeated: false,
                salary: request.Price,
                totalDays: totalDays,
                totalHours: null);
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\PricingSchemaManagement\Command\Add\AddPricingSchemaCommandValidation.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using FluentValidation;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.PricingSchemaManagement.Command.Add
{
    public class AddPricingSchemaCommandValidation : AbstractValidator<AddPricingSchemaCommand>
    {
        private IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> _repository;

        public AddPricingSchemaCommandValidation(IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> repository)
        {
            _repository = repository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(repository));

            RuleFor(x => x.Name)
                .MustAsync(async (name, token) =>
                    !await _repository.IsExistAsync(p => p.Name == name, token))
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.PricingSchemaNameExist);
            RuleFor(x => x.DurationType).IsInEnum().WithMessage(ErrorMessage.IsRequired);
            RuleFor(x => x.StartTime).NotEmpty().WithMessage(ErrorMessage.IsRequired).When(x => !x.IsRepeated);
            RuleFor(x => x.EndTime).NotEmpty().WithMessage(ErrorMessage.IsRequired).When(x => !x.IsRepeated);
            RuleFor(x => x.Price).GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0).WithMessage(ErrorMessage.InvalidPrice);
            RuleFor(x => x.IsRepeated).NotNull().WithMessage(ErrorMessage.IsRequired);

            // Ensure EndTime is not before StartTime
            RuleFor(x => x.EndTime)
                .GreaterThan(x => x.StartTime)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_EndTime)
                .When(x => !x.IsRepeated);

            // Ensure IsRepeated is not true when DurationType is Days
            RuleFor(x => x.IsRepeated)
                .Must((command, isRepeated) => !(isRepeated && command.DurationType == DurationType.Days))
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Conflict_IsRepeated);

            // Ensure TotalDays is required and greater than zero when DurationType is Days
            RuleFor(x => x.TotalDays)
                .NotEmpty().When(x => x.DurationType == DurationType.Days)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.TotalDay_Require)
                .GreaterThan(0).When(x => x.DurationType == DurationType.Days)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_TotalDays);
            // Ensure TotalHours is required and greater than zero when DurationType is Hours
            RuleFor(x => x.TotalHours)
    .NotEmpty().When(x => x.DurationType == DurationType.Hours)
    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.TotalHour_Require)
    .GreaterThan(0).When(x => x.DurationType == DurationType.Hours)
    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_TotalHour);
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\PricingSchemaManagement\Command\AddOrderSchema\AddOrderSchemaCommandHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.PricingSchemaManagement.Command.AddOrderSchema
{
    public sealed class AddOrderSchemaCommandHandler : ICommandHandler<AddOrderSchemaCommand>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<OrderPricingSchema> _orderPricingSchemaRepository;

        public AddOrderSchemaCommandHandler(IGenericRepository<OrderPricingSchema> orderPricingSchemaRepository)
        {
            _orderPricingSchemaRepository = orderPricingSchemaRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(orderPricingSchemaRepository));
        }

        public async Task<Result> Handle(AddOrderSchemaCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var entities = _orderPricingSchemaRepository.GetAll().ToList();
            if (entities is not null || entities?.Count > 0)
            {
                _orderPricingSchemaRepository.DeleteRange(entities);
                await _orderPricingSchemaRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
            }

            var orderList = request.OrderSchema.OrderBy(x => x.Count).ToList();
            var list = new List<OrderPricingSchema>();

            for (int i = 1; i <= orderList.Count; i++)
            {
                list.Add(OrderPricingSchema.Create(orderList[i - 1].PricingSchemaId, i));
            }

            await _orderPricingSchemaRepository.AddRangeAsync(list, cancellationToken);
            await _orderPricingSchemaRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
            return Result.Ok();
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\PricingSchemaManagement\Command\AddOrderSchema\AddOrderSchemaCommandValidation.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using FluentValidation;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.PricingSchemaManagement.Command.AddOrderSchema
{
    public sealed class AddOrderSchemaCommandValidation : AbstractValidator<AddOrderSchemaCommand>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> _pricingSchemaRepository;

        public AddOrderSchemaCommandValidation(IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> pricingSchemaRepository)
        {
            _pricingSchemaRepository = pricingSchemaRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(pricingSchemaRepository));

            RuleFor(x => x.OrderSchema)
            .NotNull()
            .NotEmpty()
            .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.IsRequired);

            RuleForEach(x => x.OrderSchema).ChildRules(order =>
            {
                order.RuleFor(o => o.PricingSchemaId)
                    .NotEmpty()
                    .MustAsync(async (id, token) =>
                    await _pricingSchemaRepository.IsExistAsync(x => x.Id == id, token))
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.PricingSchemeId)
                   .MustAsync(async (id, token) => await _pricingSchemaRepository.IsExistAsync(x => x.IsRepeated == true, token))
                   .WithMessage("Must be Repeated Entity");

                order.RuleFor(o => o.Count)
                    .GreaterThan(0)
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.IsRequired);
            });
            RuleFor(x => x.OrderSchema)
    .Custom((list, ctx) =>
            {
                if (list is null || list.Count == 0)
                    return;

                var hasDuplicates = list
                    .GroupBy(x => x.Count)
                    .Any(g => g.Count() > 1);

                if (hasDuplicates)
                {
                    ctx.AddFailure(
                        "OrderSchema",
                        "القيم داخل Count لا يجب أن تتكرر / Count values in the list must be unique."
                    );
                }
            });
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\PricingSchemaManagement\Command\CreateEnterPriceSchema\CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommandHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.PricingSchemaManagement.Command.CreateEnterPriceSchema
{
    internal sealed class CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommandHandler
       : ICommandHandler<CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommand, CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommandResponse>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> _pricingSchemeRepository;
        private readonly ILogger<CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommandHandler> _logger;

        public CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommandHandler(
            IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> pricingSchemeRepository,
            ILogger<CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommandHandler> logger)
        {
            _pricingSchemeRepository = pricingSchemeRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(pricingSchemeRepository));

            _logger = logger
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
        }

        public async Task<Result<CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommandResponse>> Handle(
            CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommand request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            try
            {
                var name = request.Name.Trim();

                var duplicateSpec = new EnterPriceSchemaByNameSpec(name);

                var existingSchema = await _pricingSchemeRepository
                    .FirstOrDefaultWithSpecAsync(duplicateSpec, cancellationToken);

                if (existingSchema is not null)
                {
                    return Result<CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "EnterPriceSchema.Name.AlreadyExists",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.EnterPriceSchema_Name_AlreadyExists,
                            Type: ErrorType.Conflict));
                }

                var entity = PricingScheme.CreateEnterPriceSchema(
                    name: name,
                    salary: request.Salary);

                await _pricingSchemeRepository.AddAsync(entity, cancellationToken);
                await _pricingSchemeRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

                var response = new CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommandResponse
                {
                    Id = entity.Id,
                    Name = entity.Name,
                    Salary = entity.Salary,
                    IsEnterPriceSchema = entity.IsEnterPriceSchema
                };

                return Result<CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommandResponse>.Ok(response);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateEnterPriceSchema operation was canceled.");
                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error while creating enter price schema.");

                return Result<CreateEnterPriceSchemaCommandResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "EnterPriceSchema.Create.Unexpected",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.EnterPriceSchema_Create_Unexpected,
                        Type: ErrorType.Infrastructure));
            }
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\PricingSchemaManagement\Command\Delete\DeletePricingSchemaCommandHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.PricingSchemaManagement.Command.Delete
{
    public sealed class DeletePricingSchemaCommandHandler : ICommandHandler<DeletePricingSchemaCommand>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> _pricingRepo;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<OrderPricingSchema> _orderSchemaRepo;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<ParkingMemberships> _membershipRepo;

        public DeletePricingSchemaCommandHandler(
            IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> pricingRepo,
            IGenericRepository<OrderPricingSchema> orderSchemaRepo,
            IGenericRepository<ParkingMemberships> membershipRepo)
        {
            _pricingRepo = pricingRepo ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(pricingRepo));
            _orderSchemaRepo = orderSchemaRepo ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(orderSchemaRepo));
            _membershipRepo = membershipRepo ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(membershipRepo));
        }

        public async Task<Result> Handle(DeletePricingSchemaCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // 1) Load entity (guard in handler)
            var entity = await _pricingRepo.GetByIdAsync(request.Id, cancellationToken);
            if (entity is null)
            {
                return Result.Fail(new Error(
                    Code: "PricingScheme.NotFound",
                    Message: ErrorMessage.PricingSchema_NotFound,
                    Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
            }

            // 2) Prevent delete if referenced (separate messages per source)
            var referencedByOrdersTask = await _orderSchemaRepo.IsExistAsync(
                x => x.PricingSchemaId == request.Id,
                cancellationToken);

            var referencedByMembershipsTask = await _membershipRepo.IsExistAsync(
                x => x.PricingSchemeId == request.Id,
                cancellationToken);

            if (referencedByOrdersTask)
            {
                return Result.Fail(new Error(
                    Code: "PricingScheme.Delete.ReferencedByOrders",
                    Message: ErrorMessage.PricingScheme_Delete_ReferencedByOrders,
                    Type: ErrorType.Conflict));
            }

            if (referencedByMembershipsTask)
            {
                return Result.Fail(new Error(
                    Code: "PricingScheme.Delete.ReferencedByMemberships",
                    Message: ErrorMessage.PricingScheme_Delete_ReferencedByMemberships,
                    Type: ErrorType.Conflict));
            }

            // 3) Delete
            _pricingRepo.Delete(entity);

            // 4) Safety net (race condition / FK constraint)
            try
            {
                await _pricingRepo.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
                return Result.Ok();
            }
            catch (DbUpdateException ex) when (ex.InnerException is SqlException { Number: 547 })
            {
                return Result.Fail(new Error(
                    Code: "PricingScheme.Delete.ForeignKeyConflict",
                    Message: ErrorMessage.PricingScheme_Delete_ForeignKeyConflict,
                    Type: ErrorType.Conflict));
            }
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\PricingSchemaManagement\Command\Update\UpdatePricingSchemaCommandHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.PricingSchemaManagement.Command.Update
{
    public sealed class UpdatePricingSchemaCommandHandler : ICommandHandler<UpdatePricingSchemaCommand>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> _repository;
        private readonly ILogger<UpdatePricingSchemaCommandHandler> _logger;

        public UpdatePricingSchemaCommandHandler(
            IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> repository,
            ILogger<UpdatePricingSchemaCommandHandler> logger)
        {
            _repository = repository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(repository));
            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
        }

        public async Task<Result> Handle(
            UpdatePricingSchemaCommand request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            var entity = await _repository.GetByIdAsync(request.Id, cancellationToken);

            if (entity is null)
            {
                return Result.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "PricingScheme.NotFound",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.NotFound,
                        Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
            }

            /*
             * EnterPriceSchema update:
             * لو الريكويست داخل كـ EnterPriceSchema
             * أو الـ entity نفسها أصلًا EnterPriceSchema
             * يبقى نثبت كل القيم حسب business rule بتاع سعر الدخول.
             */
            if (request.IsEnterPriceSchema || entity.IsEnterPriceSchema)
            {
                entity.UpdateEnterPriceSchema(
                    name: request.Name,
                    salary: request.Price);

                await _repository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Updated enter price schema. PricingSchemeId={PricingSchemeId}, DateTime={DateTime}",
                    entity.Id,
                    DateTime.UtcNow);

                return Result.Ok();
            }

            if (request.IsRepeated)
            {
                entity.Update(
                    name: request.Name,
                    durationType: DurationType.Hours,
                    startTime: null,
                    endTime: null,
                    isRepeated: true,
                    salary: request.Price,
                    totalDays: null,
                    totalHours: request.TotalHours);

                await _repository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Updated repeated pricing scheme. PricingSchemeId={PricingSchemeId}, DateTime={DateTime}",
                    entity.Id,
                    DateTime.UtcNow);

                return Result.Ok();
            }

            if (request.DurationType == DurationType.Hours)
            {
                entity.Update(
                    name: request.Name,
                    durationType: request.DurationType,
                    startTime: request.StartTime,
                    endTime: request.EndTime,
                    isRepeated: false,
                    salary: request.Price,
                    totalDays: null,
                    totalHours: request.TotalHours);

                await _repository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Updated pricing scheme by hours. PricingSchemeId={PricingSchemeId}, DateTime={DateTime}",
                    entity.Id,
                    DateTime.UtcNow);

                return Result.Ok();
            }

            if (request.DurationType == DurationType.Days)
            {
                entity.Update(
                    name: request.Name,
                    durationType: request.DurationType,
                    startTime: request.StartTime,
                    endTime: request.EndTime,
                    isRepeated: false,
                    salary: request.Price,
                    totalDays: request.TotalDays,
                    totalHours: null);

                await _repository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Updated pricing scheme by days. PricingSchemeId={PricingSchemeId}, DateTime={DateTime}",
                    entity.Id,
                    DateTime.UtcNow);

                return Result.Ok();
            }

            entity.Update(
                name: request.Name,
                durationType: request.DurationType,
                startTime: request.StartTime,
                endTime: request.EndTime,
                isRepeated: false,
                salary: request.Price,
                totalDays: 365,
                totalHours: null);

            await _repository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Updated yearly pricing scheme. PricingSchemeId={PricingSchemeId}, DateTime={DateTime}",
                entity.Id,
                DateTime.UtcNow);

            return Result.Ok();
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\PricingSchemaManagement\Command\Update\UpdatePricingSchemaCommandValidator.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using FluentValidation;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.PricingSchemaManagement.Command.Update
{
    public class UpdatePricingSchemaCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<UpdatePricingSchemaCommand>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> _repository;

        public UpdatePricingSchemaCommandValidator(IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> repository)
        {
            _repository = repository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(repository));

            RuleFor(x => x.Id)
                .NotEmpty()
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.PricingSchemeId)
                .MustAsync(async (id, cancellationToken) =>
                    await _repository.IsExistAsync(x => x.Id == id, cancellationToken))
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.NotFound);

            RuleFor(x => x.Name)
                .NotEmpty()
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.IsRequired);

            /*
             * Enter Price Schema Validation
             * هنا ممنوع نطلب DurationType / StartTime / EndTime
             * لأنهم بيتظبطوا جوه الـ Entity Method.
             */
            When(x => x.IsEnterPriceSchema, () =>
            {
                RuleFor(x => x.Price)
                    .GreaterThan(0)
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.InvalidPrice);
            });

            /*
             * Normal Pricing Schema Validation
             */
            When(x => !x.IsEnterPriceSchema, () =>
            {
                RuleFor(x => x.DurationType)
                    .IsInEnum()
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.IsRequired);

                RuleFor(x => x.StartTime)
                    .NotEmpty()
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.IsRequired)
                    .When(x => !x.IsRepeated);

                RuleFor(x => x.EndTime)
                    .NotEmpty()
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.IsRequired)
                    .When(x => !x.IsRepeated);

                RuleFor(x => x.Price)
                    .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0)
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.InvalidPrice);

                RuleFor(x => x.EndTime)
                    .GreaterThan(x => x.StartTime)
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_EndTime)
                    .When(x => !x.IsRepeated && x.StartTime.HasValue && x.EndTime.HasValue);

                RuleFor(x => x.IsRepeated)
                    .Must((command, isRepeated) =>
                        !(isRepeated && command.DurationType == DurationType.Days))
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Conflict_IsRepeated);

                RuleFor(x => x.TotalDays)
                    .NotEmpty()
                    .When(x => x.DurationType == DurationType.Days)
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.TotalDay_Require)
                    .GreaterThan(0)
                    .When(x => x.DurationType == DurationType.Days)
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_TotalDays);

                RuleFor(x => x.TotalHours)
                    .NotEmpty()
                    .When(x => x.DurationType == DurationType.Hours)
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.TotalHour_Require)
                    .GreaterThan(0)
                    .When(x => x.DurationType == DurationType.Hours)
                    .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.Invalid_TotalHour);
            });
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\Reports\Query\GetEntranceCashierTicketsReport\GetEntranceCashierInsideTicketsSpec.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.Specification;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.FileNames;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.Reports.Query.GetEntranceCashierTicketsReport
{
    internal sealed class GetEntranceCashierInsideTicketsSpec
        : Specification<Ticket, EntranceCashierInsideTicketResponse>
    {
        public GetEntranceCashierInsideTicketsSpec(
            Guid userId,
            DateTime fromDate,
            DateTime toDateExclusive)
        {
            AddCriteria(x =>
                x.UserId == userId &&
                x.StartDate >= fromDate &&
                x.StartDate < toDateExclusive);

            Select(x => new EntranceCashierInsideTicketResponse
            {
                TicketId = x.Id,
                UniqueCode = x.UniqueCode,

                StartDate = x.StartDate,

                Price = x.Price,
                ExceedPrice = x.ExceedPrice,
                TotalPrice = x.Price + x.ExceedPrice,

                VehicleNumber = x.VehicleNumber,

                IsSubscriber = x.IsSubscriber,
                SubscriberNationalId = x.SubscriberNationalId,
                CardNumber = x.CardNumber,

                GateId = x.GateId,
                GateNumber = x.ParkingGate.GateNumber,
                Attachments = x.TicketAttachments
                    .Select(a => new TicketAttachmentResponse
                    {
                        AttachmentId = a.Id,
                        FilePath = "Media" + "/" + FileNames.TicketAttachments + "/" + a.FilePath
                    })
                    .ToList()
            });
        }
    }
}

﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.Reports.Query.GetEntranceCashierTicketsReport
{
    public sealed record GetEntranceCashierTicketsReportQuery
       : IQuery<EntranceCashierTicketsReportResponse>
    {
        public Guid UserId { get; init; }
        public DateTime From { get; init; }
        public DateTime To { get; init; }
    }

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\Reports\Query\GetEntranceCashierTicketsReport\GetEntranceCashierTicketsReportQueryHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.FileNames;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.Reports.Query.GetEntranceCashierTicketsReport
{
    internal sealed class GetEntranceCashierTicketsReportQueryHandler
        : IQueryHandler<GetEntranceCashierTicketsReportQuery, EntranceCashierTicketsReportResponse>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<User> _userRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<Ticket> _ticketRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<TicketArchive> _ticketArchiveRepository;

        public GetEntranceCashierTicketsReportQueryHandler(
            IGenericRepository<User> userRepository,
            IGenericRepository<Ticket> ticketRepository,
            IGenericRepository<TicketArchive> ticketArchiveRepository)
        {
            _userRepository = userRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(userRepository));
            _ticketRepository = ticketRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticketRepository));
            _ticketArchiveRepository = ticketArchiveRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticketArchiveRepository));
        }

        public async Task<Result<EntranceCashierTicketsReportResponse>> Handle(
            GetEntranceCashierTicketsReportQuery request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            var cashier = await _userRepository.FirstOrDefaultWithSpecAsync(
                new GetEntranceCashierInfoSpec(request.UserId),
                cancellationToken);

            if (cashier is null)
            {
                return Result<EntranceCashierTicketsReportResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "EntranceCashierReport.UserNotFound",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.User_NotFound,
                        Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
            }

            if (cashier.RoleId != AppRoleIds.EntranceCashier)
            {
                return Result<EntranceCashierTicketsReportResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "EntranceCashierReport.UserMustBeEntranceCashier",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.User_MustBeEntranceCashier,
                        Type: ErrorType.Validation));
            }

            var fromDate = request.From.Date;
            var toDate = request.To.Date;
            var toDateExclusive = toDate.AddDays(1);

            var insideTickets = await _ticketRepository.ListWithSpecAsync(
                new GetEntranceCashierInsideTicketsSpec(
                    request.UserId,
                    fromDate,
                    toDateExclusive),
                cancellationToken);

            var outsideTickets = await _ticketArchiveRepository.ListWithSpecAsync(
                new GetEntranceCashierOutsideTicketsSpec(
                    request.UserId,
                    fromDate,
                    toDateExclusive),
                cancellationToken);

            var insideTicketsList = insideTickets?.ToList()
                ?? new List<EntranceCashierInsideTicketResponse>();

            var outsideTicketsList = outsideTickets?.ToList()
                ?? new List<EntranceCashierOutsideTicketResponse>();

            var insideParkTicketsCount = insideTicketsList.Count;
            var outsideParkTicketsCount = outsideTicketsList.Count;

            var insideParkTotalBasePrice = insideTicketsList.Sum(x => x.Price);
            var outsideParkTotalBasePrice = outsideTicketsList.Sum(x => x.Price);

            var insideParkTotalExceedPrice = insideTicketsList.Sum(x => x.ExceedPrice);
            var outsideParkTotalExceedPrice = outsideTicketsList.Sum(x => x.ExceedPrice);

            var insideParkTotalAmount = insideTicketsList.Sum(x => x.TotalPrice);
            var outsideParkTotalAmount = outsideTicketsList.Sum(x => x.TotalPrice);

            var insideParkExceededTicketsCount = insideTicketsList.Count(x => x.ExceedPrice > 0);
            var outsideParkExceededTicketsCount = outsideTicketsList.Count(x => x.ExceedPrice > 0);

            var response = new EntranceCashierTicketsReportResponse
            {
                UserId = cashier.UserId,
                CashierName = cashier.CashierName,
                Username = cashier.Username,

                RoleId = cashier.RoleId,
                RoleNameEn = cashier.RoleNameEn,
                RoleNameAr = cashier.RoleNameAr,

                From = fromDate,
                To = toDate,

                Summary = new EntranceCashierTicketsReportSummaryResponse
                {
                    TotalEnteredTicketsCount = insideParkTicketsCount + outsideParkTicketsCount,

                    InsideParkTicketsCount = insideParkTicketsCount,
                    OutsideParkTicketsCount = outsideParkTicketsCount,

                    InsideParkTotalBasePrice = insideParkTotalBasePrice,
                    OutsideParkTotalBasePrice = outsideParkTotalBasePrice,
                    TotalBasePrice = insideParkTotalBasePrice + outsideParkTotalBasePrice,

                    InsideParkTotalExceedPrice = insideParkTotalExceedPrice,
                    OutsideParkTotalExceedPrice = outsideParkTotalExceedPrice,
                    TotalExceedPrice = insideParkTotalExceedPrice + outsideParkTotalExceedPrice,

                    InsideParkTotalAmount = insideParkTotalAmount,
                    OutsideParkTotalAmount = outsideParkTotalAmount,
                    TotalAmount = insideParkTotalAmount + outsideParkTotalAmount,

                    InsideParkExceededTicketsCount = insideParkExceededTicketsCount,
                    OutsideParkExceededTicketsCount = outsideParkExceededTicketsCount,
                    TotalExceededTicketsCount = insideParkExceededTicketsCount + outsideParkExceededTicketsCount
                },

                InsideParkTickets = insideTicketsList,
                OutsideParkTickets = outsideTicketsList
            };

            return Result<EntranceCashierTicketsReportResponse>.Ok(response);
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\Reports\Query\GetEntranceCashierTicketsReport\GetEntranceCashierTicketsReportQueryValidator.cs ==================== 
﻿using FluentValidation;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.Reports.Query.GetEntranceCashierTicketsReport
{
    internal sealed class GetEntranceCashierTicketsReportQueryValidator
       : AbstractValidator<GetEntranceCashierTicketsReportQuery>
    {
        public GetEntranceCashierTicketsReportQueryValidator()
        {
            RuleFor(x => x.UserId)
                .NotEmpty()
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.UserId_Required);

            RuleFor(x => x.From)
                .NotEmpty()
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.FromDate_Required);

            RuleFor(x => x.To)
                .NotEmpty()
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.ToDate_Required);

            RuleFor(x => x)
                .Must(x => x.To.Date >= x.From.Date)
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.ToDate_MustBeGreaterThanOrEqualFromDate);
        }
    }
}

    }
