// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\Reports\Query\GetSupervisorCollectionReport\GetSupervisorCollectionReportQueryHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;
using NPark.Domain.FileNames;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.Reports.Query.GetSupervisorCollectionReport
{
    internal sealed class GetSupervisorCollectionReportQueryHandler
        : IQueryHandler<GetSupervisorCollectionReportQuery, SupervisorCollectionReportResponse>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<TicketCollectionTransaction> _collectionTransactionRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<User> _userRepository;
        private readonly ILogger<GetSupervisorCollectionReportQueryHandler> _logger;

        public GetSupervisorCollectionReportQueryHandler(
            IGenericRepository<TicketCollectionTransaction> collectionTransactionRepository,
            IGenericRepository<User> userRepository,
            ILogger<GetSupervisorCollectionReportQueryHandler> logger)
        {
            _collectionTransactionRepository = collectionTransactionRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(collectionTransactionRepository));

            _userRepository = userRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(userRepository));

            _logger = logger
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
        }

        public async Task<Result<SupervisorCollectionReportResponse>> Handle(
            GetSupervisorCollectionReportQuery request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            try
            {
                var fromDate = request.FromDate.Date;
                var toDate = request.ToDate.Date;

                if (toDate < fromDate)
                {
                    return Result<SupervisorCollectionReportResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Report.InvalidDateRange",
                            Message: "To date must be greater than or equal from date.",
                            Type: ErrorType.Validation));
                }

                var supervisor = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(
                    request.SupervisorId,
                    cancellationToken);

                if (supervisor is null)
                {
                    return Result<SupervisorCollectionReportResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "User.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.User_NotFound,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                if (supervisor.RoleId != SystemRoles.SupervisorRoleId)
                {
                    return Result<SupervisorCollectionReportResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "User.NotSupervisor",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.Supervisor_OnlyCanCollectTicketExceedTransactions,
                            Type: ErrorType.Security));
                }

                var spec = new SupervisorCollectionTransactionsReportSpec(
                    supervisorId: request.SupervisorId,
                    fromDate: fromDate,
                    toDate: toDate);

                var transactionsResult = await _collectionTransactionRepository
                    .ListWithSpecAsync(spec, cancellationToken);

                var transactions = transactionsResult?
                    .OrderByDescending(x => x.CollectedAt)
                    .ToList()
                    ?? new List<TicketCollectionTransaction>();

                var responsibleUserIds = transactions
                    .SelectMany(x => x.Lines.Select(line => line.ResponsibleUserId))
                    .Concat(transactions.SelectMany(x => x.Tickets.Select(ticket => ticket.ResponsibleUserId)))
                    .Concat(transactions.Select(x => x.CollectedBy))
                    .Append(request.SupervisorId)
                    .Where(id => id != Guid.Empty)
                    .Distinct()
                    .ToArray();

                var users = responsibleUserIds.Length == 0
                    ? new List<User>()
                    : (await _userRepository.ListWithSpecAsync(
                        new UsersByIdsSpec(responsibleUserIds),
                        cancellationToken))?.ToList() ?? new List<User>();

                var userNames = users
                    .GroupBy(x => x.Id)
                    .ToDictionary(
                        g => g.Key,
                        g => g.Select(x => x.Name)
                              .FirstOrDefault(name => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) ?? string.Empty);

                var supervisorName = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(supervisor.Name)
                    ? supervisor.Name
                    : GetUserName(userNames, request.SupervisorId);

                var transactionItems = transactions
                    .Select(transaction => new SupervisorCollectionTransactionReportItem
                    {
                        TransactionId = transaction.Id,
                        TransactionTypeId = (int)transaction.Type,
                        TransactionType = transaction.Type.ToString(),

                        GateId = transaction.GateId,
                        GateName = transaction.Gate is not null
                            ? transaction.Gate.GateNumber.ToString()
                            : string.Empty,

                        CollectedBy = transaction.CollectedBy,
                        CollectedByName = GetUserName(userNames, transaction.CollectedBy),

                        CollectedAt = transaction.CollectedAt,
                        TotalItemsCollected = transaction.TotalItemsCollected,
                        TotalAmountCollected = transaction.TotalAmountCollected,

                        Lines = transaction.Lines
                            .Select(line => new SupervisorCollectionLineReportItem
                            {
                                ResponsibleUserId = line.ResponsibleUserId,
                                ResponsibleUserName = GetUserName(userNames, line.ResponsibleUserId),
                                ItemsCount = line.ItemsCount,
                                TotalAmount = line.TotalAmount
                            })
                            .OrderByDescending(line => line.TotalAmount)
                            .ToList(),

                        Tickets = transaction.Tickets
                            .Select(ticket => new SupervisorCollectionTicketReportItem
                            {
                                ItemId = ticket.Id,
                                ResponsibleUserId = ticket.ResponsibleUserId,
                                ResponsibleUserName = GetUserName(userNames, ticket.ResponsibleUserId),
                                Source = ticket.Source.ToString(),
                                TicketIdSnapshot = ticket.TicketIdSnapshot,
                                TicketUniqueCode = ticket.TicketUniqueCode,
                                TicketStartDate = ticket.TicketStartDate,
                                TicketEndDate = ticket.TicketEndDate,
                                OriginalPrice = ticket.OriginalPrice,
                                ExceedAmount = ticket.ExceedAmount,
                                AmountCollected = ticket.AmountCollected,
                                VehicleNumber = ticket.VehicleNumber,
                                CardNumber = ticket.CardNumber,
                                IsSubscriber = ticket.IsSubscriber,
                                SubscriberNationalId = ticket.SubscriberNationalId,
                                TicketGateId = ticket.TicketGateId,
                                TicketExitGateId = ticket.TicketExitGateId
                            })
                            .OrderByDescending(ticket => ticket.TicketStartDate)
                            .ToList()
                    })
                    .ToList();

                var enterTransactions = transactions
                    .Where(x => x.Type == TicketCollectionTransactionType.EnterTickets)
                    .ToList();

                var exceedTransactions = transactions
                    .Where(x => x.Type == TicketCollectionTransactionType.ExceedTransactions)
                    .ToList();

                var response = new SupervisorCollectionReportResponse
                {
                    SupervisorId = request.SupervisorId,
                    SupervisorName = supervisorName,
                    FromDate = fromDate,
                    ToDate = toDate,

                    TotalCollectionTransactions = transactions.Count,
                    TotalItemsCollected = transactions.Sum(x => x.TotalItemsCollected),
                    TotalAmountCollected = transactions.Sum(x => x.TotalAmountCollected),

                    TotalEnterTicketsCollected = enterTransactions.Sum(x => x.TotalItemsCollected),
                    TotalEnterTicketsAmount = enterTransactions.Sum(x => x.TotalAmountCollected),

                    TotalExceedTransactionsCollected = exceedTransactions.Sum(x => x.TotalItemsCollected),
                    TotalExceedAmount = exceedTransactions.Sum(x => x.TotalAmountCollected),

                    Transactions = transactionItems
                };

                return Result<SupervisorCollectionReportResponse>.Ok(response);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "GetSupervisorCollectionReport operation was canceled. SupervisorId: {SupervisorId}",
                    request.SupervisorId);

                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Unexpected error while getting supervisor collection report. SupervisorId: {SupervisorId}",
                    request.SupervisorId);

                return Result<SupervisorCollectionReportResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "TicketCollectionReport.Supervisor.Unexpected",
                        Message: "An unexpected error occurred while getting supervisor collection report.",
                        Type: ErrorType.Infrastructure));
            }
        }

        private static string GetUserName(
            IReadOnlyDictionary<Guid, string> userNames,
            Guid userId)
        {
            return userNames.TryGetValue(userId, out var name)
                ? name
                : string.Empty;
        }
    }
}

﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.Specification;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.Reports.Query.GetSupervisorCollectionReport
{
    public sealed class SupervisorCollectionTransactionsReportSpec
       : Specification<TicketCollectionTransaction>
    {
        public SupervisorCollectionTransactionsReportSpec(
            Guid supervisorId,
            DateTime fromDate,
            DateTime toDate)
        {
            var from = fromDate.Date;
            var toExclusive = toDate.Date.AddDays(1);

            Include(x => x.Gate);
            Include(x => x.Collector);
            Include(x => x.Lines);
            Include(x => x.Tickets);

            AddCriteria(x =>
                x.CollectedBy == supervisorId &&
                x.CollectedAt >= from &&
                x.CollectedAt < toExclusive);

            AddOrderBy(x => x.CollectedAt);
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\Reports\Query\GetSupervisorCollectionsReport\GetSupervisorCollectionsReportQueryHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.FileNames;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.Reports.Query.GetSupervisorCollectionsReport
{
    internal sealed class GetSupervisorCollectionsReportQueryHandler
        : IQueryHandler<GetSupervisorCollectionsReportQuery, SupervisorCollectionsReportResponse>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<User> _userRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<Ticket> _ticketRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<TicketArchive> _ticketArchiveRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<TicketExceedTransaction> _ticketExceedTransactionRepository;

        public GetSupervisorCollectionsReportQueryHandler(
            IGenericRepository<User> userRepository,
            IGenericRepository<Ticket> ticketRepository,
            IGenericRepository<TicketArchive> ticketArchiveRepository,
            IGenericRepository<TicketExceedTransaction> ticketExceedTransactionRepository)
        {
            _userRepository = userRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(userRepository));
            _ticketRepository = ticketRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticketRepository));
            _ticketArchiveRepository = ticketArchiveRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticketArchiveRepository));
            _ticketExceedTransactionRepository = ticketExceedTransactionRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticketExceedTransactionRepository));
        }

        public async Task<Result<SupervisorCollectionsReportResponse>> Handle(
            GetSupervisorCollectionsReportQuery request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            var supervisor = await _userRepository.FirstOrDefaultWithSpecAsync(
                new GetSupervisorReportInfoSpec(request.SupervisorId),
                cancellationToken);

            if (supervisor is null)
            {
                return Result<SupervisorCollectionsReportResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "SupervisorCollectionsReport.SupervisorNotFound",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.Supervisor_NotFound,
                        Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
            }

            if (supervisor.RoleId != AppRoleIds.Supervisor)
            {
                return Result<SupervisorCollectionsReportResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "SupervisorCollectionsReport.UserMustBeSupervisor",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.User_MustBeSupervisor,
                        Type: ErrorType.Validation));
            }

            var fromDate = request.From.Date;
            var toDate = request.To.Date;
            var toDateExclusive = toDate.AddDays(1);

            var activeTicketCollections = await _ticketRepository.ListWithSpecAsync(
                new GetActiveTicketCollectionsSpec(fromDate, toDateExclusive),
                cancellationToken);

            var archivedTicketCollections = await _ticketArchiveRepository.ListWithSpecAsync(
                new GetArchivedTicketCollectionsSpec(fromDate, toDateExclusive),
                cancellationToken);

            var supervisorExceedCollections = await _ticketExceedTransactionRepository.ListWithSpecAsync(
                new GetSupervisorExceedCollectionsSpec(
                    request.SupervisorId,
                    fromDate,
                    toDateExclusive),
                cancellationToken);

            var pendingExceedCollections = await _ticketExceedTransactionRepository.ListWithSpecAsync(
                new GetPendingExceedCollectionsSpec(fromDate, toDateExclusive),
                cancellationToken);

            var activeTickets = activeTicketCollections?.ToList()
                ?? new List<ActiveTicketCollectionResponse>();

            var archivedTickets = archivedTicketCollections?.ToList()
                ?? new List<ArchivedTicketCollectionResponse>();

            var collectedExceeds = supervisorExceedCollections?.ToList()
                ?? new List<SupervisorExceedCollectionResponse>();

            var pendingExceeds = pendingExceedCollections?.ToList()
                ?? new List<PendingExceedCollectionResponse>();

            var activeTicketCollectionsAmount = activeTickets.Sum(x => x.CollectionAmount);
            var archivedTicketCollectionsAmount = archivedTickets.Sum(x => x.CollectionAmount);

            var ticketCollectionsAmount =
                activeTicketCollectionsAmount + archivedTicketCollectionsAmount;

            var supervisorExceedCollectionsAmount =
                collectedExceeds.Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount);

            var pendingExceedCollectionsAmount =
                pendingExceeds.Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount);

            var grandTotalCollectionsAmount =
                ticketCollectionsAmount + supervisorExceedCollectionsAmount;

            var collectorsSummary = BuildTicketCollectorsSummary(
                activeTickets,
                archivedTickets);

            var response = new SupervisorCollectionsReportResponse
            {
                Supervisor = supervisor,

                Period = new SupervisorCollectionsPeriodResponse
                {
                    From = fromDate,
                    To = toDate
                },

                Summary = new SupervisorCollectionsSummaryResponse
                {
                    TicketCollectionsCount = activeTickets.Count + archivedTickets.Count,

                    ActiveTicketCollectionsCount = activeTickets.Count,
                    ArchivedTicketCollectionsCount = archivedTickets.Count,

                    ActiveTicketCollectionsAmount = activeTicketCollectionsAmount,
                    ArchivedTicketCollectionsAmount = archivedTicketCollectionsAmount,
                    TicketCollectionsAmount = ticketCollectionsAmount,

                    SupervisorExceedCollectionsCount = collectedExceeds.Count,
                    SupervisorExceedCollectionsAmount = supervisorExceedCollectionsAmount,

                    PendingExceedCollectionsCount = pendingExceeds.Count,
                    PendingExceedCollectionsAmount = pendingExceedCollectionsAmount,

                    GrandTotalCollectionsAmount = grandTotalCollectionsAmount
                },

                TicketCollectorsSummary = collectorsSummary,

                ActiveTicketCollections = activeTickets,
                ArchivedTicketCollections = archivedTickets,

                SupervisorExceedCollections = collectedExceeds,
                PendingExceedCollections = pendingExceeds
            };

            return Result<SupervisorCollectionsReportResponse>.Ok(response);
        }

        private static IReadOnlyList<TicketCollectorSummaryResponse> BuildTicketCollectorsSummary(
            IReadOnlyCollection<ActiveTicketCollectionResponse> activeTickets,
            IReadOnlyCollection<ArchivedTicketCollectionResponse> archivedTickets)
        {
            var activeSummary = activeTickets
                .Where(x => x.CollectedBy.HasValue)
                .GroupBy(x => new
                {
                    CollectorId = x.CollectedBy!.Value,
                    CollectorName = x.CollectorName ?? string.Empty
                })
                .Select(x => new
                {
                    x.Key.CollectorId,
                    x.Key.CollectorName,
                    ActiveTicketsCount = x.Count(),
                    ArchivedTicketsCount = 0,
                    ActiveTicketsAmount = x.Sum(t => t.CollectionAmount),
                    ArchivedTicketsAmount = 0m
                });

            var archivedSummary = archivedTickets
                .Where(x => x.CollectedBy.HasValue)
                .GroupBy(x => new
                {
                    CollectorId = x.CollectedBy!.Value,
                    CollectorName = x.CollectorName ?? string.Empty
                })
                .Select(x => new
                {
                    x.Key.CollectorId,
                    x.Key.CollectorName,
                    ActiveTicketsCount = 0,
                    ArchivedTicketsCount = x.Count(),
                    ActiveTicketsAmount = 0m,
                    ArchivedTicketsAmount = x.Sum(t => t.CollectionAmount)
                });

            return activeSummary
                .Concat(archivedSummary)
                .GroupBy(x => new
                {
                    x.CollectorId,
                    x.CollectorName
                })
                .Select(x => new TicketCollectorSummaryResponse
                {
                    CollectorId = x.Key.CollectorId,
                    CollectorName = x.Key.CollectorName,

                    ActiveTicketsCount = x.Sum(t => t.ActiveTicketsCount),
                    ArchivedTicketsCount = x.Sum(t => t.ArchivedTicketsCount),
                    TotalTicketsCount = x.Sum(t => t.ActiveTicketsCount + t.ArchivedTicketsCount),

                    ActiveTicketsAmount = x.Sum(t => t.ActiveTicketsAmount),
                    ArchivedTicketsAmount = x.Sum(t => t.ArchivedTicketsAmount),
                    TotalAmount = x.Sum(t => t.ActiveTicketsAmount + t.ArchivedTicketsAmount)
                })
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.TotalAmount)
                .ToList();
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\Reports\Query\GetSupervisorCollectionsReport\GetSupervisorExceedCollectionsSpec.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.Specification;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.Reports.Query.GetSupervisorCollectionsReport
{
    internal sealed class GetSupervisorExceedCollectionsSpec
           : Specification<TicketExceedTransaction, SupervisorExceedCollectionResponse>
    {
        public GetSupervisorExceedCollectionsSpec(
            Guid supervisorId,
            DateTime fromDate,
            DateTime toDateExclusive)
        {
            AddCriteria(x =>
                x.SuperVisorCollectorId == supervisorId &&
                x.SuperVisorCollectedAt != null &&
                x.SuperVisorCollectedAt >= fromDate &&
                x.SuperVisorCollectedAt < toDateExclusive);

            Select(x => new SupervisorExceedCollectionResponse
            {
                TransactionId = x.Id,

                TicketIdSnapshot = x.TicketIdSnapshot,
                TicketUniqueCode = x.TicketUniqueCode,
                TicketStartDate = x.TicketStartDate,
                TicketEndDate = x.TicketEndDate,

                ExceedAmount = x.ExceedAmount,

                TicketPrice = x.TicketPrice,
                TicketOldExceedPrice = x.TicketOldExceedPrice,
                TotalPriceAfterExceed = x.TotalPriceAfterExceed,

                VehicleNumber = x.VehicleNumber,
                CardNumber = x.CardNumber,
                IsSubscriber = x.IsSubscriber,
                SubscriberNationalId = x.SubscriberNationalId,

                ExceedCreatedById = x.UserCollectId,
                ExceedCreatedByName = x.UserCollector.Name,

                SupervisorCollectorId = x.SuperVisorCollectorId!.Value,
                SupervisorCollectorName = x.SuperVisorCollector != null
                    ? x.SuperVisorCollector.Name

                TicketExitGateId = x.TicketExitGateId

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\TicketExceedTransactionsManagement\Command\CollectTicketExceedTransaction\CollectTicketExceedTransactionCommandHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Specification;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction.Security;
using NPark.Application.Shared.Dto;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;
using NPark.Domain.FileNames;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.TicketExceedTransactionsManagement.Command.CollectTicketExceedTransaction
{
    internal sealed class CollectTicketExceedTransactionCommandHandler
        : ICommandHandler<CollectTicketExceedTransactionCommand, CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<TicketExceedTransaction> _ticketExceedTransactionRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<TicketCollectionTransaction> _ticketCollectionTransactionRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<ParkingGate> _parkingGateRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<User> _userRepository;
        private readonly ITokenReader _tokenReader;
        private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
        private readonly IAuditLogger _auditLogger;
        private readonly ILogger<CollectTicketExceedTransactionCommandHandler> _logger;

        public CollectTicketExceedTransactionCommandHandler(
            IGenericRepository<TicketExceedTransaction> ticketExceedTransactionRepository,
            IGenericRepository<TicketCollectionTransaction> ticketCollectionTransactionRepository,
            IGenericRepository<ParkingGate> parkingGateRepository,
            IGenericRepository<User> userRepository,
            ITokenReader tokenReader,
            IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
            IAuditLogger auditLogger,
            ILogger<CollectTicketExceedTransactionCommandHandler> logger)
        {
            _ticketExceedTransactionRepository = ticketExceedTransactionRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticketExceedTransactionRepository));

            _ticketCollectionTransactionRepository = ticketCollectionTransactionRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticketCollectionTransactionRepository));

            _parkingGateRepository = parkingGateRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(parkingGateRepository));

            _userRepository = userRepository
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(userRepository));

            _tokenReader = tokenReader
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tokenReader));

            _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpContextAccessor));

            _auditLogger = auditLogger
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(auditLogger));

            _logger = logger
                ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
        }

        public async Task<Result<CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse>> Handle(
            CollectTicketExceedTransactionCommand request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            try
            {
                var tokenInfo = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.ReadToken(_tokenReader);

                if (tokenInfo is null || !tokenInfo.GateId.HasValue || !tokenInfo.UserId.HasValue)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Token info is missing GateId/UserId while collecting ticket exceed transactions.");

                    return Result<CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Token.GateOrUser.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.TokenInfo_Missing,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                var gateId = tokenInfo.GateId.Value;
                var supervisorId = tokenInfo.UserId.Value;
                if (!string.Equals(tokenInfo.Role, "Supervisor", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) )
                {
                    return Result<CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "User.NotSupervisor",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.Supervisor_OnlyCanCollectTicketExceedTransactions,
                            Type: ErrorType.Security));
                } 
                

                var gate = await _parkingGateRepository.GetByIdAsync(
                    gateId,
                    cancellationToken);

                if (gate is null)
                {
                    return Result<CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Gate.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.GateNotFound,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                var supervisor = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(
                    supervisorId,
                    cancellationToken);

                if (supervisor is null)
                {
                    return Result<CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "User.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.User_NotFound,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                if (supervisor.RoleId != SystemRoles.SupervisorRoleId)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "User {UserId} tried to collect ticket exceed transactions but is not supervisor.",
                        supervisorId);

                    return Result<CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "User.NotSupervisor",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.Supervisor_OnlyCanCollectTicketExceedTransactions,
                            Type: ErrorType.Security));
                }

                Specification<TicketExceedTransaction> spec =
                    new UncollectedTicketExceedTransactionsByGateSpec(gateId);

                var transactions = await _ticketExceedTransactionRepository
                    .ListWithSpecAsync(spec, cancellationToken);

                var transactionList = transactions?.ToList()
                    ?? new List<TicketExceedTransaction>();

                if (transactionList.Count == 0)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "No uncollected ticket exceed transactions found for gate {GateId}.",
                        gateId);

                    return Result<CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "TicketExceedTransactions.NoneToCollect",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.TicketExceedTransactions_NoneToCollect,
                            Type: ErrorType.Conflict));
                }

                var collectedAt = DateTime.Now;

                var collectionTransaction = TicketCollectionTransaction.Create(
                    type: TicketCollectionTransactionType.ExceedTransactions,
                    gateId: gateId,
                    collectedBy: supervisorId,
                    collectedAt: collectedAt);

                foreach (var transaction in transactionList)
                {
                    var ticketSnapshot = TicketCollectionTransactionTicket.CreateFromExceedTransaction(
                        transactionId: collectionTransaction.Id,
                        exceedTransaction: transaction);

                    collectionTransaction.AddTicket(ticketSnapshot);

                    transaction.SetSupervisorCollected(supervisorId, collectedAt);
                }

                collectionTransaction.BuildLinesFromTickets();

                var responsibleUserNames = transactionList
                    .Select(x => new
                    {
                        UserId = x.UserCollectId,
                        UserName = x.UserCollector?.Name ?? string.Empty
                    })
                    .GroupBy(x => x.UserId)
                    .ToDictionary(
                        g => g.Key,
                        g => g.Select(x => x.UserName)
                              .FirstOrDefault(name => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) ?? string.Empty);

                var response = new CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse
                {
                    CollectionTransactionId = collectionTransaction.Id,
                    GateId = gateId,
                    CollectedBy = supervisorId,
                    CollectedName = supervisor.Name,
                    CollectedAt = collectedAt,

                    TotalTransactionsCollected = transactionList.Count,
                    TotalExceedAmountCollected = transactionList.Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount),

                    Lines = collectionTransaction.Lines
                        .Select(x => new TicketExceedCollectLine
                        {
                            ResponsibleUserId = x.ResponsibleUserId,
                            ResponsibleUserName = responsibleUserNames.TryGetValue(
                                x.ResponsibleUserId,
                                out var responsibleUserName)
                                    ? responsibleUserName
                                    : string.Empty,
                            TransactionsCount = x.ItemsCount,
                            TotalExceedAmount = x.TotalAmount
                        })
                        .OrderByDescending(x => x.TotalExceedAmount)
                        .ToList(),

                    TicketExceedCollectDetails = transactionList
                        .Select(x => new TicketExceedCollectDetails
                        {
                            TransactionId = x.Id,
                            TicketIdSnapshot = x.TicketIdSnapshot,
                            TicketUniqueCode = x.TicketUniqueCode,
                            ResponsibleUserId = x.UserCollectId,
                            ResponsibleUserName = responsibleUserNames.TryGetValue(
                                x.UserCollectId,
                                out var responsibleUserName)
                                    ? responsibleUserName
                                    : string.Empty,
                            TransactionCreatedAt = x.CreatedAt,
                            SupervisorCollectedAt = x.SuperVisorCollectedAt ?? collectedAt,
                            TicketPrice = x.TicketPrice,
                            TicketOldExceedPrice = x.TicketOldExceedPrice,
                            ExceedAmount = x.ExceedAmount,
                            TotalPriceAfterExceed = x.TotalPriceAfterExceed,
                            VehicleNumber = x.VehicleNumber,
                            CardNumber = x.CardNumber,
                            IsSubscriber = x.IsSubscriber
                        })
                        .OrderByDescending(x => x.SupervisorCollectedAt)
                        .ThenByDescending(x => x.TransactionCreatedAt)
                        .ToList()
                };

                await _ticketCollectionTransactionRepository.AddAsync(
                    collectionTransaction,
                    cancellationToken);

                await _ticketCollectionTransactionRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

                await SafeAuditAsync(
                    response,
                    supervisorId,
                    gateId,
                    cancellationToken);

                return Result<CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse>.Ok(response);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CollectTicketExceedTransaction operation was canceled.");
                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Unexpected error while collecting ticket exceed transactions.");

                return Result<CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "TicketExceedTransactions.Collect.Unexpected",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.TicketExceedTransactions_CollectUnexpected,
                        Type: ErrorType.Infrastructure));
            }
        }

        private async Task SafeAuditAsync(
            CollectTicketExceedTransactionResponse response,
            Guid supervisorId,
            Guid gateId,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            try
            {
                await _auditLogger.LogAsync(
                    new AuditLogEntry(
                        EventName: "CollectTicketExceedTransactionsSucceeded",
                        EventCategory: "TicketManagement",
                        IsSuccess: true,
                        StatusCode: StatusCodes.Status200OK,
                        UserId: supervisorId,
                        GateId: gateId,
                        Extra: new
                        {
                            response.CollectionTransactionId,
                            response.TotalTransactionsCollected,
                            response.TotalExceedAmountCollected,
                            LinesCount = response.Lines.Count,
                            TicketExceedDetailsCount = response.TicketExceedCollectDetails.Count,
                            SupervisorCollectorId = supervisorId,
                            GateId = gateId
                        }),
                    cancellationToken);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    ex,
                    "Audit logging failed for CollectTicketExceedTransaction. SupervisorId: {SupervisorId}, GateId: {GateId}, CollectionTransactionId: {CollectionTransactionId}",
                    supervisorId,
                    gateId,
                    response.CollectionTransactionId);
            }
        }
    }
}

﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.Specification;

{
    public sealed class UncollectedTicketExceedTransactionsByGateSpec
      : Specification<TicketExceedTransaction>
    {
        public UncollectedTicketExceedTransactionsByGateSpec(Guid gateId)
        {
            Include(x => x.UserCollector);

            AddCriteria(x =>
                x.GateId == gateId &&
                x.SuperVisorCollectorId == null);

            AddOrderBy(x => x.CreatedAt);
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\TicketExceedTransactionsManagement\Command\Create\CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction.QrCode;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction.Security;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.TicketExceedTransactionsManagement.Command.Create
{
    internal sealed class CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandHandler
         : ICommandHandler<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommand, CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandResponse>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<Ticket> _ticketRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<TicketExceedTransaction> _ticketExceedTransactionRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<Sanction> _sanctionRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<ParkingGate> _parkingGateRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<User> _userRepository;

        private readonly IQRCodeService _qrCodeService;
        private readonly IByteVerificationService _byteVerificationService;

        private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
        private readonly ITokenReader _tokenReader;
        private readonly ILogger<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandHandler> _logger;

        public CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandHandler(
            IGenericRepository<Ticket> ticketRepository,
            IGenericRepository<TicketExceedTransaction> ticketExceedTransactionRepository,
            IGenericRepository<Sanction> sanctionRepository,
            IGenericRepository<ParkingGate> parkingGateRepository,
            IGenericRepository<User> userRepository,
            IQRCodeService qrCodeService,
            IByteVerificationService byteVerificationService,
            IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
            ITokenReader tokenReader,
            ILogger<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandHandler> logger)
        {
            _ticketRepository = ticketRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticketRepository));
            _ticketExceedTransactionRepository = ticketExceedTransactionRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticketExceedTransactionRepository));
            _sanctionRepository = sanctionRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sanctionRepository));
            _parkingGateRepository = parkingGateRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(parkingGateRepository));
            _userRepository = userRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(userRepository));

            _qrCodeService = qrCodeService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(qrCodeService));
            _byteVerificationService = byteVerificationService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(byteVerificationService));

            _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpContextAccessor));
            _tokenReader = tokenReader ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tokenReader));
            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
        }

        public async Task<Result<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandResponse>> Handle(
            CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommand request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            try
            {
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                // 1) Read token info: GateId + UserId
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                var tokenInfo = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.ReadToken(_tokenReader);

                if (tokenInfo is null || !tokenInfo.GateId.HasValue || !tokenInfo.UserId.HasValue)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Token info missing GateId/UserId while creating ticket exceed transaction.");

                    return Result<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Token.GateOrUser.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.TokenInfo_Missing,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                var gateId = tokenInfo.GateId.Value;
                var userCollectId = tokenInfo.UserId.Value;

                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                // 2) Validate Gate exists
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                var gate = await _parkingGateRepository.GetByIdAsync(gateId, cancellationToken);

                if (gate is null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Gate not found while creating ticket exceed transaction. GateId: {GateId}",
                        gateId);

                    return Result<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Gate.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.GateNotFound,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                // 3) Validate User exists
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                var userCollector = await _userRepository.GetByIdAsync(userCollectId, cancellationToken);

                if (userCollector is null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "User collector not found while creating ticket exceed transaction. UserId: {UserId}",
                        userCollectId);

                    return Result<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "User.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.User_NotFound,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                // 4) Get Ticket
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                var ticketEntity = await _ticketRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.TicketId, cancellationToken);

                if (ticketEntity is null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Ticket not found while creating ticket exceed transaction. TicketId: {TicketId}",
                        request.TicketId);

                    return Result<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Ticket.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.Ticket_NotFound,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                // 5) Prevent duplicate transaction
                // Important: Transaction.Id = TicketId
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                var existingTransaction = await _ticketExceedTransactionRepository
                    .GetByIdAsync(request.TicketId, cancellationToken);

                if (existingTransaction is not null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Ticket exceed transaction already exists. TicketId: {TicketId}",
                        request.TicketId);

                    return Result<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "TicketExceedTransaction.AlreadyExists",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.TicketExceedTransaction_AlreadyExists,
                            Type: ErrorType.Conflict));
                }

                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                // 6) Generate SAME ticket QR as AddTicket
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                var generatedQr = GenerateTicketQrCode(ticketEntity);

                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                // 7) Get Sanctions + calculate total exceed amount
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                var distinctSanctionIds = request.SanctionIds
                    .Distinct()
                    .ToList();

                var sanctions = new List<Sanction>();

                foreach (var sanctionId in distinctSanctionIds)
                {
                    var sanction = await _sanctionRepository.GetByIdAsync(sanctionId, cancellationToken);

                    if (sanction is null)
                    {
                        _logger.LogWarning(
                            "Sanction not found while creating ticket exceed transaction. SanctionId: {SanctionId}",
                            sanctionId);

                        return Result<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandResponse>.Fail(
                            new Error(
                                Code: "Sanction.NotFound",
                                Message: ErrorMessage.Sanction_NotFound,
                                Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                    }

                    sanctions.Add(sanction);
                }

                var totalExceedAmount = sanctions.Sum(x => x.Amount);
                var oldExceedPrice = ticketEntity.ExceedPrice;

                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                // 8) Update ticket exceed price
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                ticketEntity.SetExceedPrice(totalExceedAmount);

                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                // 9) Create transaction snapshot
                // SuperVisorCollectorId = null initially
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                var transaction = TicketExceedTransaction.Create(
                    ticket: ticketEntity,
                    oldExceedPrice: oldExceedPrice,
                    exceedAmount: totalExceedAmount,
                    gateId: gateId,
                    userCollectId: userCollectId,
                    sanctions: sanctions);

                await _ticketExceedTransactionRepository.AddAsync(transaction, cancellationToken);

                // Saves:
                // 1) Ticket.ExceedPrice update
                // 2) TicketExceedTransaction insert
                // 3) Many-to-many sanctions join rows
                await _ticketExceedTransactionRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
                await _ticketRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                // 10) Build response
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------
                var response = new CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandResponse
                {
                    TicketExceedTransactionId = transaction.Id,
                    TicketId = ticketEntity.Id,

                    ExceedAmount = transaction.ExceedAmount,
                    TicketPrice = transaction.TicketPrice,
                    TotalPriceAfterExceed = transaction.TotalPriceAfterExceed,

                    GateId = transaction.GateId,
                    UserCollectId = transaction.UserCollectId,
                    SuperVisorCollectorId = transaction.SuperVisorCollectorId,

                    SanctionIds = distinctSanctionIds,
                    CreatedAt = transaction.CreatedAt,

                    QrCode = generatedQr.QrCode,
                    TicketInfo = generatedQr.QrText
                };

                return Result<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandResponse>.Ok(response);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateTicketExceedTransaction operation was canceled.");
                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error while creating ticket exceed transaction.");

                return Result<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "TicketExceedTransaction.Create.Unexpected",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.TicketExceedTransaction_Create_Unexpected,
                        Type: ErrorType.Infrastructure));
            }
        }

        private (byte[] QrCode, string QrText) GenerateTicketQrCode(Ticket ticketEntity)
        {
            if (ticketEntity.UniqueGuidPart is null || ticketEntity.UniqueGuidPart.Length != 4)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"Ticket UniqueGuidPart must be exactly 4 bytes. TicketId={ticketEntity.Id}");
            }

            var byte5 = _byteVerificationService
                .GenerateComplexByte5FromGuid(ticketEntity.UniqueGuidPart);

            var combinedBytes = ticketEntity.UniqueGuidPart
                .Concat(new[] { byte5 })
                .ToArray();

            if (combinedBytes.Length != 5)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"Generated QR bytes must be exactly 5 bytes, but got {combinedBytes.Length} bytes. TicketId={ticketEntity.Id}");
            }

            var qrText = Convert.ToHexString(combinedBytes);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Ticket QR generated for exceed transaction. TicketId={TicketId}, UniqueCode={UniqueCode}, QrText={QrText}",
                ticketEntity.Id,
                ticketEntity.UniqueCode,
                qrText);

            var qrCode = _qrCodeService.GenerateQRCodeFromText(qrText);

            return (qrCode, qrText);
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Feature\TicketExceedTransactionsManagement\Command\Create\CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandValidation.cs ==================== 
﻿using FluentValidation;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.TicketExceedTransactionsManagement.Command.Create
{
    public sealed class CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandValidation
       : AbstractValidator<CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommand>
    {
        public CreateTicketExceedTransactionCommandValidation()
        {
            RuleFor(x => x.TicketId)
                .NotEmpty()
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.TicketId_Required);

            RuleFor(x => x.SanctionIds)
                .NotNull()
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.SanctionIds_Required);

            RuleFor(x => x.SanctionIds)
                .Must(x => x is { Count: > 0 })
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.SanctionIds_Required);

            RuleForEach(x => x.SanctionIds)
                .NotEmpty()
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.SanctionId_Required);

            RuleFor(x => x.SanctionIds)
                .Must(x => x.Distinct().Count() == x.Count)
                .When(x => x.SanctionIds is { Count: > 0 })
                .WithMessage(ErrorMessage.SanctionIds_Duplicated);
        }
    }
}

﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction.Media;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction.QrCode;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction.Security;
using NPark.Application.Shared.Dto;
using NPark.Application.Specifications.ParkingMembershipSpecification;
using NPark.Application.Specifications.ParkingSystemConfigurationSpec;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;
using NPark.Domain.FileNames;
using NPark.Domain.Resource;

namespace NPark.Application.Feature.TicketsManagement.Command.Add
{
    public sealed class AddTicketCommandHandler
         : ICommandHandler<AddTicketCommand, AddTicketCommandResponse>
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<Ticket> _ticketRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<ParkingGate> _parkingGateRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> _pricingSchemaRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<ParkingSystemConfiguration> _parkingSystemConfigurationRepository;
        private readonly IGenericRepository<ParkingMemberships> _parkingMembershipsRepository;
        private readonly IQRCodeService _qrCodeService;
        private readonly IByteVerificationService _byteVerificationService;
        private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
        private readonly ITokenReader _tokenReader;
        private readonly IMediaService _mediaService;
        private readonly ILogger<AddTicketCommandHandler> _logger;
        private readonly IRealtimeNotifier _realtimeNotifier;

        public AddTicketCommandHandler(
            IGenericRepository<Ticket> ticketRepository,
            IGenericRepository<ParkingMemberships> parkingMembershipsRepository,
            IQRCodeService qrCodeService,
            IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
            IByteVerificationService byteVerificationService,
            ITokenReader tokenReader,
            IGenericRepository<PricingScheme> pricingSchemaRepository,
            IMediaService mediaService,
            ILogger<AddTicketCommandHandler> logger,
            IRealtimeNotifier realtimeNotifier,
            IGenericRepository<ParkingSystemConfiguration> parkingSystemConfigurationRepository,
            IGenericRepository<ParkingGate> parkingGateRepository)
        {
            _ticketRepository = ticketRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticketRepository));
            _parkingMembershipsRepository = parkingMembershipsRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(parkingMembershipsRepository));
            _qrCodeService = qrCodeService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(qrCodeService));
            _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpContextAccessor));
            _byteVerificationService = byteVerificationService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(byteVerificationService));
            _tokenReader = tokenReader ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tokenReader));
            _pricingSchemaRepository = pricingSchemaRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(pricingSchemaRepository));
            _mediaService = mediaService ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(mediaService));
            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
            _realtimeNotifier = realtimeNotifier ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(realtimeNotifier));
            _parkingSystemConfigurationRepository = parkingSystemConfigurationRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(parkingSystemConfigurationRepository));
            _parkingGateRepository = parkingGateRepository ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(parkingGateRepository));
        }

        public async Task<Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>> Handle(
            AddTicketCommand request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            try
            {
                var configSpec = new GetParkingSystemConfigurationForUpdateSpecification();

                var configuration = await _parkingSystemConfigurationRepository
                    .FirstOrDefaultWithSpecAsync(configSpec, cancellationToken);

                if (configuration is null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Parking system configuration not found while adding ticket.");

                    return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Configuration.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.Configuration_NotFound,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                var tokenInfo = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.ReadToken(_tokenReader);

                if (tokenInfo is null || !tokenInfo.GateId.HasValue || !tokenInfo.UserId.HasValue)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Token info missing GateId/UserId while adding ticket.");

                    return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Token.GateOrUser.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.TokenInfo_Missing,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                var gateInfo = await _parkingGateRepository
                    .GetByIdAsync(tokenInfo.GateId.Value, cancellationToken);

                if (gateInfo is null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Gate info not found while adding ticket. GateId={GateId}",
                        tokenInfo.GateId.Value);

                    return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Gate.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.GateNotFound,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }

                if (gateInfo.LprIp != null)
                {
                    if (request.VehicleNumber == null)
                    {
                        return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                            new Error(
                                Code: "VehicleNumber.RequiredForLPR",
                                Message: ErrorMessage.VehicleNumberRequired,
                                Type: ErrorType.Validation));
                    }
                }
                if (gateInfo.HasScanner is not null && gateInfo.HasScanner.Value == true)
                {
                    if (request.ScannerPhoto == null)
                    {
                        return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                                new Error(
                                    Code: "ScannerPhoto.RequiredForScannerGate",
                                    Message: ErrorMessage.ScannerPhotoRequired,
                                    Type: ErrorType.Validation));
                    }
                }
                if (request.IsSubscriber)
                {
                    return await HandleSubscriberTicketAsync(
                        request,
                        configuration,
                        tokenInfo.GateId.Value,
                        tokenInfo.UserId.Value,
                        gateInfo,
                        cancellationToken);
                }

                return await HandleNormalTicketAsync(
                    request,
                    configuration,
                    tokenInfo.GateId.Value,
                    tokenInfo.UserId.Value,
                    gateInfo,
                    cancellationToken);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("AddTicket operation was canceled.");
                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error while adding ticket.");

                return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "Ticket.Add.Unexpected",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.TicketAdd_Unexpected,
                        Type: ErrorType.Infrastructure));
            }
        }

        private async Task<Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>> HandleSubscriberTicketAsync(
            AddTicketCommand request,
            ParkingSystemConfiguration configuration,
            Guid gateId,
            Guid userId,
            ParkingGate gateInfo,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var cardSpec = new GetCardSummaryByIdSpec(
                request.CardNumber ?? string.Empty,
                request.VehicleNumber ?? string.Empty);

            var subscriber = await _parkingMembershipsRepository
                .FirstOrDefaultWithSpecAsync(cardSpec, cancellationToken);

            if (subscriber is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Subscriber card not found. CardNumber={CardNumber}, VehicleNumber={VehicleNumber}",
                    request.CardNumber,
                    request.VehicleNumber);

                return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "Subscriber.Card.NotFound",
                        Message: "المشترك غير موجود ",
                        Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
            }

            var now = DateTime.Now;

            if (now < subscriber.CreatedAt || now >= subscriber.EndDate)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Invalid subscriber card date. CardNumber={CardNumber}, VehicleNumber={VehicleNumber}, Start={Start}, End={End}, Now={Now}",
                    subscriber.CardNumber,
                    subscriber.VehicleNumber,
                    subscriber.CreatedAt,
                    subscriber.EndDate,
                    now);

                return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "Subscriber.Card.InvalidDate",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.Subscriber_Card_InvalidDate,
                        Type: ErrorType.Validation));
            }

            var activeSubscriberTicketSpec = new GetActiveSubscriberTicketSpec(
                cardNumber: subscriber.CardNumber,
                subscriberNationalId: subscriber.NationalId,
                vehicleNumber: subscriber.VehicleNumber);

            var activeSubscriberTicket = await _ticketRepository
                .FirstOrDefaultWithSpecAsync(activeSubscriberTicketSpec, cancellationToken);

            if (activeSubscriberTicket is not null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Subscriber is already inside park. SubscriberNationalId={SubscriberNationalId}, CardNumber={CardNumber}, ActiveTicketId={TicketId}",
                    subscriber.NationalId,
                    subscriber.CardNumber,
                    activeSubscriberTicket.Id);

                return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                    new Error(
                        Code: "Subscriber.AlreadyInsidePark",
                        Message: ErrorMessage.Subscriber_AlreadyInsidePark,
                        Type: ErrorType.Validation));
            }

            var ticketEntity = Ticket.Create(
                startDate: now,
                price: 0m,
                gateId: gateId,
                userId: userId);

            ticketEntity.SetSubscriber(
                nationalId: subscriber.NationalId,
                vehicleNumber: subscriber.VehicleNumber,
                cardNumber: subscriber.CardNumber);

            await _ticketRepository.AddAsync(ticketEntity, cancellationToken);
            await _ticketRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            await NotifyDashboardTicketAddedAsync(
                ticketEntity,
                gateInfo,
                isSubscriber: true,
                cancellationToken);

            var response = BuildResponse(
                ticketEntity,
                qrCode: Array.Empty<byte>(),
                ticketInfo: ticketEntity.UniqueCode);

            return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Ok(response);
        }

        private async Task<Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>> HandleNormalTicketAsync(
            AddTicketCommand request,
            ParkingSystemConfiguration configuration,
            Guid gateId,
            Guid userId,
            ParkingGate gateInfo,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var now = DateTime.Now;

            Ticket ticketEntity;

            if (configuration.PriceType == PriceType.Enter)
            {
                if (request.PricingSchemaId is null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("Configuration has PriceType=Enter but no PricingSchemaId.");

                    return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "Configuration.PricingSchema.Missing",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.PricingSchemaNotConfiguredForEnterPriceType,
                            Type: ErrorType.Validation));
                }

                var pricingScheme = await _pricingSchemaRepository
                    .GetByIdAsync(request.PricingSchemaId.Value, cancellationToken);

                if (pricingScheme is null)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Pricing scheme not found. PricingSchemaId={PricingSchemaId}",
                        request.PricingSchemaId.Value);

                    return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "PricingSchema.NotFound",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.PricingSchema_NotFound,
                            Type: ErrorType.NotFound));
                }
                if (!pricingScheme.IsEnterPriceSchema)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Invalid pricing scheme for enter ticket. PricingSchemaId={PricingSchemaId}",
                        request.PricingSchemaId.Value);

                    return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Fail(
                        new Error(
                            Code: "EnterPriceSchema.InvalidForEnterTicket",
                            Message: ErrorMessage.EnterPriceSchema_InvalidForEnterTicket,
                            Type: ErrorType.Validation));
                }
                ticketEntity = Ticket.Create(
                    startDate: now,
                    price: pricingScheme.Salary,
                    gateId: gateId,
                    userId: userId);

                ticketEntity.SetIsCashierCollected();

                if (request.TicketsImages is { Count: > 0 })
                {
                    foreach (var file in request.TicketsImages)
                    {
                        var filePath = await _mediaService
                            .SaveAsync(file, FileNames.TicketAttachments);

                        ticketEntity.AddAttachment(filePath);
                    }
                }

                if (request.ScannerPhoto is not null)
                {
                    var filePath = await _mediaService
                        .SaveAsync(request.ScannerPhoto, FileNames.TicketAttachments);

                    ticketEntity.AddAttachment(filePath);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                ticketEntity = Ticket.Create(
                    startDate: now,
                    price: 0m,
                    gateId: gateId,
                    userId: userId);
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.VehicleNumber))
            {
                ticketEntity.SetVehicleNumber(request.VehicleNumber);
            }

            await _ticketRepository.AddAsync(ticketEntity, cancellationToken);
            await _ticketRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            await NotifyDashboardTicketAddedAsync(
                ticketEntity,
                gateInfo,
                isSubscriber: false,
                cancellationToken);

            var generatedQr = GenerateTicketQrCode(ticketEntity);

            var response = BuildResponse(
                ticketEntity,
                generatedQr.QrCode,
                generatedQr.QrText);

            return Result<AddTicketCommandResponse>.Ok(response);
        }

        private async Task NotifyDashboardTicketAddedAsync(
            Ticket ticketEntity,
            ParkingGate gateInfo,
            bool isSubscriber,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            try
            {
                var gateNumber = gateInfo.GateType == GateType.Entrance
                    ? $"{ErrorMessage.EntranceGate} {gateInfo.GateNumber}"
                    : $"{ErrorMessage.ExitGate} {gateInfo.GateNumber}";

                var payload = new TicketAddedNotification
                {
                    TicketId = ticketEntity.Id,
                    GateId = ticketEntity.GateId,
                    StartDate = ticketEntity.StartDate,
                    Price = ticketEntity.Price,
                    IsSubscriber = isSubscriber,
                    VehicleNumber = ticketEntity.VehicleNumber,
                    GateNumber = gateNumber
                };

                await _realtimeNotifier.NotifyTicketAddedAsync(payload);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Failed to send realtime notification for ticket {TicketId}",
                    ticketEntity.Id);
            }
        }

        private GeneratedTicketQr GenerateTicketQrCode(Ticket ticketEntity)
        {
            var byte5 = _byteVerificationService
                .GenerateComplexByte5FromGuid(ticketEntity.UniqueGuidPart);

            var combinedBytes = ticketEntity.UniqueGuidPart
                .Concat(new[] { byte5 })
                .ToArray();

            if (combinedBytes.Length != 5)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"Generated QR bytes must be exactly 5 bytes, but got {combinedBytes.Length} bytes.");
            }

            var qrText = Convert.ToHexString(combinedBytes);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Ticket QR generated as hexadecimal text. TicketId={TicketId}, UniqueCode={UniqueCode}, QrText={QrText}",
                ticketEntity.Id,
                ticketEntity.UniqueCode,
                qrText);

            var qrCode = _qrCodeService.GenerateQRCodeFromText(qrText);

            return new GeneratedTicketQr(
                QrCode: qrCode,
                QrText: qrText);
        }

        private static AddTicketCommandResponse BuildResponse(
            Ticket ticketEntity,
            byte[] qrCode,
            string ticketInfo)
        {
            return new AddTicketCommandResponse
            {
                CreatedAt = ticketEntity.StartDate,
                Price = ticketEntity.Price,
                QrCode = qrCode ?? Array.Empty<byte>(),
                TicketId = ticketEntity.Id,

                // For normal tickets this is now the exact QR text:
                // Example: 75A714A3C3
                TicketInfo = ticketInfo
            };
        }

        private sealed record GeneratedTicketQr(
            byte[] QrCode,
            string QrText);
    }
}

        public GetActiveSubscriberTicketSpec(

                    (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(vehicleNumber) && x.VehicleNumber == vehicleNumber)
                ));
        }
    }
