// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Specifications\ParkingMembershipSpecification\GetParkingMembershipWithPriceSchemaSpec.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.Specification;
using NPark.Application.Feature.ParkingMembershipsManagement.Query.GetAll;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.FileNames;

namespace NPark.Application.Specifications.ParkingMembershipSpecification
{
    public sealed class GetParkingMembershipWithPriceSchemaSpec : Specification<ParkingMemberships, GetAllParkingMembershipQueryResponse>
    {
        public GetParkingMembershipWithPriceSchemaSpec(GetAllParkingMembershipQuery request)
        {
            Include(x => x.PricingScheme);
            Include(x => x.Attachments);
            UseSingleQuery();
            if (request.SearchText != null)
            {
                AddCriteria(x => x.Name.Contains(request.SearchText) ||
                x.VehicleNumber.Contains(request.SearchText) ||
                x.Phone.Contains(request.SearchText) ||
                x.NationalId.Contains(request.SearchText)

                );
            }
            ApplyPaging(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
            if (request.OrderSort == BuildingBlock.Domain.Enums.OrderSort.Newest)
            {
                AddOrderByDescending(x => x.CreatedAt);
            }
            else
            {
                AddOrderBy(x => x.CreatedAt);
            }
            Select(x => new GetAllParkingMembershipQueryResponse
            {
                Id = x.Id,
                Name = x.Name,
                VehicleNumber = x.VehicleNumber,
                Phone = x.Phone,
                NationalId = x.NationalId,
                CreatedAt = x.CreatedAt,
                StartTime = x.PricingScheme.StartTime,
                EndTime = x.PricingScheme.EndTime,
                EndDate = x.EndDate,
                CardNumber = x.CardNumber,
                PricingSchemeId = x.PricingSchemeId,
                VehicleImage = x.Attachments.Select(x => new GetAllParkingAttachment
                {
                    FilePath = $"Media/{FileNames.ParkingMemberships}/{x.FilePath}",
                    Id = x.Id,
                }).ToList(),
            });
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Specifications\ParkingSystemConfigurationSpec\GetParkingSystemConfigurationSpecification.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.Specification;
using NPark.Application.Feature.ParkingSystemConfigurationManagement.Command.Update;
using NPark.Application.Feature.ParkingSystemConfigurationManagement.Query.GetSystemConfiguration;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;

namespace NPark.Application.Specifications.ParkingSystemConfigurationSpec
{
    public sealed class GetParkingSystemConfigurationSpecification
       : Specification<ParkingSystemConfiguration, GetSystemConfigurationQueryResponse>
    {
        public GetParkingSystemConfigurationSpecification()
        {
            AddCriteria(x => x.Id == 1);
            Include(x => x.PricingScheme);
            Include(x => x.ParkingGates);
            Select(x => new GetSystemConfigurationQueryResponse
            {
                AllowedParkingSlots = x.AllowedParkingSlots,
                EntryGatesCount = x.EntryGatesCount,
                ExitGatesCount = x.ExitGatesCount,

                PriceType = x.PriceType,
                VehiclePassengerData = x.VehiclePassengerData,
                PrintType = x.PrintType,

                DateTimeFlag = x.DateTimeFlag,
                TicketIdFlag = x.TicketIdFlag,
                FeesFlag = x.FeesFlag,

                gracePeriodMinutes = x.GracePeriod == null
                    ? null
                    : (int)x.GracePeriod.Value.TotalMinutes,

                PricingSchemaId = x.PricingSchemaId,
                PricingSchemaName = x.PricingScheme == null
                    ? string.Empty
                    : x.PricingScheme.Name,

                EntryGates = x.ParkingGates
                    .Where(g => g.GateType == GateType.Entrance)
                    .Select(g => new GateInfo
                    {
                        GateId = g.Id,
                        GateNumber = g.GateNumber,
                        HasReceiptPrinterName = g.HasReceiptPrinterName,
                        HasQrPrinterName = g.HasQrPrinterName,
                        LprIp = g.LprIp,
                        PcIp = g.PcIp,
                        HasScanner = g.HasScanner,
                        ControlIp = g.ControlIp ?? string.Empty,

                        IsAssigned = g.IsAssigned,
                        AssignedTo = g.AssignedTo,

                        QrPrinterName = g.QrPrinterName,
                        ReceiptPrinterName = g.ReceiptPrinterName,

                        ONVIFCameraSetting = g.ONVIFCameraSetting == null
                            ? null
                            : new ONVIFCameraSettingDto
                            {
                                UrlRequest = g.ONVIFCameraSetting.UrlRequest,
                                UserName = g.ONVIFCameraSetting.UserName,
                                Password = g.ONVIFCameraSetting.Password
                            }
                    })
                    .OrderBy(g => g.GateNumber)
                    .ToList(),
                ExitGates = x.ParkingGates
                    .Where(g => g.GateType == GateType.Exit)
                    .Select(g => new GateInfo
                    {
                        GateId = g.Id,
                        GateNumber = g.GateNumber,

                        LprIp = g.LprIp,
                        HasScanner = g.HasScanner,
                        PcIp = g.PcIp,
                        HasReceiptPrinterName = g.HasReceiptPrinterName,
                        HasQrPrinterName = g.HasQrPrinterName,
                        ControlIp = g.ControlIp ?? string.Empty,

                        IsAssigned = g.IsAssigned,
                        AssignedTo = g.AssignedTo,

                        QrPrinterName = g.QrPrinterName,
                        ReceiptPrinterName = g.ReceiptPrinterName,

                        ONVIFCameraSetting = g.ONVIFCameraSetting == null
                            ? null
                            : new ONVIFCameraSettingDto
                            {
                                UrlRequest = g.ONVIFCameraSetting.UrlRequest,
                                UserName = g.ONVIFCameraSetting.UserName,
                                Password = g.ONVIFCameraSetting.Password
                            }
                    })
                    .OrderBy(g => g.GateNumber)
                    .ToList()
            });
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Specifications\PricingSchemaSpecification\GetAllPricingSchemaSpecification.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.Specification;
using NPark.Application.Feature.PricingSchemaManagement.Query.GetAll;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;

namespace NPark.Application.Specifications.PricingSchemaSpecification
{
    public class GetAllPricingSchemaSpecification : Specification<PricingScheme, GetAllPricingSchemaQueryResponse>
    {
        public GetAllPricingSchemaSpecification(GetAllPricingSchemaQuery request)
        {
            if (request.SearchText != null)
            {
                AddCriteria(x => x.Name.Contains(request.SearchText));
            }
            ApplyPaging(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
            if (request.OrderSort == BuildingBlock.Domain.Enums.OrderSort.Newest)
            {
                AddOrderByDescending(x => x.CreatedOnUtc);
            }
            else
            {
                AddOrderBy(x => x.CreatedOnUtc);
            }
            Select(x => new GetAllPricingSchemaQueryResponse
            {
                Id = x.Id,
                Name = x.Name,
                DurationType = x.DurationType,
                Price = x.Salary,
                EndTime = x.EndTime,
                StartTime = x.StartTime,
                IsRepeated = x.IsRepeated,
                TotalDays = x.TotalDays,
                TotalHours = x.TotalHours,
                IsEnterPriceSchema = x.IsEnterPriceSchema
            });
            UseNoTracking();
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Specifications\TicketSpecification\SearchTicketArchiveSpecification.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.Enums;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.SharedDto;
using BuildingBlock.Domain.Specification;
using NPark.Application.Feature.TicketsManagement.Query.GetTicketForEntryGate;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;

namespace NPark.Application.Specifications.TicketSpecification
{
    internal sealed class SearchTicketArchiveSpecification : Specification<TicketArchive, GetTicketInfo>

    {
        public SearchTicketArchiveSpecification(SearchParameters searchParameters)
        {
            var date = DateTime.Now.Date;
            var start = date;
            var end = date.AddDays(1);
            AddCriteria(t => t.CreatedOnUtc >= start && t.CreatedOnUtc < end);

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchParameters.SearchText))
                AddCriteria(t => (t.VehicleNumber != null && t.VehicleNumber.Contains(searchParameters.SearchText)) ||
                t.UniqueCode.Contains(searchParameters.SearchText) ||
                (t.CardNumber != null && t.CardNumber.Contains(searchParameters.SearchText)));

            if (searchParameters.OrderSort == OrderSort.Newest)
            {
                AddOrderBy(x => x.CreatedOnUtc);
            }
            else
            {
                AddOrderByDescending(x => x.CreatedOnUtc);
            }

            Select(x => new GetTicketInfo
            {
                isCollectedByCashier = x.IsCollected,
                Price = x.Price,
                TicketNumber = x.UniqueCode,
                StartDate = x.CreatedOnUtc,
                TicketInfo = x.VehicleNumber
            });
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Application\Specifications\TicketSpecification\TicketReportSpec.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.Specification;
using NPark.Application.Feature.TicketsManagement.Query.ReportTickets;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Domain.FileNames;

namespace NPark.Application.Specifications.TicketSpecification
{
    internal sealed class TicketReportSpec : Specification<TicketArchive, ReportTicketsResponse>
    {
        public TicketReportSpec(ReportTicketsQuery request)
        {
            Include(x => x.UserCollector);
            Include(x => x.TicketArchiveAttachments);

            var fromDate = request.FromDate.Date;
            var toDateExclusive = request.ToDate.Date.AddDays(1);

            AddCriteria(x =>
                x.StartDate >= fromDate &&
                x.StartDate < toDateExclusive);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.SearchTerm))
            {
                var searchTerm = request.SearchTerm.Trim();

                AddCriteria(x =>
                    (x.VehicleNumber != null && x.VehicleNumber.Contains(searchTerm)) ||
                    (x.UserCollector != null && x.UserCollector.Name.Contains(searchTerm)));
            }

            Select(x => new ReportTicketsResponse
            {
                TicketId = x.Id,
                EnterDate = x.StartDate,
                ExitDate = x.EndDate,
                VehicleNumber = x.VehicleNumber,
                IsSubscribed = x.IsSubscriber,
                Price = x.Price,
                CollectorName = x.UserCollector == null ? string.Empty : x.UserCollector.Name,
                TicketNumber = x.UniqueCode,

                Attachments = x.TicketArchiveAttachments
                    .Select(a => new ReportTicketAttachmentResponse
                    {
                        ImagePath = "Media/" + FileNames.TicketAttachments + "/" + a.FilePath
                    })
                    .ToList()
            });
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Domain\Entities\AuditLog.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.EntitiesHelper;

namespace NPark.Domain.Entities
{
    public sealed class AuditLog : Entity<Guid>
    {
        public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; init; }

        // WHAT
        public string EventName { get; init; } = null!;   // ex: "TicketCollected", "GateEntered", "GateExited", "UnhandledException"

        public string? EventCategory { get; init; }       // ex: "Ticket", "Gate", "Error"

        // WHO
        public Guid? UserId { get; init; }

        public Guid? GateId { get; init; }
        public string? Role { get; init; }

        // HTTP

        public string? ErrorCode { get; init; }           // ex: "Unknown.Exception" أو Error.Code من Result
        public string? ErrorMessage { get; init; }        // Short message (مش الـ stack)

        // CORR
        public string? CorrelationId { get; init; }

        public string? TraceId { get; init; }

        // EXTRA

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Domain\Entities\ParkingGate.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.EntitiesHelper;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;

namespace NPark.Domain.Entities
{
    public class ParkingGate : Entity<Guid>
    {
        public int GateNumber { get; private set; }
        public GateType GateType { get; private set; }

        public bool? IsOccupied { get; private set; }
        public Guid? OccupiedBy { get; private set; }
        public DateTime? OccupiedTime { get; private set; }

        public string? PcIp { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
        public bool HasPc => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(PcIp);

        public string? LprIp { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
        public bool HasLpr => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(LprIp);
        public bool? HasScanner { get; private set; } = false;
        public Guid? LastLoginUserId { get; private set; }

        public bool IsAssigned { get; private set; }
        public Guid? AssignedTo { get; private set; }
        public User? AssignedToUser { get; private set; }

        public string? ControlIp { get; private set; }

        public bool HasQrPrinterName { get; private set; }
        public string? QrPrinterName { get; private set; }

        public bool HasReceiptPrinterName { get; private set; }
        public string? ReceiptPrinterName { get; private set; }

        public Guid? ONVIFCameraSettingId { get; private set; }
        public ONVIFCameraSetting? ONVIFCameraSetting { get; private set; }

        public int ParkingSystemConfigurationId { get; private set; }
        public ParkingSystemConfiguration ParkingSystemConfiguration { get; private set; } = null!;

        private ParkingGate()
        {
        }

        public static ParkingGate Create(
            int gateNumber,
            GateType gateType,
            int parkingSystemConfigurationId,
            string? lprIp = null,
            string? pcIp = null,
            string? controlIp = null,
            Guid? onvifCameraSettingId = null,
            bool hasQrPrinterName = false,
            string? qrPrinterName = null,
            bool hasReceiptPrinterName = false,
            string? receiptPrinterName = null)
        {
            if (parkingSystemConfigurationId <= 0)
            {
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    "ParkingSystemConfigurationId must be greater than zero.",
                    nameof(parkingSystemConfigurationId));
            }

            var gate = new ParkingGate
            {
                GateNumber = gateNumber,
                GateType = gateType,
                ParkingSystemConfigurationId = parkingSystemConfigurationId,

                LprIp = lprIp,
                PcIp = pcIp,
                ControlIp = controlIp,

                ONVIFCameraSettingId = onvifCameraSettingId
            };

            gate.UpdatePrinters(
                hasQrPrinterName: hasQrPrinterName,
                qrPrinterName: qrPrinterName,
                hasReceiptPrinterName: hasReceiptPrinterName,
                receiptPrinterName: receiptPrinterName);

            return gate;
        }

        public void AssignToConfiguration(int parkingSystemConfigurationId)
        {
            if (parkingSystemConfigurationId <= 0)
            {
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    "ParkingSystemConfigurationId must be greater than zero.",
                    nameof(parkingSystemConfigurationId));
            }

            ParkingSystemConfigurationId = parkingSystemConfigurationId;
        }

        public void SetIsOccupied(
            bool isOccupied,
            Guid? occupiedBy = null,
            DateTime? occupiedTime = null)
        {
            IsOccupied = isOccupied;
            OccupiedBy = occupiedBy;
            OccupiedTime = occupiedTime;
        }

        public void UpdatePrinters(
            bool hasQrPrinterName,
            string? qrPrinterName,
            bool hasReceiptPrinterName,
            string? receiptPrinterName)
        {
            HasQrPrinterName = hasQrPrinterName;
            QrPrinterName = NormalizePrinterName(
                hasPrinterName: hasQrPrinterName,
                printerName: qrPrinterName,
                parameterName: nameof(qrPrinterName));

            HasReceiptPrinterName = hasReceiptPrinterName;
            ReceiptPrinterName = NormalizePrinterName(
                hasPrinterName: hasReceiptPrinterName,
                printerName: receiptPrinterName,
                parameterName: nameof(receiptPrinterName));
        }

        public void SetPcIp(string pcIp)
        {
            PcIp = pcIp;
        }

        public void UpdateGateInfo(
    int gateNumber,
    GateType gateType,
    string? lprIp,
    string? pcIp,
    string? controlIp,
    Guid? onvifCameraSettingId,
    bool isAssigned,
    Guid? assignedTo,
    bool hasScanner,
    bool hasQrPrinterName = false,
    string? qrPrinterName = null,
    bool hasReceiptPrinterName = false,
    string? receiptPrinterName = null)
        {
            GateNumber = gateNumber;
            GateType = gateType;
            LprIp = lprIp;
            PcIp = pcIp;
            ControlIp = controlIp;
            ONVIFCameraSettingId = onvifCameraSettingId;
            IsAssigned = isAssigned;
            AssignedTo = isAssigned ? assignedTo : null;

            SetScanner(hasScanner);

            UpdatePrinters(
                hasQrPrinterName: hasQrPrinterName,
                qrPrinterName: qrPrinterName,
                hasReceiptPrinterName: hasReceiptPrinterName,
                receiptPrinterName: receiptPrinterName);
        }

        public void SetLastLoginUserId(Guid userId)
        {
            LastLoginUserId = userId;
        }

        public void SetControlIp(string controlIp)
        {
            ControlIp = controlIp;
        }

        public void SetONVIFCameraSettingId(Guid? id)
        {
            ONVIFCameraSettingId = id;
        }

        private static string? NormalizePrinterName(
            bool hasPrinterName,
            string? printerName,
            string parameterName)
        {
            if (!hasPrinterName)
            {
                return null;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(printerName))
            {
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    $"{parameterName} is required when printer flag is enabled.",
                    parameterName);
            }

            return printerName.Trim();
        }

        public void SetScanner(bool hasScanner)
        {
            HasScanner = hasScanner;
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Domain\Entities\Ticket.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.EntitiesHelper;
using NPark.Domain.DomainEvent;
using System.Buffers.Binary;
using System.Globalization;

namespace NPark.Domain.Entities
{
    public sealed class Ticket : AggregateRoot<Guid>
    {
        private readonly List<TicketAttachment> _ticketAttachments = new();
        public DateTime StartDate { get; private set; }
        public DateTime? EndDate { get; private set; } = null;
        public decimal Price { get; private set; }
        public string? VehicleNumber { get; private set; } = null;
        public decimal ExceedPrice { get; private set; } = 0;
        public Guid? CollectedBy { get; private set; }
        public decimal TotalPrice => Price + ExceedPrice;
        public bool IsCollected { get; private set; }
        public DateTime? CollectedDate { get; private set; }
        public byte[] UniqueGuidPart { get; private set; }
        public string UniqueCode { get; private set; }
        public Guid GateId { get; private set; }
        public Guid? ExitGateId { private set; get; }
        public Guid UserId { get; private set; }
        public bool IsCashierCollected { get; private set; } = false;
        public User User { get; private set; }
        public User? UserCollector { get; private set; }
        public ParkingGate ParkingGate { get; private set; }
        public bool IsSubscriber { get; private set; } = false;
        public string? SubscriberNationalId { get; private set; }
        public string? CardNumber { get; private set; } = null;
        public IReadOnlyCollection<TicketAttachment> TicketAttachments => _ticketAttachments;

        private Ticket()
        { }

        public static Ticket Create(DateTime startDate, decimal price, Guid gateId, Guid userId
            )
        {
            var ticket = new Ticket()
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                StartDate = startDate,
                Price = price,
                GateId = gateId,
                UserId = userId,
            };

            // Save the first 4 bytes of the Guid as the unique part
            ticket.UniqueGuidPart = GetGuidUniquePart(ticket.Id);
            ticket.UniqueCode = BitConverter.ToString(ticket.UniqueGuidPart).Replace("-", "");

            return ticket;
        }

        public void SetCollected(Guid Id, DateTime? now)
        {
            IsCollected = true;
            CollectedBy = Id;
            CollectedDate = now ?? DateTime.Now;
        }

        public void SetExitGate(Guid exitGateId) => ExitGateId = exitGateId;

        public void SetVehicleNumber(string vehicleNumber) => VehicleNumber = vehicleNumber;

        public void SetIsCashierCollected() => IsCashierCollected = true;

        public void SetCollectedBy(Guid collectedBy)
        {
            CollectedBy = collectedBy;
            IsCollected = true;
            CollectedDate = DateTime.Now;
        }

        private static byte[] GetGuidUniquePart(Guid guid)
        {
            var first8 = guid.ToString("N").AsSpan(0, 8);
            var value = int.Parse(first8, NumberStyles.HexNumber);
            Span<byte> buf = stackalloc byte[4];
            BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt32BigEndian(buf, value);
            return buf.ToArray();
        }

        public void SetSubscriber(string nationalId, string? vehicleNumber = null, string? cardNumber = null)
        {
            Price = 0;
            IsSubscriber = true;
            IsCashierCollected = true;
            VehicleNumber = vehicleNumber;
            SubscriberNationalId = nationalId;
            CardNumber = cardNumber;
        }

        public void SetPrice(decimal price) => Price = price;

        public void SetExitDate() => EndDate = DateTime.Now;

        public static byte[] ParseUniqueCode(string code)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(code))
                throw new ArgumentException("Invalid ticket code.", nameof(code));

            // "63729C54" -> byte[4]
            return Convert.FromHexString(code);
        }

        public void Archive() => RaiseDomainEvent(new ExitTicketDomainEvent(this));

        public void AddAttachment(string filePath)
        {
            var attachment = TicketAttachment.Create(Id, filePath);
            _ticketAttachments.Add(attachment);
        }

        public void SetExceedPrice(decimal exceedPrice)
        {
            if (exceedPrice < 0)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(exceedPrice), "Exceed price cannot be negative.");

            ExceedPrice = exceedPrice;
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Domain\Entities\TicketArchive.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.EntitiesHelper;

namespace NPark.Domain.Entities
{
    public sealed class TicketArchive : Entity<Guid>
    {
        private readonly List<TicketArchiveAttachment> _ticketArchiveAttachments = new();

        public DateTime StartDate { get; private set; }

        public DateTime EndDate { get; private set; }

        public decimal Price { get; private set; }

        public string? VehicleNumber { get; private set; } = null;

        public decimal ExceedPrice { get; private set; } = 0;

        public Guid? CollectedBy { get; private set; }

        public decimal TotalPrice => Price + ExceedPrice;

        public bool IsCollected { get; private set; }

        public DateTime CollectedDate { get; private set; }

        public byte[] UniqueGuidPart { get; private set; } = Array.Empty<byte>();

        public string UniqueCode { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

        public Guid GateId { get; private set; }

        public Guid ExitGateId { private set; get; }

        public Guid UserId { get; private set; }

        public bool IsCashierCollected { get; private set; } = false;

        public User User { get; private set; } = default!;

        public User? UserCollector { get; private set; }

        public ParkingGate ParkingGate { get; private set; } = default!;
        public ParkingGate ExitParkingGate { get; private set; } = default!;

        public bool IsSubscriber { get; private set; } = false;

        public string? SubscriberNationalId { get; private set; }

        public string? CardNumber { get; private set; } = null;

        public IReadOnlyCollection<TicketArchiveAttachment> TicketArchiveAttachments
            => _ticketArchiveAttachments.AsReadOnly();

        private TicketArchive()
        {
        }

        public static TicketArchive CreateFromTicket(Ticket ticket)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(ticket);

            var ticketArchive = new TicketArchive
            {
                Id = ticket.Id,
                StartDate = ticket.StartDate,
                EndDate = ticket.EndDate ?? DateTime.Now,
                Price = ticket.Price,
                VehicleNumber = ticket.VehicleNumber,
                ExceedPrice = ticket.ExceedPrice,
                CollectedBy = ticket.CollectedBy,
                IsCollected = ticket.IsCollected,
                CollectedDate = ticket.CollectedDate ?? DateTime.Now,
                UniqueGuidPart = ticket.UniqueGuidPart,
                UniqueCode = ticket.UniqueCode,
                GateId = ticket.GateId,
                ExitGateId = ticket.ExitGateId ?? Guid.Empty,
                UserId = ticket.UserId,
                IsCashierCollected = ticket.IsCashierCollected,

                // Existing navigation references.
                // EF will save using FK values above.
                User = ticket.User,
                UserCollector = ticket.UserCollector,
                ParkingGate = ticket.ParkingGate,

                IsSubscriber = ticket.IsSubscriber,
                SubscriberNationalId = ticket.SubscriberNationalId,
                CardNumber = ticket.CardNumber
            };

            ticketArchive.CopyAttachmentsFromTicket(ticket);

            return ticketArchive;
        }

        public void SetCollected(Guid id, DateTime? now = null)
        {
            IsCollected = true;
            CollectedBy = id;
            CollectedDate = now ?? DateTime.Now;
        }

        private void CopyAttachmentsFromTicket(Ticket ticket)
        {
            if (ticket.TicketAttachments is null || ticket.TicketAttachments.Count == 0)
                return;

            foreach (var attachment in ticket.TicketAttachments)
            {
                AddAttachmentSnapshot(attachment.FilePath);
            }
        }

        private void AddAttachmentSnapshot(string filePath)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filePath))
                return;

            var archiveAttachment = TicketArchiveAttachment.Create(Id, filePath);
            _ticketArchiveAttachments.Add(archiveAttachment);
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Domain\Entities\TicketCollectionTransaction.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.EntitiesHelper;
using NPark.Domain.Enums;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace NPark.Domain.Entities
{
    public sealed class TicketCollectionTransaction : Entity<Guid>
    {
        private readonly List<TicketCollectionTransactionLine> _lines = new();
        private readonly List<TicketCollectionTransactionTicket> _tickets = new();

        private TicketCollectionTransaction()
        {
        }

        public TicketCollectionTransactionType Type { get; private set; }

        public Guid GateId { get; private set; }

        public ParkingGate Gate { get; private set; } = null!;

        public Guid CollectedBy { get; private set; }

        public User Collector { get; private set; } = null!;

        public DateTime CollectedAt { get; private set; }

        public int TotalItemsCollected { get; private set; }

        public decimal TotalAmountCollected { get; private set; }

        public IReadOnlyCollection<TicketCollectionTransactionLine> Lines
            => _lines.AsReadOnly();

        public IReadOnlyCollection<TicketCollectionTransactionTicket> Tickets
            => _tickets.AsReadOnly();

        public static TicketCollectionTransaction Create(
            TicketCollectionTransactionType type,
            Guid gateId,
            Guid collectedBy,
            DateTime collectedAt)
        {
            if (gateId == Guid.Empty)
                throw new ArgumentException("Gate id is required.", nameof(gateId));

            if (collectedBy == Guid.Empty)
                throw new ArgumentException("Collector id is required.", nameof(collectedBy));

            return new TicketCollectionTransaction
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                Type = type,
                GateId = gateId,
                CollectedBy = collectedBy,
                CollectedAt = collectedAt,
                TotalItemsCollected = 0,
                TotalAmountCollected = 0
            };
        }

        public void AddTicket(TicketCollectionTransactionTicket ticket)
        {
            ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(ticket);

            if (ticket.TicketCollectionTransactionId != Id)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Ticket snapshot belongs to another collection transaction.");

            _tickets.Add(ticket);

            RecalculateTotals();
        }

        public void BuildLinesFromTickets()
        {
            _lines.Clear();

            if (_tickets.Count == 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot build collection lines without ticket snapshots.");

            var groups = _tickets
                .GroupBy(x => x.ResponsibleUserId)
                .Select(g => TicketCollectionTransactionLine.Create(
                    transactionId: Id,
                    responsibleUserId: g.Key,
                    itemsCount: g.Count(),
                    totalAmount: g.Sum(x => x.AmountCollected)))
                .ToList();

            _lines.AddRange(groups);

            RecalculateTotals();
        }

        private void RecalculateTotals()
        {
            TotalItemsCollected = _tickets.Count;
            TotalAmountCollected = _tickets.Sum(x => x.AmountCollected);
        }
    }
}

        public TicketCollectionTransaction Transaction { get; private set; } = null!;

        /// <summary>
        /// In EnterTickets: user who created the ticket.
        /// In ExceedTransactions: user who created/collected the exceed transaction.
        /// </summary>
        public Guid ResponsibleUserId { get; private set; }

        public User ResponsibleUser { get; private set; } = null!;

        public int ItemsCount { get; private set; }

        public decimal TotalAmount { get; private set; }

        public static TicketCollectionTransactionLine Create(
            Guid transactionId,
            Guid responsibleUserId,
            int itemsCount,
            decimal totalAmount)
        {
            if (transactionId == Guid.Empty)
                throw new ArgumentException("Transaction id is required.", nameof(transactionId));

            if (responsibleUserId == Guid.Empty)
                throw new ArgumentException("Responsible user id is required.", nameof(responsibleUserId));

            if (itemsCount <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(itemsCount), "Items count must be greater than zero.");

            if (totalAmount < 0)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(totalAmount), "Total amount cannot be negative.");

            return new TicketCollectionTransactionLine
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                TicketCollectionTransactionId = transactionId,
                ResponsibleUserId = responsibleUserId,
                ItemsCount = itemsCount,
                TotalAmount = totalAmount
            };
        }

﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.EntitiesHelper;

namespace NPark.Domain.Entities
{
    public sealed class TicketExceedTransaction : Entity<Guid>
    {
        private readonly List<Sanction> _sanctions = new();

        private TicketExceedTransaction()
        {
        }

        // -----------------------------
        // Ticket Snapshot - No FK to Ticket
        // -----------------------------
        public Guid TicketIdSnapshot { get; private set; }

        public string TicketUniqueCode { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
        public DateTime TicketStartDate { get; private set; }
        public DateTime? TicketEndDate { get; private set; }
        public decimal TicketPrice { get; private set; }
        public decimal TicketOldExceedPrice { get; private set; }
        public decimal TotalPriceAfterExceed { get; private set; }

        public string? VehicleNumber { get; private set; }
        public string? CardNumber { get; private set; }
        public bool IsSubscriber { get; private set; }
        public string? SubscriberNationalId { get; private set; }

        // Snapshot from Ticket itself
        public Guid TicketGateId { get; private set; }

        public Guid? TicketExitGateId { get; private set; }

        // -----------------------------
        // Transaction Data
        // -----------------------------
        public decimal ExceedAmount { get; private set; }

        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; private set; }

        // -----------------------------
        // Relations
        // -----------------------------
        public Guid GateId { get; private set; }

        public ParkingGate Gate { get; private set; } = null!;

        public Guid UserCollectId { get; private set; }
        public User UserCollector { get; private set; } = null!;

        public Guid? SuperVisorCollectorId { get; private set; }
        public User? SuperVisorCollector { get; private set; }
        public DateTime? SuperVisorCollectedAt { get; private set; }

        public IReadOnlyCollection<Sanction> Sanctions => _sanctions;

        public static TicketExceedTransaction Create(
            Ticket ticket,
            decimal oldExceedPrice,
            decimal exceedAmount,
            Guid gateId,
            Guid userCollectId,
            IReadOnlyCollection<Sanction> sanctions)
        {
            if (ticket is null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ticket));

            if (sanctions is null || sanctions.Count == 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Sanctions are required.", nameof(sanctions));

            if (exceedAmount < 0)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(exceedAmount), "Exceed amount cannot be negative.");

            var transaction = new TicketExceedTransaction
            {
                // Important: Id = TicketId, and there is NO FK relation with Ticket.
                Id = ticket.Id,

                TicketIdSnapshot = ticket.Id,
                TicketUniqueCode = ticket.UniqueCode,
                TicketStartDate = ticket.StartDate,
                TicketEndDate = ticket.EndDate,
                TicketPrice = ticket.Price,
                TicketOldExceedPrice = oldExceedPrice,
                ExceedAmount = exceedAmount,
                TotalPriceAfterExceed = ticket.Price + exceedAmount,

                VehicleNumber = ticket.VehicleNumber,
                CardNumber = ticket.CardNumber,
                IsSubscriber = ticket.IsSubscriber,
                SubscriberNationalId = ticket.SubscriberNationalId,

                TicketGateId = ticket.GateId,
                TicketExitGateId = ticket.ExitGateId,

                GateId = gateId,
                UserCollectId = userCollectId,

                // Important: initially null
                SuperVisorCollectorId = null,
                SuperVisorCollectedAt = null,

                CreatedAt = DateTime.Now
            };

            transaction._sanctions.AddRange(sanctions);

            return transaction;
        }

        public void SetSupervisorCollected(Guid supervisorId, DateTime? now)
        {
            if (supervisorId == Guid.Empty)
                throw new ArgumentException("Supervisor id is required.", nameof(supervisorId));

            if (SuperVisorCollectorId.HasValue)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Ticket exceed transaction is already collected by supervisor.");

            SuperVisorCollectorId = supervisorId;
            SuperVisorCollectedAt = now ?? DateTime.Now;
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure
{
    public class NParkDBContext : DbContext
    {
        public NParkDBContext(DbContextOptions<NParkDBContext> options)
: base(options) { }

        protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
        {
            modelBuilder.ApplySoftDeleteQueryFilter();
            modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof(NParkDBContext).Assembly);
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Authorization\PermissionAuthorizationHandler.cs ==================== 
﻿using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Authorization
{
    public class PermissionAuthorizationHandler : AuthorizationHandler<PermissionRequirement>
    {
        protected override Task HandleRequirementAsync(AuthorizationHandlerContext context, PermissionRequirement requirement)
        {
            var userPermissions = context.User.FindAll("permission").Select(c => c.Value).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            bool hasAnyPermission = requirement.Permissions.Any(p => userPermissions.Contains(p));

            if (hasAnyPermission)
            {
                context.Succeed(requirement);
            }

            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }
    }

    public class PermissionRequirement : IAuthorizationRequirement
    {
        public List<string> Permissions { get; }

        public PermissionRequirement(IEnumerable<string> permissions)
        {
            Permissions = permissions.Select(p => p.Trim()).ToList();
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Authorization\PermissionPolicyProvider.cs ==================== 
﻿using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Authorization
{
    public class PermissionPolicyProvider : IAuthorizationPolicyProvider
    {
        private const string POLICY_PREFIX = "PERMISSION_";
        public DefaultAuthorizationPolicyProvider FallbackPolicyProvider { get; }

        public PermissionPolicyProvider(IOptions<AuthorizationOptions> options)
        {
            FallbackPolicyProvider = new DefaultAuthorizationPolicyProvider(options);
        }

        public Task<AuthorizationPolicy> GetDefaultPolicyAsync()
            => FallbackPolicyProvider.GetDefaultPolicyAsync();

        public Task<AuthorizationPolicy?> GetFallbackPolicyAsync()
            => FallbackPolicyProvider.GetFallbackPolicyAsync();

        public Task<AuthorizationPolicy?> GetPolicyAsync(string policyName)
        {
            if (policyName.StartsWith(POLICY_PREFIX))
            {
                var permissionSegment = policyName.Substring(POLICY_PREFIX.Length);
                var permissions = permissionSegment.Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries);

                var policy = new AuthorizationPolicyBuilder()
                    .RequireAuthenticatedUser()
                    .AddRequirements(new PermissionRequirement(permissions))
                    .Build();

                return Task.FromResult<AuthorizationPolicy?>(policy);
            }

            return FallbackPolicyProvider.GetPolicyAsync(policyName);
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Bootstrap\Bootstrap.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Abstraction;
using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Infrastracture.Bootstrap;
using BuildingBlock.Infrastracture.Interceptors;
using BuildingBlock.Infrastracture.Options;
using BuildingBlock.Infrastracture.Repositories;
using BuildingBlock.Infrastracture.Service;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction.Security;
using NPark.Application.Options;
using NPark.Infrastructure.Authorization;
using NPark.Infrastructure.Options;
using NPark.Infrastructure.Services;
using NPark.Infrastructure.Services.Camera;
using NPark.Infrastructure.Services.Mqtt;
using NPark.Infrastructure.Services.Seeders;
using NPark.Infrastructure.Services.Token;
using System.Text;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Bootstrap
{
    public static class Bootstrap
    {
        public static IServiceCollection InfrastructureInjection(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            services.Configure<EncryptionOptions>(configuration.GetSection("EncryptionOptions"));
            services.Configure<SalaryConfig>(configuration.GetSection("SalaryConfig"));
            services.AddDbConfig(configuration);
            services.AddScoped<IDbContextProvider, DbContextProvider<NParkDBContext>>();
            services.AddScoped<IAuditLogger, AuditLogger>();
            services.AddScoped<IDashboardService, DashboardService>();
            services.AddSecurity();
            services.AddEfInfrastructure();
            services.AddBuildingBlockAuditingAndSoftDelete();
            services.EnsureDatabaseInitializationAndUpToDate();
            services.AddHttpClient();
            services.AddSingleton<ICacheService, MemoryCacheService>();
            services.AddSingleton<IByteVerificationService, ByteVerificationService>();
            services.AddMediaService();
            services.AddQrCodeService();
            services.AddSeeding();
            services.AddAuth(configuration);
            services.AddHttpClient("device-http", c =>
            {
            }).SetHandlerLifetime(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5));

            services.AddScoped<ISendProtocol, SendProtocol>();
            services.AddScoped<ITokenReader, JwtReader>();

            services.Configure<MqttOptions>(configuration.GetSection("Mqtt"));
            services.Configure<MqttHeartbeatOptions>(configuration.GetSection("MqttHeartbeat"));
            services.AddHostedService<MqttNetworkHeartbeatService>();

            services.AddSingleton<IMqttPublisher, MqttPublisher>();
            services.Configure<CameraOptions>(configuration.GetSection("Camera"));

            services.AddHttpClient<ICameraSnapshotService, OnvifCameraSnapshotService>((sp, client) =>
            {
                var options = sp.GetRequiredService<Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptions<CameraOptions>>().Value;
                client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(options.TimeoutSeconds <= 0 ? 15 : options.TimeoutSeconds);
            });
            services.Configure<MqttNetworkSubscriberOptions>(
    configuration.GetSection(MqttNetworkSubscriberOptions.SectionName));
            services.AddHostedService<MqttNetworkSubscriberService>();
            services.AddSingleton<IMqttExitQrPacketDecoder, MqttExitQrPacketDecoder>();
            return services;
        }

        private static IServiceCollection AddDbConfig(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            string connectionString = configuration.GetConnectionString("Database")!;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
                throw new ArgumentException("A valid database connection string must be provided.");

            services.AddDbContext<NParkDBContext>((sp, options) =>
            {
                options.UseSqlServer(connectionString);
                options.AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<SoftDeleteEntitiesInterceptor>());
                options.AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<AuditableEntitiesInterceptor>());
                options.AddInterceptors(sp.GetRequiredService<DomainEventsInterceptor>());
            });

            return services;
        }

        #region Database ifnitialization

        private static void EnsureDatabaseInitializationAndUpToDate(this IServiceCollection services)
        {
            using var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            var dbContext = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<NParkDBContext>();
            var logger = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILogger<NParkDBContext>>();

            try
            {
                if (!dbContext.Database.CanConnect())
                {
                    dbContext.Database.EnsureCreated();
                    EnsureMigrationHistoryTableExists(dbContext, logger);
                    MarkMigrationsAsApplied(dbContext, logger);
                    logger.LogInformation("Database created, and migrations marked as applied.");
                    return;
                }

                ApplyOrMarkPendingMigrations(dbContext, logger);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger.LogError($"An error occurred during database initialization: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private static void EnsureMigrationHistoryTableExists(NParkDBContext dbContext, ILogger<NParkDBContext> logger)
        {
            const string checkTableQuery = @"
                IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
                               WHERE TABLE_NAME = '__EFMigrationsHistory')
                BEGIN
                    CREATE TABLE __EFMigrationsHistory (
                        MigrationId NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                        ProductVersion NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
                    );
                END";

            dbContext.Database.ExecuteSqlRaw(checkTableQuery);
            logger.LogInformation("Verified or created the __EFMigrationsHistory table.");
        }

        private static void MarkMigrationsAsApplied(NParkDBContext dbContext, ILogger<NParkDBContext> logger)
        {
            var pendingMigrations = dbContext.Database.GetPendingMigrations();

            if (pendingMigrations.Any())
            {
                logger.LogInformation($"Marking migrations as applied: {string.Join(", ", pendingMigrations)}");
                var efCurrenVersion = GetCurrentEfVersion();
                foreach (var migrationId in pendingMigrations)
                {
                    dbContext.Database.ExecuteSqlInterpolated($@"
                            INSERT INTO __EFMigrationsHistory (MigrationId, ProductVersion)
                            VALUES ({migrationId}, {efCurrenVersion})");
                }

                logger.LogInformation("Migrations marked as applied successfully.");
            }
            else
            {
                logger.LogInformation("No migrations to mark as applied.");
            }
        }

        private static string GetCurrentEfVersion()
        {
            var efAssembly = typeof(DbContext).Assembly;
            var version = efAssembly.GetName().Version;
            return version != null ? $"{version.Major}.{version.Minor}.{version.Build}" : "Unknown";
        }

        private static void ApplyOrMarkPendingMigrations(NParkDBContext dbContext, ILogger<NParkDBContext> logger)
        {
            var pendingMigrations = dbContext.Database.GetPendingMigrations();

            if (pendingMigrations.Any())
            {
                logger.LogInformation($"Pending migrations detected: {string.Join(", ", pendingMigrations)}");

                dbContext.Database.Migrate();
                logger.LogInformation($"Applied migrations: {string.Join(", ", pendingMigrations)}");
            }
            else
            {
                logger.LogInformation("No pending migrations.");
            }
        }

        #endregion Database ifnitialization

        #region Seeding Database

        private static IServiceCollection AddSeeding(this IServiceCollection services)
        {
            services.AddScoped<ISeeder, PermissionSeeder>();
            services.AddScoped<ISeeder, RoleSeeder>();
            services.AddScoped<ISeeder, RolePermissionSeeder>();
            services.AddScoped<ISeeder, IUserSeeder>();
            services.AddScoped<IEnsureSeeding, EnsureSeeding>();
            services.AddHostedService<SeedingHostedService>();

            return services;
        }

        private sealed class SeedingHostedService : IHostedService
        {
            private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
            private readonly ILogger<SeedingHostedService> _logger;

            public SeedingHostedService(IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory, ILogger<SeedingHostedService> logger)
            {
                _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
                _logger = logger;
            }

            public async Task StartAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
            {
                using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
                var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<NParkDBContext>();

                //await db.Database.MigrateAsync(cancellationToken); if want to ensure!

                var seeder = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IEnsureSeeding>();
                _logger.LogInformation("Starting database seeding (HostedService)...");
                await seeder.SeedDatabaseAsync();
                _logger.LogInformation("Database seeding completed (HostedService).");
            }

            public Task StopAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        #endregion Seeding Database

        #region Authentication & Authorization

        private static IServiceCollection AddAuth(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            services.AddScoped<IJwtProvider, JwtProvider>();
            var jwtSettings = new JwtOption();
            configuration.GetSection(JwtOption.SectionName).Bind(jwtSettings);

            services.Configure<JwtOption>(
                configuration.GetSection(JwtOption.SectionName));
            services.AddAuthentication(defaultScheme: JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
                        .AddJwtBearer(options =>
                        {
                            options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
                            {
                                ValidateIssuer = true,
                                ValidateAudience = true,
                                ValidateLifetime = true,
                                ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
                                ValidIssuer = jwtSettings.Issuer,
                                ValidAudience = jwtSettings.Audience,
                                IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(
                                    Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jwtSettings.Secret))
                            };
                        });

            services.AddSingleton<IAuthorizationPolicyProvider, PermissionPolicyProvider>();
            services.AddScoped<IAuthorizationHandler, PermissionAuthorizationHandler>();

            services.AddAuthorization(options =>
            {
                options.DefaultPolicy = new AuthorizationPolicyBuilder()
                    .RequireAuthenticatedUser()
                    .Build();
            });

            return services;
        }

        #endregion Authentication & Authorization
    }
}

﻿using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Configuration
{
    public sealed class AuditLogConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<AuditLog>
    {
        public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<AuditLog> b)
        {
            b.ToTable("AuditLogs");

            b.HasKey(x => x.Id);

            b.Property(x => x.CreatedAtUtc)
                .IsRequired();

            b.Property(x => x.EventName)
                .IsRequired()
                .HasMaxLength(200);

            b.Property(x => x.EventCategory)
                .HasMaxLength(100);

            b.Property(x => x.Role)
                .HasMaxLength(100);

            b.Property(x => x.RequestPath)
                .HasMaxLength(400);

            b.Property(x => x.HttpMethod)
                .HasMaxLength(10);

            b.Property(x => x.ErrorCode)
                .HasMaxLength(200);

            b.Property(x => x.ErrorMessage)
                .HasMaxLength(1000);

            b.Property(x => x.CorrelationId)
                .HasMaxLength(64);

            b.Property(x => x.TraceId)
                .HasMaxLength(64);
        }
    }
}

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Configuration\TicketArchiveConfiguration.cs ==================== 
﻿using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Configuration
{
    internal sealed class TicketArchiveConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<TicketArchive>
    {
        public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<TicketArchive> builder)
        {
            builder.HasKey(t => t.Id);
            builder.Property(t => t.Id)
    .ValueGeneratedNever();
            builder.Property(t => t.StartDate).IsRequired();
            builder.Property(t => t.EndDate).IsRequired();
            builder.Property(t => t.CollectedBy).IsRequired(false);
            builder.Property(t => t.ExitGateId).IsRequired();
            builder.Property(t => t.VehicleNumber).IsRequired(false);

                .IsRequired()

            builder.Property(x => x.TicketEndDate)
                .HasColumnType("datetime2");

            builder.Property(x => x.TicketPrice)
                .IsRequired()
                .HasPrecision(18, 2);

            builder.Property(x => x.TicketOldExceedPrice)
                .IsRequired()
                .HasPrecision(18, 2);

            builder.Property(x => x.ExceedAmount)
                .IsRequired()

            builder.Property(x => x.TotalPriceAfterExceed)
                .IsRequired()
                .HasPrecision(18, 2);

            builder.Property(x => x.VehicleNumber)
                .HasMaxLength(50);

            builder.Property(x => x.CardNumber)
                .HasMaxLength(50);

            builder.Property(x => x.SubscriberNationalId)
                .HasMaxLength(50);

            builder.Property(x => x.IsSubscriber)
                .IsRequired();

            builder.Property(x => x.TicketGateId)
                .IsRequired();

            builder.Property(x => x.TicketExitGateId)
                .IsRequired(false);

            builder.Property(x => x.CreatedAt)
                .IsRequired()
                .HasColumnType("datetime2");

            builder.Property(x => x.SuperVisorCollectedAt)
              .HasColumnType("datetime2")
              .IsRequired(false);

            // -----------------------------
            // Gate Relation
            // -----------------------------
            builder.HasOne(x => x.Gate)
                .WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(x => x.GateId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            // -----------------------------
            // User Collector Relation
            // -----------------------------
            builder.HasOne(x => x.UserCollector)
                .WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(x => x.UserCollectId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            // -----------------------------
            // Supervisor Collector Relation - Nullable
            // -----------------------------
            builder.HasOne(x => x.SuperVisorCollector)
                .WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(x => x.SuperVisorCollectorId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

            // -----------------------------
            // Many-to-Many with Sanctions
            // -----------------------------
            builder.HasMany(x => x.Sanctions)
                .WithMany()
                .UsingEntity<Dictionary<string, object>>(
                    "TicketExceedTransactionSanctions",
                    right => right
                        .HasOne<Sanction>()
                        .WithMany()
                        .HasForeignKey("SanctionId")
                        .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict),
                    left => left
                        .HasOne<TicketExceedTransaction>()
                        .WithMany()
                        .HasForeignKey("TicketExceedTransactionId")
                        .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict),
                    join =>
                    {
                        join.ToTable("TicketExceedTransactionSanctions");

                        join.HasKey("TicketExceedTransactionId", "SanctionId");

                        join.HasIndex("SanctionId");
                    });

            builder.Navigation(x => x.Sanctions)
                .UsePropertyAccessMode(PropertyAccessMode.Field);

            builder.HasIndex(x => x.TicketIdSnapshot)
                .IsUnique();

            builder.HasIndex(x => x.GateId);
            builder.HasIndex(x => x.UserCollectId);
            builder.HasIndex(x => x.SuperVisorCollectorId);
            builder.HasIndex(x => x.CreatedAt);
        }
    }
