        public int Port { get; set; }
        public string ClientId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string? Username { get; set; }
        public string? Password { get; set; }
        public int KeepAliveSeconds { get; set; } = 20;
        public int ReconnectSeconds { get; set; } = 3;
        public bool UseTls { get; set; } = true;
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Services\AuditLogger.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Application.Repositories;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction.Security;
using NPark.Application.Shared.Dto;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Services
{
    public sealed class AuditLogger : IAuditLogger
    {
        private readonly IGenericRepository<AuditLog> _repo;
        private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
        private readonly ITokenReader _tokenReader;
        private readonly ILogger<AuditLogger> _logger;

        public AuditLogger(
            IGenericRepository<AuditLog> repo,
            IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
            ITokenReader tokenReader,
            ILogger<AuditLogger> logger)
        {
            _repo = repo;
            _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
            _tokenReader = tokenReader;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        public async Task LogAsync(AuditLogEntry entry, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            var http = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext;

            Guid? tokenUserId = null;
            Guid? tokenGateId = null;
            string? tokenRole = null;

            if (http?.User?.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
            {
                var info = _tokenReader.ReadFromPrincipal(http.User);
                tokenUserId = info.UserId;
                tokenGateId = info.GateId;
                tokenRole = info.Role;
            }

            var correlationId = entry.CorrelationId
                ?? http?.Items["__CorrelationId"]?.ToString()
                ?? http?.TraceIdentifier;

            var traceId = entry.TraceId ?? Activity.Current?.Id;

            var audit = new AuditLog
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,

                EventName = entry.EventName,
                EventCategory = entry.EventCategory,

                IsSuccess = entry.IsSuccess,
                StatusCode = entry.StatusCode,
                ErrorCode = entry.ErrorCode,
                ErrorMessage = entry.ErrorMessage,

                UserId = entry.UserId ?? tokenUserId,
                GateId = entry.GateId ?? tokenGateId,
                Role = entry.Role ?? tokenRole,

                RequestPath = entry.RequestPath ?? http?.Request.Path.Value,
                HttpMethod = entry.HttpMethod ?? http?.Request.Method,

                CorrelationId = correlationId,
                TraceId = traceId,

                ExtraJson = entry.Extra is null
                    ? null
                    : JsonSerializer.Serialize(entry.Extra)
            };

            try
            {
                await _repo.AddAsync(audit, ct);
                await _repo.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to write audit log for {EventName}", entry.EventName);
            }
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Services\DashboardService.cs ==================== 
﻿using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Services
{
    public interface IDashboardService
    {
        Task<DashboardDto> GetDashboardAsync(
            DateOnly? from = null,
            DateOnly? to = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }

    public sealed class DashboardService : IDashboardService
    {
        private readonly NParkDBContext _context;

        public DashboardService(NParkDBContext context)
        {
            _context = context ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
        }

        public async Task<DashboardDto> GetDashboardAsync(
            DateOnly? from = null,
            DateOnly? to = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.Now);

            var fromDate = from ?? today;
            var toDate = to ?? fromDate;

            if (toDate < fromDate)
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("To date must be greater than or equal to From date.");
            }

            var start = fromDate.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue);
            var end = toDate.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue).AddDays(1);

            // =========================================================
            // 1) BASE QUERIES
            // =========================================================
            var liveTicketsQuery = _context.Set<Ticket>().AsNoTracking();
            var archivedTicketsQuery = _context.Set<TicketArchive>().AsNoTracking();
            var ticketExceedTransactionsQuery = _context.Set<TicketExceedTransaction>().AsNoTracking();

            var liveEnteredInPeriodQuery = liveTicketsQuery
                .Where(t => t.StartDate >= start && t.StartDate < end);

            var archivedEnteredInPeriodQuery = archivedTicketsQuery
                .Where(t => t.StartDate >= start && t.StartDate < end);

            var archivedExitedInPeriodQuery = archivedTicketsQuery
                .Where(t => t.EndDate >= start && t.EndDate < end);

            var ticketsEnteredBeforePeriodAndStillInsideQuery = liveTicketsQuery
                .Where(t => t.StartDate < start);

            var exceedTransactionsInPeriodQuery = ticketExceedTransactionsQuery
                .Where(t => t.CreatedAt >= start && t.CreatedAt < end);

            // =========================================================
            // 2) TICKETS COUNTS
            // =========================================================
            var liveEnteredInPeriodCount = await liveEnteredInPeriodQuery
                .CountAsync(cancellationToken);

            var archivedEnteredInPeriodCount = await archivedEnteredInPeriodQuery
                .CountAsync(cancellationToken);

            var ticketEnterInPeriod = liveEnteredInPeriodCount + archivedEnteredInPeriodCount;

            var ticketEnterBeforePeriodButNotExitYet = await ticketsEnteredBeforePeriodAndStillInsideQuery
                .CountAsync(cancellationToken);

            var exitTicketsCount = await archivedExitedInPeriodQuery
                .CountAsync(cancellationToken);

            // =========================================================
            // 3) CURRENT VEHICLES INSIDE + OCCUPANCY
            // =========================================================
            var currentVehiclesInside = await liveTicketsQuery
                .CountAsync(cancellationToken);

            var activeTicketsCount = currentVehiclesInside;

            var parkingConfig = await _context.Set<ParkingSystemConfiguration>()
                .AsNoTracking()
                .OrderByDescending(c => c.Id)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

            var totalParkingSlots = parkingConfig?.AllowedParkingSlots ?? 0;

            decimal occupancyPercentage = 0m;
            int estimatedFreeSlots = 0;

            if (totalParkingSlots > 0)
            {
                occupancyPercentage = (decimal)currentVehiclesInside / totalParkingSlots * 100m;
                estimatedFreeSlots = Math.Max(0, totalParkingSlots - currentVehiclesInside);
            }

            // =========================================================
            // 4) TICKET BASE REVENUE DATASET
            // =========================================================
            var revenueLiveRows = await liveEnteredInPeriodQuery
                .Select(t => new RevenueRow
                {
                    IsCollected = t.IsCollected,
                    IsSubscriber = t.IsSubscriber,
                    TicketPrice = t.Price,
                    CollectedBy = t.CollectedBy,
                    CollectorName = t.UserCollector != null ? t.UserCollector.Name : null,
                    CollectedDate = t.CollectedDate
                })
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            var revenueArchiveRows = await archivedEnteredInPeriodQuery
                .Select(t => new RevenueRow
                {
                    IsCollected = t.IsCollected,
                    IsSubscriber = t.IsSubscriber,
                    TicketPrice = t.Price,
                    CollectedBy = t.CollectedBy,
                    CollectorName = t.UserCollector != null ? t.UserCollector.Name : null,
                    CollectedDate = t.CollectedDate
                })
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            var revenueRows = revenueLiveRows
                .Concat(revenueArchiveRows)
                .ToList();

            // =========================================================
            // 5) EXCEED TRANSACTIONS DATASET
            // =========================================================
            var exceedRows = await exceedTransactionsInPeriodQuery
                .Select(t => new ExceedTransactionRow
                {
                    Id = t.Id,
                    GateId = t.GateId,
                    ExceedAmount = t.ExceedAmount,
                    IsSubscriber = t.IsSubscriber,
                    IsSupervisorCollected = t.SuperVisorCollectorId.HasValue,
                    SupervisorCollectorId = t.SuperVisorCollectorId,
                    SupervisorCollectorName = t.SuperVisorCollector != null
                        ? t.SuperVisorCollector.Name
                        : null,
                    CreatedAt = t.CreatedAt,
                    SupervisorCollectedAt = t.SuperVisorCollectedAt
                })
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            // =========================================================
            // 6) REVENUE CALCULATION
            // =========================================================
            var ticketBaseRevenue = revenueRows
                .Sum(x => x.TicketPrice);

            var collectedTicketBaseRevenue = revenueRows
                .Where(x => x.IsCollected)
                .Sum(x => x.TicketPrice);

            var pendingTicketBaseRevenue = revenueRows
                .Where(x => !x.IsCollected)
                .Sum(x => x.TicketPrice);

            var totalExceedRevenue = exceedRows
                .Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount);

            var collectedExceedRevenue = exceedRows
                .Where(x => x.IsSupervisorCollected)
                .Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount);

            var pendingExceedRevenue = exceedRows
                .Where(x => !x.IsSupervisorCollected)
                .Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount);

            var totalRevenue = ticketBaseRevenue + totalExceedRevenue;

            var collectedRevenue = collectedTicketBaseRevenue + collectedExceedRevenue;

            var pendingRevenue = pendingTicketBaseRevenue + pendingExceedRevenue;

            // =========================================================
            // 7) MEMBERSHIP / WALK-IN
            // =========================================================
            var membershipTicketsCount = revenueRows
                .Count(x => x.IsSubscriber);

            var walkInTicketsCount = revenueRows
                .Count(x => !x.IsSubscriber);

            var membershipTicketBaseRevenue = revenueRows
                .Where(x => x.IsSubscriber)
                .Sum(x => x.TicketPrice);

            var walkInTicketBaseRevenue = revenueRows
                .Where(x => !x.IsSubscriber)
                .Sum(x => x.TicketPrice);

            var membershipExceedRevenue = exceedRows
                .Where(x => x.IsSubscriber)
                .Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount);

            var walkInExceedRevenue = exceedRows
                .Where(x => !x.IsSubscriber)
                .Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount);

            var membershipRelatedRevenue = membershipTicketBaseRevenue + membershipExceedRevenue;

            var walkInRevenue = walkInTicketBaseRevenue + walkInExceedRevenue;

            // =========================================================
            // 8) SUBSCRIPTIONS SNAPSHOT
            // =========================================================
            var now = DateTime.Now;

            var subscriptionCount = await _context.Set<ParkingMemberships>()
                .AsNoTracking()
                .CountAsync(cancellationToken);

            var activeSubscriptionCount = await _context.Set<ParkingMemberships>()
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(m => m.EndDate >= now)
                .CountAsync(cancellationToken);

            var inactiveSubscriptionCount = await _context.Set<ParkingMemberships>()
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(m => m.EndDate < now)
                .CountAsync(cancellationToken);

            var membershipsExpiringNext7Days = await _context.Set<ParkingMemberships>()
                .AsNoTracking()
                .CountAsync(
                    m => m.EndDate >= now && m.EndDate <= now.AddDays(7),
                    cancellationToken);

            // =========================================================
            // 9) PARKING DURATION
            // =========================================================
            var exitedDurations = await archivedExitedInPeriodQuery
                .Select(t => EF.Functions.DateDiffMinute(t.StartDate, t.EndDate))
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            int averageDurationMinutes = 0;
            int maxDurationMinutes = 0;

            if (exitedDurations.Count > 0)
            {
                averageDurationMinutes = (int)Math.Round(exitedDurations.Average());
                maxDurationMinutes = exitedDurations.Max();
            }

            // =========================================================
            // 10) EXCEED METRICS
            // =========================================================
            var exceedTransactionsCount = exceedRows.Count;

            var collectedExceedTransactionsCount = exceedRows
                .Count(x => x.IsSupervisorCollected);

            var pendingExceedTransactionsCount = exceedRows
                .Count(x => !x.IsSupervisorCollected);

            var exceededTicketsCount = exceedTransactionsCount;

            var averageExceedPerTransaction = exceedTransactionsCount > 0
                ? totalExceedRevenue / exceedTransactionsCount
                : 0m;

            var averageExceedPerTicket = exceededTicketsCount > 0
                ? totalExceedRevenue / exceededTicketsCount
                : 0m;

            // =========================================================
            // 11) ENTRY GATES STATS
            // =========================================================
            var entryGateLiveRows = await liveEnteredInPeriodQuery
                .Select(t => new EntryGateRow
                {
                    GateId = t.GateId,
                    Price = t.Price,
                    IsCollected = t.IsCollected,
                    CollectedBy = t.CollectedBy,
                    CollectorName = t.UserCollector != null ? t.UserCollector.Name : null
                })
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            var entryGateArchiveRows = await archivedEnteredInPeriodQuery
                .Select(t => new EntryGateRow
                {
                    GateId = t.GateId,
                    Price = t.Price,
                    IsCollected = t.IsCollected,
                    CollectedBy = t.CollectedBy,
                    CollectorName = t.UserCollector != null ? t.UserCollector.Name : null
                })
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            var entryGateRows = entryGateLiveRows
                .Concat(entryGateArchiveRows)
                .ToList();

            var entryGateIds = entryGateRows
                .Select(x => x.GateId)
                .Distinct()
                .ToList();

            var entryGatesLookup = await _context.Set<ParkingGate>()
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(g => entryGateIds.Contains(g.Id))
                .ToDictionaryAsync(g => g.Id, cancellationToken);

            var entryGates = entryGateRows
                .GroupBy(x => x.GateId)
                .Select(g =>
                {
                    entryGatesLookup.TryGetValue(g.Key, out var gate);

                    var collectors = g
                        .Where(x =>
                            x.IsCollected &&
                            x.CollectedBy.HasValue &&
                            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.CollectorName))
                        .GroupBy(x => new
                        {
                            CollectorId = x.CollectedBy!.Value,
                            x.CollectorName
                        })
                        .Select(cg => new GateCollectorSummaryDto
                        {
                            CollectorId = cg.Key.CollectorId,
                            CollectorName = cg.Key.CollectorName!,
                            TicketsCount = cg.Count(),
                            CollectedAmount = cg.Sum(x => x.Price)
                        })
                        .OrderByDescending(x => x.CollectedAmount)
                        .ThenByDescending(x => x.TicketsCount)
                        .ToList();

                    return new EntryGateSummaryDto
                    {
                        GateId = g.Key,
                        GateNumber = gate?.GateNumber ?? 0,
                        TicketsCount = g.Count(),
                        TotalPrice = g.Sum(x => x.Price),
                        CollectedPrice = g
                            .Where(x => x.IsCollected)
                            .Sum(x => x.Price),
                        PendingPrice = g
                            .Where(x => !x.IsCollected)
                            .Sum(x => x.Price),
                        Collectors = collectors
                    };
                })
                .OrderBy(x => x.GateNumber)
                .ToList();

            // =========================================================
            // 12) EXIT GATES STATS
            // =========================================================
            var exitTrafficRows = await archivedExitedInPeriodQuery
                .Where(t => t.ExitGateId != Guid.Empty)
                .Select(t => new ExitTrafficRow
                {
                    GateId = t.ExitGateId
                })
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            var exitGateIds = exitTrafficRows
                .Select(x => x.GateId)
                .Concat(exceedRows.Select(x => x.GateId))
                .Distinct()
                .ToList();

            var exitGatesLookup = await _context.Set<ParkingGate>()
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(g => exitGateIds.Contains(g.Id))
                .ToDictionaryAsync(g => g.Id, cancellationToken);

            var exitGates = exitGateIds
                .Select(gateId =>
                {
                    exitGatesLookup.TryGetValue(gateId, out var gate);

                    var gateTrafficRows = exitTrafficRows
                        .Where(x => x.GateId == gateId)
                        .ToList();

                    var gateExceedRows = exceedRows
                        .Where(x => x.GateId == gateId)
                        .ToList();

                    var supervisors = gateExceedRows
                        .Where(x =>
                            x.IsSupervisorCollected &&
                            x.SupervisorCollectorId.HasValue &&
                            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.SupervisorCollectorName))
                        .GroupBy(x => new
                        {
                            SupervisorId = x.SupervisorCollectorId!.Value,
                            x.SupervisorCollectorName
                        })
                        .Select(sg => new GateSupervisorSummaryDto
                        {
                            SupervisorId = sg.Key.SupervisorId,
                            SupervisorName = sg.Key.SupervisorCollectorName!,
                            TransactionsCount = sg.Count(),
                            CollectedAmount = sg.Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount)
                        })
                        .OrderByDescending(x => x.CollectedAmount)
                        .ThenByDescending(x => x.TransactionsCount)
                        .ToList();

                    return new ExitGateSummaryDto
                    {
                        GateId = gateId,
                        GateNumber = gate?.GateNumber ?? 0,

                        ExitedTicketsCount = gateTrafficRows.Count,

                        ExceedTransactionsCount = gateExceedRows.Count,
                        CollectedExceedTransactionsCount = gateExceedRows
                            .Count(x => x.IsSupervisorCollected),
                        PendingExceedTransactionsCount = gateExceedRows
                            .Count(x => !x.IsSupervisorCollected),

                        TotalExceedAmount = gateExceedRows
                            .Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount),
                        CollectedExceedAmount = gateExceedRows
                            .Where(x => x.IsSupervisorCollected)
                            .Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount),
                        PendingExceedAmount = gateExceedRows
                            .Where(x => !x.IsSupervisorCollected)
                            .Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount),

                        Supervisors = supervisors
                    };
                })
                .OrderBy(x => x.GateNumber)
                .ToList();

            // =========================================================
            // 13) BUSIEST GATE
            // =========================================================
            var busiestGate = entryGates
                .Select(x => new
                {
                    x.GateNumber,
                    TrafficCount = x.TicketsCount
                })
                .Concat(exitGates.Select(x => new
                {
                    x.GateNumber,
                    TrafficCount = x.ExitedTicketsCount
                }))
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.TrafficCount)
                .ThenBy(x => x.GateNumber)
                .FirstOrDefault();

            var busiestGateNumber = busiestGate?.GateNumber ?? 0;
            var busiestGateTicketsCount = busiestGate?.TrafficCount ?? 0;

            // =========================================================
            // 14) TOP TICKET COLLECTOR
            // =========================================================
            var topCollector = revenueRows
                .Where(x =>
                    x.IsCollected &&
                    x.CollectedBy.HasValue &&
                    !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.CollectorName))
                .GroupBy(x => new
                {
                    x.CollectedBy,
                    x.CollectorName
                })
                .Select(g => new
                {
                    CollectorName = g.Key.CollectorName!,
                    TicketsCount = g.Count(),
                    TotalAmount = g.Sum(x => x.TicketPrice)
                })
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.TotalAmount)
                .ThenByDescending(x => x.TicketsCount)
                .FirstOrDefault();

            var topCollectorName = topCollector?.CollectorName;
            var topCollectorAmount = topCollector?.TotalAmount ?? 0m;
            var topCollectorTicketsCount = topCollector?.TicketsCount ?? 0;

            // =========================================================
            // 15) TOP EXCEED COLLECTOR
            // =========================================================
            var topExceedCollector = exceedRows
                .Where(x =>
                    x.IsSupervisorCollected &&
                    x.SupervisorCollectorId.HasValue &&
                    !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.SupervisorCollectorName))
                .GroupBy(x => new
                {
                    x.SupervisorCollectorId,
                    x.SupervisorCollectorName
                })
                .Select(g => new
                {
                    CollectorName = g.Key.SupervisorCollectorName!,
                    TransactionsCount = g.Count(),
                    TotalAmount = g.Sum(x => x.ExceedAmount)
                })
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.TotalAmount)
                .ThenByDescending(x => x.TransactionsCount)
                .FirstOrDefault();

            var topExceedCollectorName = topExceedCollector?.CollectorName;
            var topExceedCollectorAmount = topExceedCollector?.TotalAmount ?? 0m;
            var topExceedCollectorTransactionsCount = topExceedCollector?.TransactionsCount ?? 0;

            // =========================================================
            // 16) BUILD DTO
            // =========================================================
            return new DashboardDto
            {
                // Backward compatibility
                Date = fromDate,

                FromDate = fromDate,
                ToDate = toDate,

                // Subscriptions
                SubscriptionCount = subscriptionCount,
                ActiveSubscriptionCount = activeSubscriptionCount,
                InactiveSubscriptionCount = inactiveSubscriptionCount,
                MembershipsExpiringNext7Days = membershipsExpiringNext7Days,

                // Tickets
                TicketEnterToday = ticketEnterInPeriod,
                TicketEnterNotTodayButNotExitYet = ticketEnterBeforePeriodButNotExitYet,
                ExitTicketsCount = exitTicketsCount,

                CurrentVehiclesInside = currentVehiclesInside,
                ActiveTicketsCount = activeTicketsCount,
                OccupancyPercentage = occupancyPercentage,
                EstimatedFreeSlots = estimatedFreeSlots,

                // Revenue
                TotalRevenue = totalRevenue,
                CollectedRevenue = collectedRevenue,
                PendingRevenue = pendingRevenue,

                TicketBaseRevenue = ticketBaseRevenue,
                CollectedTicketBaseRevenue = collectedTicketBaseRevenue,
                PendingTicketBaseRevenue = pendingTicketBaseRevenue,

                // Membership / Walk-in
                MembershipTicketsCount = membershipTicketsCount,
                WalkInTicketsCount = walkInTicketsCount,
                MembershipRelatedRevenue = membershipRelatedRevenue,
                WalkInRevenue = walkInRevenue,

                // Duration
                AverageDurationMinutes = averageDurationMinutes,
                MaxDurationMinutes = maxDurationMinutes,

                // Exceed
                ExceededTicketsCount = exceededTicketsCount,
                ExceedTransactionsCount = exceedTransactionsCount,
                CollectedExceedTransactionsCount = collectedExceedTransactionsCount,
                PendingExceedTransactionsCount = pendingExceedTransactionsCount,

                TotalExceedRevenue = totalExceedRevenue,
                CollectedExceedRevenue = collectedExceedRevenue,
                PendingExceedRevenue = pendingExceedRevenue,

                AverageExceedPerTicket = averageExceedPerTicket,
                AverageExceedPerTransaction = averageExceedPerTransaction,

                // Gates
                BusiestGateNumber = busiestGateNumber,
                BusiestGateTicketsCount = busiestGateTicketsCount,

                EntryGates = entryGates,
                ExitGates = exitGates,

                // Collectors
                TopCollectorName = topCollectorName,
                TopCollectorAmount = topCollectorAmount,
                TopCollectorTicketsCount = topCollectorTicketsCount,

                TopExceedCollectorName = topExceedCollectorName,
                TopExceedCollectorAmount = topExceedCollectorAmount,
                TopExceedCollectorTransactionsCount = topExceedCollectorTransactionsCount
            };
        }

        private sealed class RevenueRow
        {
            public bool IsCollected { get; init; }

            public bool IsSubscriber { get; init; }

            public decimal TicketPrice { get; init; }

            public Guid? CollectedBy { get; init; }

            public string? CollectorName { get; init; }

            public DateTime? CollectedDate { get; init; }
        }

        private sealed class EntryGateRow
        {
            public Guid GateId { get; init; }

            public decimal Price { get; init; }

            public bool IsCollected { get; init; }

            public Guid? CollectedBy { get; init; }

            public string? CollectorName { get; init; }
        }

        private sealed class ExitTrafficRow
        {
            public Guid GateId { get; init; }
        }

        private sealed class ExceedTransactionRow
        {
            public Guid Id { get; init; }

            public Guid GateId { get; init; }

            public decimal ExceedAmount { get; init; }

            public bool IsSubscriber { get; init; }

            public bool IsSupervisorCollected { get; init; }

            public Guid? SupervisorCollectorId { get; init; }

            public string? SupervisorCollectorName { get; init; }

            public DateTime CreatedAt { get; init; }

            public DateTime? SupervisorCollectedAt { get; init; }
        }
    }

    public sealed class DashboardDto
    {
        // Backward compatibility with old frontend
        public DateOnly Date { get; init; }

        public DateOnly FromDate { get; init; }

        public DateOnly ToDate { get; init; }

        // -----------------------------
        // Subscriptions
        // -----------------------------
        public int SubscriptionCount { get; init; }

        public int ActiveSubscriptionCount { get; init; }

        public int InactiveSubscriptionCount { get; init; }

        public int MembershipsExpiringNext7Days { get; init; }

        // -----------------------------
        // Tickets
        // -----------------------------
        public int TicketEnterToday { get; init; }

        public int TicketEnterNotTodayButNotExitYet { get; init; }

        public int ExitTicketsCount { get; init; }

        public int CurrentVehiclesInside { get; init; }

        public int ActiveTicketsCount { get; init; }

        public decimal OccupancyPercentage { get; init; }

        public int EstimatedFreeSlots { get; init; }

        // -----------------------------
        // Revenue
        // -----------------------------
        public decimal TotalRevenue { get; init; }

        public decimal CollectedRevenue { get; init; }

        public decimal PendingRevenue { get; init; }

        public decimal TicketBaseRevenue { get; init; }

        public decimal CollectedTicketBaseRevenue { get; init; }

        public decimal PendingTicketBaseRevenue { get; init; }

        // -----------------------------
        // Membership / Walk-in
        // -----------------------------
        public int MembershipTicketsCount { get; init; }

        public int WalkInTicketsCount { get; init; }

        public decimal MembershipRelatedRevenue { get; init; }

        public decimal WalkInRevenue { get; init; }

        // -----------------------------
        // Duration
        // -----------------------------
        public int AverageDurationMinutes { get; init; }

        public int MaxDurationMinutes { get; init; }

        // -----------------------------
        // Exceed
        // -----------------------------
        public int ExceededTicketsCount { get; init; }

        public int ExceedTransactionsCount { get; init; }

        public int CollectedExceedTransactionsCount { get; init; }

        public int PendingExceedTransactionsCount { get; init; }

        public decimal TotalExceedRevenue { get; init; }

        public decimal CollectedExceedRevenue { get; init; }

        public decimal PendingExceedRevenue { get; init; }

        public decimal AverageExceedPerTicket { get; init; }

        public decimal AverageExceedPerTransaction { get; init; }

        // -----------------------------
        // Gates
        // -----------------------------
        public int BusiestGateNumber { get; init; }

        public int BusiestGateTicketsCount { get; init; }

// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Services\GenerateComplexByte5FromGuid.cs ==================== 
﻿using NPark.Application.Abstraction.Security;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Services
{
    public class ByteVerificationService : IByteVerificationService
    {
        // Method to generate Byte 5 (same as the one used to generate Byte 5 during creation)
        public byte GenerateComplexByte5FromGuid(byte[] guidBytes)
        {
            // Ensure we have 4 bytes
            if (guidBytes.Length != 4)
                throw new ArgumentException("GUID should be 4 bytes");

            // Step 1: Sum all bytes
            int sum = guidBytes.Sum(b => b);

            // Step 2: Multiply the sum by a constant factor
            int product = sum * 12345; // Constant factor, you can change this value

            // Step 3: XOR operation with a random byte
            byte randomByte = 0xAA; // You can change this byte or make it dynamic
            product ^= randomByte;

            // Step 4: Use a shift operation on the product
            product = (product << 3) | (product >> (32 - 3)); // Left circular shift by 3 bits

            // Step 5: Hash the resulting value (using SHA256 for example)
            using (SHA256 sha256 = SHA256.Create())
            {
                byte[] hashBytes = sha256.ComputeHash(BitConverter.GetBytes(product));

                // Step 6: Return the first byte of the hash as Byte 5
                return hashBytes[0];
            }
        }

        // Method to verify the Byte 5 from the received 5 bytes
        public bool VerifyByte5(byte[] receivedBytes)
        {
            // Ensure the received byte array has exactly 5 bytes
            if (receivedBytes.Length != 5)
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("Received bytes must be 5 bytes.");
            }

            // The first 4 bytes are from the GUID
            byte[] guidBytes = receivedBytes.Take(4).ToArray();

            // The last byte is the received Byte 5
            byte receivedByte5 = receivedBytes[4];

            // Generate the expected Byte 5 from the GUID bytes using the same equation
            byte expectedByte5 = GenerateComplexByte5FromGuid(guidBytes);

            // Compare the expected Byte 5 with the received Byte 5
            return receivedByte5 == expectedByte5;
        }

        public byte[] DecodeBase64ToBytes(string base64String)
        {
            // Decode the Base64 string to byte array
            byte[] decodedBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(base64String);

            // Ensure we are getting exactly 5 bytes
            if (decodedBytes.Length != 5)
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("Decoded byte array must have exactly 5 bytes.");
            }

            return decodedBytes;
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Services\MqttPublisher.cs ==================== 
﻿using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using MQTTnet;
using MQTTnet.Client;
using MQTTnet.Formatter;
using MQTTnet.Protocol;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction;
using NPark.Infrastructure.Options;
using System.Security.Authentication;
using System.Text;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Services
{
    internal sealed class MqttPublisher : IMqttPublisher, IAsyncDisposable
    {
        private readonly ILogger<MqttPublisher> _logger;
        private readonly MqttOptions _options;
        private readonly IMqttClient _client;
        private readonly SemaphoreSlim _connectLock = new(1, 1);

        public MqttPublisher(
            IOptions<MqttOptions> options,
            ILogger<MqttPublisher> logger)
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _options = options.Value;
            _client = new MqttFactory().CreateMqttClient();
        }

        public Task PublishStringAsync(
            string topic,
            string payload,
            MqttPublishOptions options,
            CancellationToken ct)
            => PublishBytesAsync(topic, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(payload), options, ct);

        public async Task PublishBytesAsync(
            string topic,
            ReadOnlyMemory<byte> payload,
            MqttPublishOptions options,
            CancellationToken ct)
        {
            await EnsureConnectedAsync(ct);

            var message = new MqttApplicationMessageBuilder()
                .WithTopic(topic)
                .WithPayload(payload.ToArray())
                .WithQualityOfServiceLevel((MqttQualityOfServiceLevel)Math.Clamp(options.Qos, 0, 2))
                .WithRetainFlag(options.Retain)
                .Build();

            await _client.PublishAsync(message, ct);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "MQTT message published. Topic={Topic}, Qos={Qos}, Retain={Retain}, PayloadSize={PayloadSize}",
                topic,
                options.Qos,
                options.Retain,
                payload.Length);
        }

        private async Task EnsureConnectedAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            if (_client.IsConnected)
                return;

            await _connectLock.WaitAsync(ct);
            try
            {
                if (_client.IsConnected)
                    return;

                var builder = new MqttClientOptionsBuilder()
                    .WithClientId(_options.ClientId)
                    .WithTcpServer(_options.Host, _options.Port)
                    .WithKeepAlivePeriod(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(_options.KeepAliveSeconds))
                    .WithProtocolVersion(MqttProtocolVersion.V311)
                    .WithCleanSession();

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_options.Username))
                {
                    builder = builder.WithCredentials(_options.Username, _options.Password);
                }

                if (_options.UseTls)
                {
                    builder = builder.WithTls(new MqttClientOptionsBuilderTlsParameters
                    {
                        UseTls = true,
                        SslProtocol = SslProtocols.Tls12
                    });
                }

                await _client.ConnectAsync(builder.Build(), ct);

                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "MQTT connected successfully. Host={Host}, Port={Port}, UseTls={UseTls}",
                    _options.Host,
                    _options.Port,
                    _options.UseTls);
            }
            finally
            {
                _connectLock.Release();
            }
        }

        public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                if (_client.IsConnected)
                    await _client.DisconnectAsync();
            }
            catch
            {
            }

            _client.Dispose();
            _connectLock.Dispose();
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Services\SendProtocol.cs ==================== 
﻿using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Services
{
    public class SendProtocol : ISendProtocol
    {
        private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
        private readonly ILogger<SendProtocol> _logger;

        public SendProtocol(IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory, ILogger<SendProtocol> logger)
        {
            _httpClientFactory = httpClientFactory ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(httpClientFactory));
            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
        }

        public async Task<bool> SendHttpBinaryAsync(
        string hostOrIp,
        byte[] bytes,
           CancellationToken ct = default,
        string pathOrRoute = "/config",
        int timeout = 3000
        )
        {
            try
            {
                if (bytes is null || bytes.Length == 0)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("HTTP binary send called with empty payload. Host: {Host} with payload: {Payload}", hostOrIp, bytes);
                    return false;
                }

                var host = hostOrIp.Trim();
                var path = NormalizeRoute(pathOrRoute);

                var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("device-http");
                client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(timeout);

                var uri = new UriBuilder(Uri.UriSchemeHttp, host, -1, path).Uri;

                using var content = new ByteArrayContent(bytes);
                content.Headers.ContentType = new MediaTypeHeaderValue("application/octet-stream");
                content.Headers.ContentLength = bytes.Length;

                using var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, uri)
                {
                    Content = content
                };
                req.Headers.Accept.Add(new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("*/*"));
                req.Headers.ConnectionClose = true;

                using var resp = await client.SendAsync(req, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, ct)
                                             .ConfigureAwait(false);

                if (!resp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("HTTP binary send failed. Url: {Url} Status: {Status}", uri, (int)resp.StatusCode);
                    return false;
                }

                _logger.LogInformation("HTTP binary send success. Url: {Url} Bytes: {payload} Status: {Status}", uri, bytes, (int)resp.StatusCode);
                return true;
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException oce) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(oce, "HTTP binary send timed out. Host: {Host} Timeout: {Timeout}ms", hostOrIp, timeout);
                return false;
            }
            catch (HttpRequestException hre)
            {
                _logger.LogError(hre, "HTTP binary request error to {Host}", hostOrIp);
                return false;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected HTTP binary error to {Host}", hostOrIp);
                return false;
            }
        }

        private static string NormalizeRoute(string? path)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) return "/";
            path = path.Trim();
            if (!path.StartsWith("/")) path = "/" + path;
            return path;
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Services\Camera\OnvifCameraSnapshotService.cs ==================== 
﻿using BuildingBlock.Domain.Results;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Services.Camera
{
    internal sealed class OnvifCameraSnapshotService : ICameraSnapshotService
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
        private readonly ILogger<OnvifCameraSnapshotService> _logger;

        public OnvifCameraSnapshotService(
            HttpClient httpClient,
            ILogger<OnvifCameraSnapshotService> logger)
        {
            _httpClient = httpClient;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        public async Task<Result<CameraSnapshotResult>> GetSnapshotAsync(
            string url,
            string userName,
            string password,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))
            {
                return Result<CameraSnapshotResult>.Fail(
                    Error.Unknown("Camera.Url.Required", "Camera url is required."));
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userName))
            {
                return Result<CameraSnapshotResult>.Fail(
                    Error.Unknown("Camera.UserName.Required", "Camera user name is required."));
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password))
            {
                return Result<CameraSnapshotResult>.Fail(
                    Error.Unknown("Camera.Password.Required", "Camera password is required."));
            }

            try
            {
                using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, url);

                var basicToken = Convert.ToBase64String(
                    Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes($"{userName}:{password}"));

                request.Headers.Authorization =
                    new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Basic", basicToken);

                using var response = await _httpClient.SendAsync(
                    request,
                    HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead,
                    cancellationToken);

                if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    var errorBody = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);

                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Camera direct snapshot failed. Url={Url}, StatusCode={StatusCode}, Body={Body}",
                        url,
                        (int)response.StatusCode,
                        errorBody);

                    return Result<CameraSnapshotResult>.Fail(
                        Error.Unknown(
                            "Camera.Snapshot.DownloadFailed",
                            $"Camera snapshot download failed with status code {(int)response.StatusCode}."));
                }

                var bytes = await response.Content.ReadAsByteArrayAsync(cancellationToken);
                var contentType = response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType ?? "image/jpeg";

                if (bytes.Length == 0)
                {
                    return Result<CameraSnapshotResult>.Fail(
                        Error.Unknown("Camera.Snapshot.Empty", "Camera returned empty snapshot content."));
                }

                return Result<CameraSnapshotResult>.Ok(new CameraSnapshotResult
                {
                    Content = bytes,
                    ContentType = contentType,
                    FileName = $"camera_snapshot_{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.jpg"
                });
            }
            catch (TaskCanceledException ex) when (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Timeout while getting camera snapshot. Url={Url}", url);

                return Result<CameraSnapshotResult>.Fail(
                    Error.Unknown("Camera.Timeout", "Timeout while connecting to camera."));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error while getting direct camera snapshot. Url={Url}", url);

                return Result<CameraSnapshotResult>.Fail(
                    Error.Unknown("Camera.UnexpectedError", "Unexpected camera integration error."));
            }
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Services\Mqtt\MqttExitQrPacketDecoder.cs ==================== 
﻿using NPark.Application.Abstraction;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace BuildingBlock.Infrastracture.Service
{
    public sealed class MqttExitQrPacketDecoder : IMqttExitQrPacketDecoder
    {
        private const byte StartByte = 0x7B;
        private const byte EndByte = 0x7D;
        private const byte PacketConstantByte = 0xBD;

        public MqttExitQrPacketDecodeResult Decode(byte[] payloadBytes)
        {
            if (payloadBytes is null || payloadBytes.Length == 0)
            {
                return Fail(
                    "Mqtt.ExitQr.EmptyPayload",
                    "MQTT payload is empty.");
            }

            // Case 1:
            // Full packet as real bytes:
            // 7B 00 05 BD 43 41 36 39 32 30 31 35 46 34 7D
            if (LooksLikeRealPacket(payloadBytes))
            {
                return DecodePacket(payloadBytes);
            }

            // Case 2:
            // Full packet as ASCII hex:
            // "7b0005bd434136393230313546347d"
            var payloadAsText = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(payloadBytes).Trim();

            if (LooksLikeHexText(payloadAsText))
            {
                var maybePacketBytes = TryConvertHexTextToBytes(payloadAsText);

                if (maybePacketBytes is not null && LooksLikeRealPacket(maybePacketBytes))
                {
                    return DecodePacket(maybePacketBytes);
                }
            }

            // Case 3:
            // RS485 ASCII card number:
            // 43 41 36 39 32 30 31 35 46 34 0D 0A
            // ASCII => CA692015F4\r\n
            var asciiQr = ExtractQrTextFromAsciiBytes(payloadBytes);

            if (IsExactFiveByteQrHex(asciiQr))
            {
                var rawFrameHex = Convert.ToHexString(payloadBytes);
                var myDataBytes = RemoveTrailingCrLf(payloadBytes);
                var myDataHex = Convert.ToHexString(myDataBytes);

                return Success(
                    rawFrameHex: rawFrameHex,
                    hasControllerId: false,
                    controllerId: null,
                    controllerIdHex: string.Empty,
                    myDataHex: myDataHex,
                    qrText: asciiQr);
            }

            // Case 4:
            // Direct text:
            // "CA692015F4"
            var directText = NormalizeQrText(payloadAsText);

            if (IsExactFiveByteQrHex(directText))
            {
                var rawFrameHex = Convert.ToHexString(payloadBytes);
                var myDataHex = Convert.ToHexString(Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(directText));

                return Success(
                    rawFrameHex: rawFrameHex,
                    hasControllerId: false,
                    controllerId: null,
                    controllerIdHex: string.Empty,
                    myDataHex: myDataHex,
                    qrText: directText);
            }

            return Fail(
                "Mqtt.ExitQr.UnsupportedPayload",
                "MQTT payload is not a supported QR format. Expected full packet, ASCII hex QR, or direct 10-character QR hex text.",
                Convert.ToHexString(payloadBytes));
        }

        private static MqttExitQrPacketDecodeResult DecodePacket(byte[] frameBytes)
        {
            var rawFrameHex = Convert.ToHexString(frameBytes);

            if (frameBytes.Length < 6)
            {
                return Fail(
                    "Mqtt.ExitQr.FrameTooShort",
                    "MQTT exit QR frame is too short.",
                    rawFrameHex);
            }

            if (frameBytes[0] != StartByte)
            {
                return Fail(
                    "Mqtt.ExitQr.InvalidStartByte",
                    $"Invalid start byte. Expected 0x7B but got 0x{frameBytes[0]:X2}.",
                    rawFrameHex);
            }

            if (frameBytes[^1] != EndByte)
            {
                return Fail(
                    "Mqtt.ExitQr.InvalidEndByte",
                    $"Invalid end byte. Expected 0x7D but got 0x{frameBytes[^1]:X2}.",
                    rawFrameHex);
            }

            if (frameBytes.Length <= 4 || frameBytes[3] != PacketConstantByte)
            {
                var actual = frameBytes.Length > 3
                    ? $"0x{frameBytes[3]:X2}"
                    : "missing";

                return Fail(
                    "Mqtt.ExitQr.InvalidConstantByte",
                    $"Invalid constant byte. Expected 0xBD but got {actual}.",
                    rawFrameHex);
            }

            var controllerIdBytes = frameBytes[1..3];

            var controllerId = (controllerIdBytes[0] << 8) | controllerIdBytes[1];
            var controllerIdHex = Convert.ToHexString(controllerIdBytes);

            // MyData = bytes after BD and before 7D
            // Example:
            // 43 41 36 39 32 30 31 35 46 34
            var myDataBytes = frameBytes[4..^1];

            if (myDataBytes.Length == 0)
            {
                return Fail(
                    "Mqtt.ExitQr.EmptyQrData",
                    "QR data part is empty.",
                    rawFrameHex);
            }

            var myDataHex = Convert.ToHexString(myDataBytes);

            // First expected packet mode:
            // MyData is ASCII for QR text.
            // 43 41 36 39 32 30 31 35 46 34 => CA692015F4
            var asciiQr = ExtractQrTextFromAsciiBytes(myDataBytes);

            if (IsExactFiveByteQrHex(asciiQr))
            {
                return Success(
                    rawFrameHex: rawFrameHex,
                    hasControllerId: true,
                    controllerId: controllerId,
                    controllerIdHex: controllerIdHex,
                    myDataHex: myDataHex,
                    qrText: asciiQr);
            }

            // Second supported packet mode:
            // MyData is the real 5 QR bytes.
            // CA 69 20 15 F4 => CA692015F4
            if (myDataBytes.Length == 5)
            {
                var qrText = Convert.ToHexString(myDataBytes);

                if (IsExactFiveByteQrHex(qrText))
                {
                    return Success(
                        rawFrameHex: rawFrameHex,
                        hasControllerId: true,
                        controllerId: controllerId,
                        controllerIdHex: controllerIdHex,
                        myDataHex: myDataHex,
                        qrText: qrText);
                }
            }

            return Fail(
                "Mqtt.ExitQr.UnsupportedQrData",
                "MQTT QR data is not valid ASCII QR hex text or real 5-byte QR data.",
                rawFrameHex);
        }

        private static MqttExitQrPacketDecodeResult Success(
            string rawFrameHex,
            bool hasControllerId,
            int? controllerId,
            string controllerIdHex,
            string myDataHex,
            string qrText)
        {
            var normalizedQrText = NormalizeQrText(qrText);

            return new MqttExitQrPacketDecodeResult
            {
                IsSuccess = true,
                RawFrameHex = rawFrameHex,
                HasControllerId = hasControllerId,
                ControllerId = controllerId,
                ControllerIdHex = controllerIdHex,
                MyDataHex = myDataHex,

                // Actual QR value after decoding ASCII.
                // Example: CA692015F4
                ActualQrHex = normalizedQrText,

                // This is what must go to ValidateExitByTextCommand.Text
                QrString = normalizedQrText
            };
        }

        private static bool LooksLikeRealPacket(byte[] payloadBytes)
        {
            return payloadBytes.Length >= 6 &&
                   payloadBytes[0] == StartByte &&
                   payloadBytes[^1] == EndByte;
        }

        private static byte[]? TryConvertHexTextToBytes(string text)
        {
            var normalized = NormalizeHexText(text);

            if (normalized.Length == 0)
                return null;

            if (normalized.Length % 2 != 0)
                return null;

            if (!Regex.IsMatch(normalized, "^[0-9a-fA-F]+$"))
                return null;

            try
            {
                return Convert.FromHexString(normalized);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static string ExtractQrTextFromAsciiBytes(byte[] bytes)
        {
            if (bytes.Length == 0)
                return string.Empty;

            var cleanBytes = RemoveTrailingCrLf(bytes);

            var text = Encoding.ASCII
                .GetString(cleanBytes)
                .Trim();

            return NormalizeQrText(text);
        }

        private static byte[] RemoveTrailingCrLf(byte[] bytes)
        {
            var end = bytes.Length;

            while (end > 0 && (bytes[end - 1] == 0x0D || bytes[end - 1] == 0x0A))
            {
                end--;
            }

            if (end == bytes.Length)
                return bytes;

            return bytes[..end];
        }

        private static string NormalizeQrText(string value)
        {
            return value
                .Trim()
                .Trim('"')
                .Replace("{", string.Empty)
                .Replace("}", string.Empty)
                .Replace(" ", string.Empty)
                .Replace("-", string.Empty)
                .Replace(":", string.Empty)
                .Replace("\r", string.Empty)
                .Replace("\n", string.Empty)
                .Replace("0x", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToUpperInvariant();
        }

        private static string NormalizeHexText(string value)
        {
            return value
                .Trim()
                .Trim('"')
                .Replace("{", string.Empty)
                .Replace("}", string.Empty)
                .Replace(" ", string.Empty)
                .Replace("-", string.Empty)
                .Replace(":", string.Empty)
                .Replace("\r", string.Empty)
                .Replace("\n", string.Empty)
                .Replace("0x", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }

        private static bool LooksLikeHexText(string value)
        {
            var normalized = NormalizeHexText(value);

            return normalized.Length > 0 &&
                   normalized.Length % 2 == 0 &&
                   Regex.IsMatch(normalized, "^[0-9a-fA-F]+$");
        }

        private static bool IsExactFiveByteQrHex(string value)
        {
            var normalized = NormalizeQrText(value);

            return normalized.Length == 10 &&
                   Regex.IsMatch(normalized, "^[0-9A-F]{10}$");
        }

        private static MqttExitQrPacketDecodeResult Fail(
            string code,
            string message,
            string rawFrameHex = "")
        {
            return new MqttExitQrPacketDecodeResult
            {
                IsSuccess = false,
                ErrorCode = code,
                ErrorMessage = message,
                RawFrameHex = rawFrameHex
            };
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Services\Mqtt\MqttNetworkHeartbeatService.cs ==================== 
﻿using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction;
using NPark.Domain.Entities;
using NPark.Infrastructure.Options;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Services.Mqtt
{
    internal sealed class MqttNetworkHeartbeatService : BackgroundService
    {
        private readonly IMqttPublisher _mqttPublisher;
        private readonly ILogger<MqttNetworkHeartbeatService> _logger;
        private readonly MqttHeartbeatOptions _options;
        private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;

        public MqttNetworkHeartbeatService(
            IMqttPublisher mqttPublisher,
            IOptions<MqttHeartbeatOptions> options,
            IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
            ILogger<MqttNetworkHeartbeatService> logger)
        {
            _mqttPublisher = mqttPublisher;
            _logger = logger;
            _options = options.Value;
            _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
        }

        protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
        {
            if (!_options.Enabled)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("MQTT heartbeat background service is disabled.");
                return;
            }

            if (_options.IntervalSeconds <= 0)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "MQTT heartbeat background service is not started because IntervalSeconds={IntervalSeconds} is invalid.",
                    _options.IntervalSeconds);
                return;
            }

            var payload = NormalizePayload(_options.Payload);
            var hexPayload = StringToHexBytes(payload);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "MQTT heartbeat background service started. IntervalSeconds={IntervalSeconds}, Payload={Payload} (hex)",
                _options.IntervalSeconds,
                payload);

            using var timer = new PeriodicTimer(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(_options.IntervalSeconds));

            try
            {
                while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken))
                {
                    try
                    {
                        using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
                        var dbContext = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<NParkDBContext>();

                        var controlIps = await dbContext.Set<ParkingGate>()
                            .AsNoTracking()
                            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.ControlIp))
                            .Select(x => x.ControlIp!)
                            .Distinct()
                            .ToListAsync(stoppingToken);

                        foreach (var controlIp in controlIps)
                        {
                            var topic = BuildTopic(_options.TopicPrefix, controlIp);

                            await _mqttPublisher.PublishBytesAsync(
                                topic,
                                hexPayload,
                                new MqttPublishOptions(_options.Qos, _options.Retain),
                                stoppingToken);

                            _logger.LogInformation(
                                "MQTT heartbeat published successfully. Topic={Topic}, PayloadHex={PayloadHex}",
                                topic,
                                BitConverter.ToString(hexPayload.ToArray()).Replace("-", ""));
                            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1), stoppingToken);
                        }
                    }
                    catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                    {
                        break;
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to publish MQTT heartbeat.");
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
            }

            _logger.LogInformation("MQTT heartbeat background service stopped.");
        }

        private static string BuildTopic(string topicPrefix, string deviceId)
        {
            var normalizedPrefix = (topicPrefix ?? string.Empty).Trim().TrimEnd('/');
            var normalizedDeviceId = (deviceId ?? string.Empty).Trim();

            return $"{normalizedPrefix}/{normalizedDeviceId}";
        }

        private static string NormalizePayload(string payload)
        {
            return (payload ?? string.Empty).Trim();
        }

        private static ReadOnlyMemory<byte> StringToHexBytes(string input)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(input))
                return Array.Empty<byte>();

            // إزالة المسافات والفواصل لو موجودة
            input = input.Replace(" ", "").Replace("-", "");

            if (input.Length % 2 != 0)
                input = "0" + input; // إضافة صفر إذا الطول فردي

            var bytes = new byte[input.Length / 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < bytes.Length; i++)
            {
                bytes[i] = Convert.ToByte(input.Substring(i * 2, 2), 16);
            }
            return bytes;
        }
    }
} 
// ==================== E:\NPark\ITC\NPark.Infrastructure\Services\Mqtt\MqttNetworkSubscriberService.cs ==================== 
﻿using MediatR;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using MQTTnet;
using MQTTnet.Client;
using MQTTnet.Formatter;
using MQTTnet.Protocol;
using NPark.Application.Abstraction;
using NPark.Application.Feature.MqttNetworkManagement;
using NPark.Application.Feature.MqttNetworkManagement.ProcessMqttExitPacket;
using NPark.Infrastructure.Options;
using System.Security.Authentication;

namespace NPark.Infrastructure.Services.Mqtt
{
    internal sealed class MqttNetworkSubscriberService : BackgroundService
    {
        private readonly ILogger<MqttNetworkSubscriberService> _logger;
        private readonly MqttOptions _mqttOptions;
        private readonly MqttNetworkSubscriberOptions _subscriberOptions;
        private readonly IMqttCaptureSignalRNotifier _notifier;
        private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
        private readonly IMqttClient _client;

        private CancellationToken _stoppingToken;

        public MqttNetworkSubscriberService(
            IOptions<MqttOptions> mqttOptions,
            IOptions<MqttNetworkSubscriberOptions> subscriberOptions,
            IMqttCaptureSignalRNotifier notifier,
            IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
            ILogger<MqttNetworkSubscriberService> logger)
        {
            _mqttOptions = mqttOptions.Value;
            _subscriberOptions = subscriberOptions.Value;
            _notifier = notifier ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(notifier));
            _scopeFactory = scopeFactory ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(scopeFactory));
            _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
            _client = new MqttFactory().CreateMqttClient();
        }

        protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
        {
            _stoppingToken = stoppingToken;

            if (!_subscriberOptions.Enabled)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("MQTT Network Subscriber is disabled.");
                return;
            }

            ConfigureClientHandlers();

            try
            {
                await ConnectAndSubscribeAsync(stoppingToken);

                await Task.Delay(Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan, stoppingToken);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                // Normal shutdown.
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "MQTT Network Subscriber stopped unexpectedly.");
            }
        }

        private void ConfigureClientHandlers()
        {
            _client.ApplicationMessageReceivedAsync += async args =>
            {
                try
                {
                    await HandleMessageAsync(args);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    _logger.LogError(ex, "Error while handling MQTT message.");
                }
            };

            _client.DisconnectedAsync += async args =>
            {
                if (_stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                    return;

                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "MQTT subscriber disconnected. Reason={Reason}. Reconnecting in {ReconnectSeconds} seconds...",
                    args.Reason,
                    _subscriberOptions.ReconnectSeconds);

                try
                {
                    await Task.Delay(
                        TimeSpan.FromSeconds(_subscriberOptions.ReconnectSeconds),
                        _stoppingToken);

                    await ConnectAndSubscribeAsync(_stoppingToken);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                {
                    // Normal shutdown.
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    _logger.LogError(ex, "MQTT subscriber reconnect failed.");
                }
            };
        }

        private async Task ConnectAndSubscribeAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (_client.IsConnected)
                return;

            var clientId = $"{_mqttOptions.ClientId}-subscriber";

            var builder = new MqttClientOptionsBuilder()
                .WithClientId(clientId)
                .WithTcpServer(_mqttOptions.Host, _mqttOptions.Port)
                .WithKeepAlivePeriod(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(_mqttOptions.KeepAliveSeconds))
                .WithProtocolVersion(MqttProtocolVersion.V311)
                .WithCleanSession();

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_mqttOptions.Username))
            {
                builder = builder.WithCredentials(_mqttOptions.Username, _mqttOptions.Password);
            }

            if (_mqttOptions.UseTls)
            {
                builder = builder.WithTls(new MqttClientOptionsBuilderTlsParameters
                {
                    UseTls = true,
                    SslProtocol = SslProtocols.Tls12
                });
            }

            await _client.ConnectAsync(builder.Build(), cancellationToken);

            var subscribeOptions = new MqttClientSubscribeOptionsBuilder()
                .WithTopicFilter(filter =>
                {
                    filter.WithTopic(_subscriberOptions.TopicFilter);
                    filter.WithQualityOfServiceLevel(
                        (MqttQualityOfServiceLevel)Math.Clamp(_subscriberOptions.Qos, 0, 2));
                })
                .Build();

            await _client.SubscribeAsync(subscribeOptions, cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "MQTT subscriber connected. Host={Host}, Port={Port}, ClientId={ClientId}, TopicFilter={TopicFilter}",
                _mqttOptions.Host,
                _mqttOptions.Port,
                clientId,
                _subscriberOptions.TopicFilter);
        }

        private async Task HandleMessageAsync(MqttApplicationMessageReceivedEventArgs args)
        {
            var workflowId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
            var topic = args.ApplicationMessage.Topic;

            using var logScope = _logger.BeginScope(new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["WorkflowId"] = workflowId,
                ["MqttTopic"] = topic ?? string.Empty
            });

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "MQTT EXIT FLOW START. WorkflowId={WorkflowId}, Topic={Topic}",
                workflowId,
                topic);

            if (!TryExtractDeviceId(topic, out var deviceId))
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "MQTT EXIT FLOW STOPPED. Invalid topic. WorkflowId={WorkflowId}, Topic={Topic}",
                    workflowId,
                    topic);

                return;
            }

            var payloadBytes = args.ApplicationMessage.PayloadSegment.ToArray();
            var rawPayloadSpacedHex = ToSpacedHex(payloadBytes);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "MQTT packet received. WorkflowId={WorkflowId}, DeviceId={DeviceId}, PayloadLength={PayloadLength}, RawPayloadHex={RawPayloadHex}",
                workflowId,
                deviceId,
                payloadBytes.Length,
                rawPayloadSpacedHex);

            using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();

            var sender = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ISender>();

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Sending ProcessMqttExitPacketCommand. WorkflowId={WorkflowId}, DeviceId={DeviceId}",
                workflowId,
                deviceId);

            var result = await sender.Send(
                new ProcessMqttExitPacketCommand
                {
                    DeviceId = deviceId,
                    PayloadBytes = payloadBytes
                },
                _stoppingToken);

            if (!result.IsSuccess)
            {
                var error = result.Errors.FirstOrDefault();

                _logger.LogError(
                    "ProcessMqttExitPacketCommand failed. WorkflowId={WorkflowId}, DeviceId={DeviceId}, ErrorCode={ErrorCode}, ErrorMessage={ErrorMessage}",
                    workflowId,
                    deviceId,
                    error?.Code,
                    error?.Message);

                await _notifier.NotifyCaptureDetectedAsync(
                    new MqttCaptureDetectedResponse
                    {
                        DeviceId = deviceId,
                        CaptureId = false,
                        PayloadHex = rawPayloadSpacedHex,
                        WorkflowSucceeded = false,
                        ErrorCode = error?.Code ?? "MqttExit.UnknownError",
                        ErrorMessage = error?.Message ?? "Unknown MQTT exit error."
                    },
                    _stoppingToken);

                return;
            }

            var workflow = result.Value;

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "ProcessMqttExitPacketCommand completed. WorkflowId={WorkflowId}, DeviceId={DeviceId}, IsValidForExit={IsValidForExit}, TicketExited={TicketExited}, GateOpened={GateOpened}, WorkflowSucceeded={WorkflowSucceeded}, ErrorCode={ErrorCode}, ErrorMessage={ErrorMessage}",
                workflowId,
                workflow.DeviceId,
                workflow.IsValidForExit,
                workflow.TicketExited,
                workflow.GateOpened,
                workflow.WorkflowSucceeded,
                workflow.ErrorCode,
                workflow.ErrorMessage);

            await _notifier.NotifyCaptureDetectedAsync(
                new MqttCaptureDetectedResponse
                {
                    DeviceId = workflow.DeviceId,
                    CaptureId = true,
                    PayloadHex = ToSpacedHex(workflow.PayloadHex),
                    ControllerIdFromPacket = workflow.ControllerIdFromPacket,
                    MyDataHex = ToSpacedHex(workflow.MyDataHex),
                    ActualQrHex = ToSpacedHex(workflow.ActualQrHex),
                    QrString = workflow.QrString,
                    TicketId = workflow.TicketId,
                    IsValidForExit = workflow.IsValidForExit,
                    TicketExited = workflow.TicketExited,
                    GateOpened = workflow.GateOpened,
                    WorkflowSucceeded = workflow.WorkflowSucceeded,
                    OpenGateTopic = workflow.OpenGateTopic,
                    OpenGatePayload = ToSpacedHex(workflow.OpenGatePayload ?? string.Empty),
                    ErrorCode = workflow.ErrorCode,
                    ErrorMessage = workflow.ErrorMessage
                },
                _stoppingToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "MQTT EXIT FLOW END. WorkflowId={WorkflowId}, DeviceId={DeviceId}, WorkflowSucceeded={WorkflowSucceeded}",
                workflowId,
                workflow.DeviceId,
                workflow.WorkflowSucceeded);
        }

        private static bool TryExtractDeviceId(string? topic, out string deviceId)
        {
            deviceId = string.Empty;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(topic))
                return false;

            var parts = topic.Split(
                '/',
                StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries);

            // Expected:
            // publish/network/{deviceId}
            if (parts.Length < 3)
                return false;

            if (!parts[0].Equals("publish", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return false;

            if (!parts[1].Equals("network", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return false;

            deviceId = parts[2];

            return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(deviceId);
        }

        private static string ToSpacedHex(byte[] bytes)
        {
            if (bytes.Length == 0)
                return string.Empty;

            return string.Join(" ", bytes.Select(b => b.ToString("X2")));
        }

        private static string ToSpacedHex(string hex)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(hex))
                return string.Empty;

            hex = hex
                .Replace(" ", string.Empty)
                .Replace("-", string.Empty)
                .Replace("{", string.Empty)
                .Replace("}", string.Empty)
                .Replace("0x", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            if (hex.Length % 2 != 0)
                return hex;

            return string.Join(
                " ",
                Enumerable.Range(0, hex.Length / 2)
                    .Select(i => hex.Substring(i * 2, 2).ToUpperInvariant()));
        }

        public override async Task StopAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            try
            {
                if (_client.IsConnected)
                    await _client.DisconnectAsync(cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            }
            catch
            {
                // Best effort shutdown.
            }

            await base.StopAsync(cancellationToken);
        }

        public override void Dispose()
        {
            _client.Dispose();
            base.Dispose();
        }
    }
}
